	        // === ZOOM-INTERAKTION (Mausrad + Pinch) fcr den Slider-Bereich ===
	        (function initSliderZoomInteraction() {
	            const zoomCfg = PARAMS_CONFIG.zoom;
	            const zoomTarget = slider1.container;
	            if (!zoomCfg || !zoomTarget) return;

	            function applyZoomFromInteraction(rawZoom) {
	                let z = typeof rawZoom === 'number' && isFinite(rawZoom)
	                    ? rawZoom
	                    : zoomCfg.default;
	                z = Math.max(zoomCfg.min, Math.min(zoomCfg.max, z));
	                const factor = Math.pow(10, zoomCfg.decimals);
	                z = Math.round(z * factor) / factor;
	                params.zoom = z;
	                const input = document.getElementById(zoomCfg.id);
	                if (input) input.value = z;
	                // baseWidth nicht anfassen: wir zoomen nur relativ zur Basisbreite
	                updateStyles();
	            }

	            // Maus / Trackpad: Scrollrad zum Zoomen verwenden
	            zoomTarget.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
	                // Mit gedrckte Strg-Taste lieber dem Browser das Zoomen 	berlassen
	                if (e.ctrlKey) return;
	                e.preventDefault();
	                const current = typeof params.zoom === 'number' && isFinite(params.zoom)
	                    ? params.zoom
	                    : zoomCfg.default;
	                const factor = e.deltaY < 0 ? 1.05 : 0.95;
	                applyZoomFromInteraction(current * factor);
	            }, { passive: false });

	            // Touch: Zwei-Finger-Pinch auf dem Slider-Container
	            let pinchActive = false;
	            let lastPinchDistance = 0;

	            function distanceBetweenTouches(t1, t2) {
	                const dx = t2.clientX - t1.clientX;
	                const dy = t2.clientY - t1.clientY;
	                return Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
	            }

	            zoomTarget.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
	                if (e.touches.length === 2) {
	                    pinchActive = true;
	                    lastPinchDistance = distanceBetweenTouches(e.touches[0], e.touches[1]);
	                }
	            }, { passive: true });

	            zoomTarget.addEventListener('touchmove', (e) => {
	                if (!pinchActive || e.touches.length !== 2) return;
	                e.preventDefault();
	                const dist = distanceBetweenTouches(e.touches[0], e.touches[1]);
	                if (!lastPinchDistance) {
	                    lastPinchDistance = dist;
	                    return;
	                }
	                const ratio = dist / lastPinchDistance;
	                const current = typeof params.zoom === 'number' && isFinite(params.zoom)
	                    ? params.zoom
	                    : zoomCfg.default;
	                applyZoomFromInteraction(current * ratio);
	                lastPinchDistance = dist;
	            }, { passive: false });

	            function resetPinch() {
	                pinchActive = false;
	                lastPinchDistance = 0;
	            }

	            zoomTarget.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
	                if (e.touches.length < 2) {
	                    resetPinch();
	                }
	            });

	            zoomTarget.addEventListener('touchcancel', resetPinch);
	        })();

	        // Globaler Pointer-Zustand f�fcr die Schlange (Maus + Touch)
		        const snakePointer = {
		            active: false,
		            x: 0,
		            y: 0
		        };
		
		    // === WEBGL-SCHLANGE (GPU-RENDERING) ===
		    let useWebGLSnake = false;
		    let renderSnakeFrame = null;

		    function initSnakeWebGL() {
		        if (!slider1ValueDisplay) return;
		        const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
		        canvas.id = 'snakeCanvas';
		        slider1ValueDisplay.innerHTML = '';
		        slider1ValueDisplay.appendChild(canvas);
		        canvas.style.width = '100%';
		        canvas.style.height = '100%';

		        const gl = canvas.getContext('webgl', {
		            antialias: true,
		            premultipliedAlpha: true,
		        });
		        if (!gl) {
		            console.warn('WebGL nicht verfgbar, fallback auf DOM-Schlange.');
		            return;
		        }

		        // Vollbild-Triangle
		        const vertexSrc = `
		            attribute vec2 a_position;
		            void main() {
		                gl_Position = vec4(a_position, 0.0, 1.0);
		            }
		        `;

		        const fragmentSrc = `
		            precision mediump float;
		            uniform vec2 u_resolution;
		            uniform float u_time;
		            uniform float u_value;
		            uniform float u_digits;
		            uniform vec2 u_pointer;
		            uniform float u_pointerActive;
		
		            void main() {
		                // Normalisierte Koordinaten, Mitte = (0,0)
		                vec2 uv = (gl_FragCoord.xy / u_resolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
		                uv.x *= u_resolution.x / u_resolution.y;
		
		                float t = u_time * 0.4;
		                float value = clamp(u_value, 0.0, 1.0);
		
		                // Sichtbare Laenge der Schlange: -0.8 .. +0.8 skaliert mit value
		                float head = mix(-0.8, 0.8, value);
		                if (uv.x < -0.8 || uv.x > head) {
		                    gl_FragColor = vec4(0.0);
		                    return;
		                }
		
		                // Grundbahn: sinusfoermig
		                float baseY = sin(uv.x * 3.5 + t * 1.2) * 0.15;
		
		                // "Aufloesung" steuert Dichte eines Musters entlang der Schlange
		                float digits = clamp(u_digits, 0.0, 12.0);
		                float density = mix(4.0, 40.0, digits / 12.0);
		
		                // Pointer-Einfluss: Schlange wird in der Naehe weggedrueckt
		                vec2 pNorm = u_pointer * 2.0 - 1.0;
		                pNorm.x *= u_resolution.x / u_resolution.y;
		                float dPtr = length(uv - pNorm);
		                float push = 0.0;
		                if (u_pointerActive > 0.5) {
		                    float influence = smoothstep(0.6, 0.0, dPtr);
		                    push = influence * 0.25;
		                }
		
		                float y = baseY + push;
		                float dist = abs(uv.y - y);
		                float thickness = mix(0.015, 0.035, 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(t + value * 6.2831));
		                float alpha = smoothstep(thickness, 0.0, dist);
		
		                // Segmentiertes Muster entlang der Laengsachse: abstrahiert viele 'x'
		                float segmentPhase = fract((uv.x + 1.2) * density);
		                float segmentMask = smoothstep(0.0, 0.2, segmentPhase)
		                                   * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.8, 1.0, segmentPhase));
		
		                vec3 colA = vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0);
		                vec3 colB = vec3(0.3, 0.8, 1.0);
		                vec3 col = mix(colA, colB, segmentMask);
		
		                gl_FragColor = vec4(col, alpha * (0.3 + 0.7 * value));
		            }
		        `;

		        function createShader(type, source) {
		            const shader = gl.createShader(type);
		            gl.shaderSource(shader, source);
		            gl.compileShader(shader);
		            if (!gl.getShaderParameter(shader, gl.COMPILE_STATUS)) {
		                console.warn('Shader compile error:', gl.getShaderInfoLog(shader));
		                gl.deleteShader(shader);
		                return null;
		            }
		            return shader;
		        }

		        const vs = createShader(gl.VERTEX_SHADER, vertexSrc);
		        const fs = createShader(gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER, fragmentSrc);
		        if (!vs || !fs) return;

		        const program = gl.createProgram();
		        gl.attachShader(program, vs);
		        gl.attachShader(program, fs);
		        gl.linkProgram(program);
		        if (!gl.getProgramParameter(program, gl.LINK_STATUS)) {
		            console.warn('Program link error:', gl.getProgramInfoLog(program));
		            gl.deleteProgram(program);
		            return;
		        }

		        gl.useProgram(program);

		        const posBuffer = gl.createBuffer();
		        gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, posBuffer);
		        gl.bufferData(
		            gl.ARRAY_BUFFER,
		            new Float32Array([
		                -1, -1,
		                 3, -1,
		                -1,  3,
		            ]),
		            gl.STATIC_DRAW
		        );

		        const aPos = gl.getAttribLocation(program, 'a_position');
		        gl.enableVertexAttribArray(aPos);
		        gl.vertexAttribPointer(aPos, 2, gl.FLOAT, false, 0, 0);

		        const uResolution = gl.getUniformLocation(program, 'u_resolution');
		        const uTime = gl.getUniformLocation(program, 'u_time');
		        const uValue = gl.getUniformLocation(program, 'u_value');
		        const uDigits = gl.getUniformLocation(program, 'u_digits');
		        const uPointer = gl.getUniformLocation(program, 'u_pointer');
		        const uPointerActive = gl.getUniformLocation(program, 'u_pointerActive');

		        gl.enable(gl.BLEND);
		        gl.blendFunc(gl.SRC_ALPHA, gl.ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA);

		        function resizeCanvas() {
		            const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
		            const width = window.innerWidth || slider1ValueDisplay.clientWidth || 800;
		            const height = window.innerHeight || slider1ValueDisplay.clientHeight || 600;
		            const displayWidth = Math.floor(width * dpr);
		            const displayHeight = Math.floor(height * dpr);
		            if (canvas.width !== displayWidth || canvas.height !== displayHeight) {
		                canvas.width = displayWidth;
		                canvas.height = displayHeight;
		            }
		        }

		        window.addEventListener('resize', resizeCanvas);
		        resizeCanvas();

		        renderSnakeFrame = function(time) {
		            resizeCanvas();
		            gl.viewport(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
		            gl.clearColor(0, 0, 0, 0);
		            gl.clear(gl.COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);
		
		            const norm = (typeof slider1.currentValue === 'number') ? slider1.currentValue : 0;
		            const digits = (typeof params.resolutionSteps === 'number') ? params.resolutionSteps : 0;
		
		            let px = 0.5;
		            let py = 0.5;
		            let active = 0.0;
		            if (snakePointer && window.innerWidth && window.innerHeight) {
		                px = snakePointer.x / window.innerWidth;
		                py = 1 - (snakePointer.y / window.innerHeight);
		                active = snakePointer.active ? 1.0 : 0.0;
		            }
		
		            gl.useProgram(program);
		            gl.uniform2f(uResolution, canvas.width, canvas.height);
		            gl.uniform1f(uTime, (typeof time === 'number' ? time : performance.now()) * 0.001);
		            gl.uniform1f(uValue, norm);
		            gl.uniform1f(uDigits, digits);
		            gl.uniform2f(uPointer, px, py);
		            gl.uniform1f(uPointerActive, active);
		
		            gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLES, 0, 3);
		        };

		        useWebGLSnake = true;
		    }
		
		    // === ORIENTIERUNGSHILFEN (aus Rotation abgeleitet) ===
		    function getOrientation(rotationDeg) {
		        if (typeof rotationDeg !== 'number' || !isFinite(rotationDeg)) return 'horizontal';
		        const r = ((rotationDeg % 360) + 360) % 360; // 0..360
		        const distTo90 = Math.min(Math.abs(r - 90), Math.abs(r - 270));
		        const distTo0  = Math.min(Math.abs(r), Math.abs(r - 180));
		        return distTo90 > distTo0 ? 'horizontal' : 'vertical';
		    }

		    function isVerticalMode() {
		        return getOrientation(params.rotation) === 'vertical';
		    }

		    function updateVerticalToggleUI() {
		        if (!verticalToggle) return;
		        const vertical = isVerticalMode();
		        verticalToggle.textContent = vertical ? 'An' : 'Aus';
		        verticalToggle.classList.toggle('active', vertical);
		        verticalToggle.setAttribute('aria-pressed', vertical ? 'true' : 'false');
		    }

		    // === ERZEUGE NORMALISIERTES GLYPH-BILD (HiDPI, optional gestreckt) ===
		    // Rendert Text DIREKT mit moderater Skalierung, damit die Canvas-Größe nicht explodiert
		    function createGlyphImage(text, fontFamily, fontSize, color = 'white', strokeOnly = false, stretchY = 1) {
		        // Moderate HiDPI-Skalierung (max. 2x) für Schärfe ohne riesige Canvas
		        const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
		        const scale = Math.min(2, Math.max(1, dpr));
		        const scaledFontSize = fontSize * scale;
		
		        // Canvas-Größe: proportional zur Fontgröße und Streckung, aber kompakt
		        const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
		        const safeStretch = Math.max(1, stretchY);
		        const padding = Math.ceil(scaledFontSize * 0.5);
		        const textLen = text && text.length ? text.length : 1;
		        const canvasWidth = Math.ceil(scaledFontSize * textLen) + padding * 2;
		        const canvasHeight = Math.ceil(scaledFontSize * safeStretch) + padding * 2;
            canvas.width = canvasWidth;
            canvas.height = canvasHeight;
            const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

            // Text DIREKT mit Skalierung rendern (nicht nachträglich strecken!)
            ctx.save();
            ctx.translate(padding, padding);
            ctx.scale(1, stretchY); // Vertikale Streckung VOR dem Zeichnen

            ctx.font = `${scaledFontSize}px ${fontFamily}`;
            ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
            ctx.textAlign = 'left';

            if (strokeOnly) {
                ctx.strokeStyle = color;
                ctx.lineWidth = scale;
                ctx.strokeText(text, 0, 0);
            } else {
                ctx.fillStyle = color;
                ctx.fillText(text, 0, 0);
            }
            ctx.restore();

            // Pixel scannen um Grenzen zu finden
            const imageData = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, canvasWidth, canvasHeight);
            const data = imageData.data;

            let minX = canvasWidth, maxX = 0, minY = canvasHeight, maxY = 0;

            for (let y = 0; y < canvasHeight; y++) {
                for (let x = 0; x < canvasWidth; x++) {
                    if (data[(y * canvasWidth + x) * 4 + 3] > 0) {
                        minX = Math.min(minX, x);
                        maxX = Math.max(maxX, x);
                        minY = Math.min(minY, y);
                        maxY = Math.max(maxY, y);
                    }
                }
            }

            // Falls keine Pixel gefunden (leerer Text)
            if (minX > maxX || minY > maxY) {
                return { dataUrl: '', width: 0, height: 0, scale };
            }

            // Gecropte Größe (bereits gestreckt!)
            const cropWidth = maxX - minX + 1;
            const cropHeight = maxY - minY + 1;

            const croppedCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
            croppedCanvas.width = cropWidth;
            croppedCanvas.height = cropHeight;
            const croppedCtx = croppedCanvas.getContext('2d');

            // Einfach kopieren - keine Streckung mehr nötig
            croppedCtx.drawImage(canvas, minX, minY, cropWidth, cropHeight, 0, 0, cropWidth, cropHeight);

            return {
                dataUrl: croppedCanvas.toDataURL('image/png'),
                // CSS-Größe = Canvas-Größe / scale
                width: cropWidth / scale,
                height: cropHeight / scale,
                scale
            };
        }

	        // === WERT-HELPER (HTML-Range-ähnliches Modell: min/max/step, value) ===
	        function getSliderRange(slider) {
	            let min = typeof slider.min === 'number' ? slider.min : 0;
	            let max = typeof slider.max === 'number' ? slider.max : 1;
	            const step = typeof slider.step === 'number' ? slider.step : 0;
	            if (max < min) {
	                const tmp = min;
	                min = max;
	                max = tmp;
	            }
	            return { min, max, step };
	        }

	        function valueToNormalized(slider, value) {
	            const { min, max } = getSliderRange(slider);
	            if (max <= min) return 0;
	            return (value - min) / (max - min);
	        }

	        function normalizedToValue(slider, norm) {
	            const { min, max } = getSliderRange(slider);
	            if (max <= min) return min;
	            return min + norm * (max - min);
	        }

	        // Setzt den logischen Slider-Wert (wie beim HTML-Range) und aktualisiert Geometrie
	        function setSliderValue(slider, newValue, options = {}) {
	            const { fromUser = false } = options; // wird später für Events genutzt
	            const { min, max, step } = getSliderRange(slider);
	            let v = typeof newValue === 'number' ? newValue : min;

	            // Clamp auf [min,max]
	            if (v < min) v = min;
	            if (v > max) v = max;

	            // Auf step runden (wenn sinnvoll definiert)
	            if (step > 0 && max > min) {
	                v = min + Math.round((v - min) / step) * step;
	                if (v < min) v = min;
	                if (v > max) v = max;
	            }

		            	    slider.value = v;
		            	    // Wenn es unser Hauptslider ist, synchronisieren wir nur noch den internen x-Wert,
		            	    // die sichtbare 0.xx-Schlange h�ngt direkt an slider.currentValue.

	            // In Normalform [0,1] umrechnen
	            let norm = 0;
	            if (max > min) {
	                norm = (v - min) / (max - min);
	            }
	            norm = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, norm));
		            // "norm" ist die logische Benutzer-Norm (0 = links, 1 = rechts)
		            slider.currentValue = norm;
		
		            // Geometrie arbeitet mit invertierter Norm, damit 0 links und 1 rechts sind
		            const geoNorm = 1 - norm;
		            setThumbPosition(slider, geoNorm);

	            // Später: hier input/change-Events feuern, abhängig von fromUser
	            return v;
	        }

        // === RENDERE SLIDER-ELEMENTE ALS BILDER ===
		    function renderSliderImages(slider) {
		        const font = fontSelect.value;
		    	    const size = params.size;
		    	    const lengthParam = params.length;
		    	    const userRotation = params.rotation;
				        const zoom = (typeof params.zoom === 'number' && isFinite(params.zoom)) ? params.zoom : 1;
				        const thumbScale = (typeof params.thumbScale === 'number' && isFinite(params.thumbScale)) ? params.thumbScale : PARAMS_CONFIG.thumbScale.default;
				        const thumbSize = size * thumbScale;

			    // Erzeuge normalisierte Bilder
			    const trackOutlineImg = createGlyphImage(slider.trackChar, font, size, 'white', true, 1);
			    const trackFillImg = createGlyphImage(slider.trackChar, font, size, 'white', false, 1);
			    const thumbImg = createGlyphImage(slider.thumbChar, font, thumbSize, 'white', false, 1);

			        // Container-Breite aus dem Layout (wie bei einem echten <input type="range">)
			        const rect = slider.container.getBoundingClientRect();
			        let baseWidth = rect.width;
			        if (!baseWidth || !isFinite(baseWidth)) {
			            // Fallback: benutze Glyph-Breite oder einen Default
			            baseWidth = trackOutlineImg.width || 600;
			        }
			        if (typeof slider.baseWidth !== 'number' || !isFinite(slider.baseWidth) || slider.baseWidth <= 0) {
			            slider.baseWidth = baseWidth;
			        }
				        const viewportWidth = window.innerWidth || slider.baseWidth || 600;
				        const maxWidth = viewportWidth * 0.95;
				        const baseLength = PARAMS_CONFIG.length.default || 1;
				        const rawLength = (typeof lengthParam === 'number' && isFinite(lengthParam)) ? lengthParam : baseLength;
				        const lengthFactor = Math.max(0.1, rawLength / baseLength);
				        const targetWidthUnclamped = slider.baseWidth * zoom * lengthFactor;
				        const targetWidth = Math.max(40, Math.min(targetWidthUnclamped, maxWidth));
			        slider.container.style.width = targetWidth + 'px';
			
			        const containerRect = slider.container.getBoundingClientRect();
			        let containerWidth = containerRect.width;
			        if (!containerWidth || !isFinite(containerWidth)) {
			            // Fallback: benutze Glyph-Breite oder einen Default
			            containerWidth = targetWidth || trackOutlineImg.width || 600;
			        }
			
				        // Die sichtbare Slider-Achse orientiert sich an der Container-Breite,
				        // die durch Zoom * L�e4ngenfaktor bestimmt wurde.
				        const axisLength = Math.max(10, containerWidth);

		            // Skaliere den Track so, dass seine logische Länge = axisLength ist.
		            // Die Länge der Bahn verläuft IMMER entlang der lokalen Y-Achse der Glyphe,
		            // daher normieren wir konsequent auf die Glyphen-Höhe.
		            let scaleForTrack = 1;
		            const natLength = trackOutlineImg.height || 1;
		            scaleForTrack = axisLength / natLength;

		        // Gleicher Scale für Thumb, damit Proportionen stimmen
		        const trackWidth = trackOutlineImg.width * scaleForTrack;
		        const trackHeight = trackOutlineImg.height * scaleForTrack;
		        const thumbWidth = thumbImg.width * scaleForTrack;
		        const thumbHeight = thumbImg.height * scaleForTrack;

	            slider.trackWidth = trackWidth;
	            slider.trackHeight = trackHeight;
	            slider.thumbWidth = thumbWidth;
	            slider.thumbHeight = thumbHeight;

	            // Container-Höhe = Drag-Bereich: exakt so hoch wie der Thumb
	            // (plus minimale Untergrenze, falls Thumb extrem klein wäre)
	            const dragHeight = Math.max(thumbHeight, 10);
	            slider.container.style.height = dragHeight + 'px';

	            const containerCenterX = containerWidth / 2;
	            const containerCenterY = dragHeight / 2;

	            // Internes Winkelmodell:
	            // - "userRotation" ist der Wert aus dem UI, bei dem 0° eine aufrechte 1 ergibt
	            // - Wir verschieben intern um +90°, damit 0° UI einer vertikalen Achse (oben/unten) entspricht.
	            // - "baseRotation" beschreibt damit die tatsächliche Slider-Achse (in Mathe-Koordinaten):
	            //     0°  = nach rechts, 90° = nach oben, 180° = nach links, 270° = nach unten.
	            // - Diese Achse nutzen wir sowohl zum Drehen der Glyphe als auch für Drag + Debug-Linie.
	            const baseRotation = (userRotation + 90) % 360; // 0° UI => 90° intern (vertikal nach oben)
	            const glyphRotation = baseRotation;

	            // Track-Outline setzen
	            slider.trackOutline.style.backgroundImage = `url(${trackOutlineImg.dataUrl})`;
	            slider.trackOutline.style.width = trackWidth + 'px';
	            slider.trackOutline.style.height = trackHeight + 'px';
	            slider.trackOutline.style.left = containerCenterX + 'px';
	            slider.trackOutline.style.top = containerCenterY + 'px';
	            // Glyphen-Rotation: 0° UI = aufrecht, 90°-Slide dreht nur das Zeichen
	            slider.trackOutline.style.transform = `translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(${glyphRotation - 90}deg)`;

	            // Track-Fill setzen
	            slider.trackFill.style.backgroundImage = `url(${trackFillImg.dataUrl})`;
	            slider.trackFill.style.width = trackWidth + 'px';
	            slider.trackFill.style.height = trackHeight + 'px';
	            slider.trackFill.style.left = containerCenterX + 'px';
	            slider.trackFill.style.top = containerCenterY + 'px';
	            slider.trackFill.style.transform = `translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(${glyphRotation - 90}deg)`;

	            // Thumb setzen
	            slider.thumb.style.backgroundImage = `url(${thumbImg.dataUrl})`;
	            slider.thumb.style.width = thumbWidth + 'px';
	            slider.thumb.style.height = thumbHeight + 'px';

	            // Berechne Slider-Bounds
	            // Slide-Achse: läuft entlang der Glyphen-Achse (baseRotation)
	            const slideRot = baseRotation;
	            const halfRange = axisLength / 2;

	            slider.bounds = {
	                centerX: containerCenterX,
	                centerY: containerCenterY,
	                halfRange,
	                trackLength: axisLength,
	                slideRotation: slideRot
	            };

	            // Thumb initial positionieren – aktuellen Wert im HTML-Sinne auf die Geometrie mappen
	            const range = getSliderRange(slider);
	            const initialValue = (typeof slider.value === 'number')
	                ? slider.value
	                : (range.min + range.max) / 2;
	            setSliderValue(slider, initialValue);

	            return slider.bounds;
	        }

	    // === POSITIONIERE DEN THUMB (value = 0 bis 1) ===
		    function setThumbPosition(slider, value) {
		        if (!slider.bounds) return;
		
			        // Wert begrenzen (Geo-Norm 0..1)
			        value = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, value));
		
			        // Offset vom Zentrum (-halfRange bis +halfRange), "value" ist hier die Geo-Norm
		        const offset = (value - 0.5) * 2 * slider.bounds.halfRange;
		
		        // Slide-Richtung aus bounds
		        const slideRot = slider.bounds.slideRotation;
		        const rotRad = slideRot * Math.PI / 180;
		
		        // Position entlang der rotierten Achse (das ist das ZENTRUM des Thumbs)
		        const thumbCenterX = slider.bounds.centerX + offset * Math.cos(rotRad);
		        const thumbCenterY = slider.bounds.centerY + offset * Math.sin(rotRad);
		
		        // CSS Position - Thumb hat transform: translate(-50%, -50%)
		        // Also ist left/top direkt das Zentrum!
		        slider.thumb.style.left = thumbCenterX + 'px';
		        slider.thumb.style.top = thumbCenterY + 'px';
		
		            // Debug: Thumb-Fadenkreuz positionieren (genau im berechneten Zentrum)
		            const crossSize = parseFloat(slider.thumbCenterCross.style.width) || 24;
		            slider.thumbCenterCross.style.left = (thumbCenterX - crossSize / 2) + 'px';
		            slider.thumbCenterCross.style.top = (thumbCenterY - crossSize / 2) + 'px';
		
		            // Füllung der Track aktualisieren
		            // Vereinfachte Variante: die Füllkante bewegt sich immer ENTLANG der Bahn
		            // und schneidet diese exakt im Thumb-Zentrum – unabhängig vom Winkel.
		            const trackHeight = slider.trackHeight || 0;
		            let clipPathValue = '';
		
		            if (trackHeight > 0) {
		                // value: 0   -> Clip oben   = 0%  (Kante am einen Ende der Bahn)
		                // value: 0.5 -> Clip oben   = 50% (Kante in der Mitte)
		                // value: 1   -> Clip oben   = 100% (Kante am anderen Ende)
		                // Da trackHeight == geometrische Länge der Bahn ist,
		                // liegt die Kante damit immer exakt auf dem Thumb.
		                const clipPercent = value * 100;
		                clipPathValue = `inset(${clipPercent}% 0 0 0)`;
		            }
		
		        if (clipPathValue) {
		            slider.trackFill.style.clipPath = clipPathValue;
		        }
		
		        // Debug: Füll-Ursprung (Übergang) = immer exakt auf dem Thumb (blaues Kreuz)
		        if (slider.fillOriginCross && slider.bounds) {
		            const originSize = crossSize;
		            slider.fillOriginCross.style.width  = originSize + 'px';
		            slider.fillOriginCross.style.height = originSize + 'px';
		            slider.fillOriginCross.style.setProperty(
		                '--line-width',
		                (parseFloat(getComputedStyle(slider.thumbCenterCross)
		                    .getPropertyValue('--line-width')) || 2) + 'px'
		            );
		            slider.fillOriginCross.style.left = (thumbCenterX - originSize / 2) + 'px';
		            slider.fillOriginCross.style.top  = (thumbCenterY - originSize / 2) + 'px';
		        }
		    }

		        // === SCHLANGEN-WERTANZEIGE (0.xxxx mit Wobble) ===
		        // Basis-Längenfunktion: 0..1 → 1..N Zeichen.
		        // N (Anzahl der Schritte/Auflösung) ist einstellbar über params.resolutionSteps.
		        // Die Anzahl der Zeichen selbst wobbel nicht, nur die Y-Position.
		        function getBaseChainLength(norm) {
		            const stepsParam = typeof params.resolutionSteps === 'number' ? params.resolutionSteps : 9;
		            const steps = Math.max(1, Math.round(stepsParam));
		            let raw = Math.round(norm * steps); // 0..steps
		            if (raw < 1) raw = 1;
		            if (raw > steps) raw = steps;
		            return raw;
		        }

		        // Approximierte Schrittweite (Pixel) für ein Zeichen der Schlange (x)
		        let slider1CharStep = null;
		        function getSlider1CharStep() {
		            if (slider1CharStep && slider1CharStep > 0) return slider1CharStep;
		            if (!slider1ValueDisplay) return 12;
		            const probe = document.createElement('span');
		            probe.textContent = 'x';
		            probe.style.visibility = 'hidden';
		            probe.style.position = 'absolute';
		            probe.style.whiteSpace = 'nowrap';
		            slider1ValueDisplay.appendChild(probe);
		            const rect = probe.getBoundingClientRect();
		            slider1CharStep = rect.width || 12;
		            slider1ValueDisplay.removeChild(probe);
		            return slider1CharStep;
		        }
			
		        // Baut die 0.xxxx-Schlange als HTML-Spans, die wie eine 2D-Schlange innerhalb
		        // der Anzeige-Fläche unterwegs ist: Zeichen hängen aneinander, die Textrichtung
		        // kann sich ändern und die Schlange verlässt ihre Ausgangszeile.
		        	function updateSlider1Display(time) {
		            if (!slider1ValueDisplay) return;
		            const norm = typeof slider1.currentValue === 'number' ? slider1.currentValue : 0;
				
		            // Arbeitsfläche ist der gesamte Viewport. Die Schlange wird zwar an den Slider
		            // "angedockt", darf aber weiterhin den ganzen Bildschirm nutzen.
		            const width = window.innerWidth || slider1ValueDisplay.clientWidth || 800;
		            const height = window.innerHeight || slider1ValueDisplay.clientHeight || 120;
		            const edgeMargin = 16; // etwas Luft zum Rand
		            const leftLimit = edgeMargin;
		            const rightLimit = width - edgeMargin;
				
		            // Standard: Mitte des Viewports
		            let centerX = width / 2;
		            let centerY = height / 2;
		            let topLimit = edgeMargin;
		            let bottomLimit = height - edgeMargin;
				
			            // Wenn der Slider bereits gerendert ist, die Schlange direkt unterhalb des
		            // Sliders verankern (Anker 0.xxxx). Der Bewegungsbereich bleibt aber der ganze
		            // Screen, damit die Schlange weiterhin überall herumwandern kann.
		            if (slider1 && slider1.container) {
		                const rect = slider1.container.getBoundingClientRect();
		                const sliderCenterX = rect.left + rect.width / 2;
		                let desiredY = rect.bottom + 32; // Abstand unter dem Slider
				
		                // Im Viewport klemmen, damit sie nicht aus dem Screen läuft
		                const minY = edgeMargin * 2;
		                const maxY = height - edgeMargin * 2;
		                if (height > 0) {
		                    desiredY = Math.max(minY, Math.min(maxY, desiredY));
		                }
				
		                centerX = sliderCenterX;
		                centerY = desiredY;
		            }
				
		            // Horizontale Mitte ebenfalls innerhalb der sichtbaren Breite halten
		            centerX = Math.max(leftLimit, Math.min(rightLimit, centerX));
				
		            const step = getSlider1CharStep();
				
		            // Exakte Enden: 0 und 1, zentriert im aktuellen Schlange-Anker (unter dem Slider)
		            if (norm <= 0) {
		                slider1ValueDisplay.innerHTML = `
		                    <div class="slider-value-display-inner">
		                        <span class="anchor" style="left:${centerX}px; top:${centerY}px; transform:translate(-50%, -50%);">0</span>
		                    </div>
		                `;
		                return;
		            }
		            if (norm >= 1) {
		                slider1ValueDisplay.innerHTML = `
		                    <div class="slider-value-display-inner">
		                        <span class="anchor" style="left:${centerX}px; top:${centerY}px; transform:translate(-50%, -50%);">1</span>
		                    </div>
		                `;
		                return;
		            }
				
		            const len = getBaseChainLength(norm);
			
		            // --- Physikalisches Wobble ---
		            // Grundidee:
		            // - Im Stand nahezu keine Eigenbewegung.
		            // - Bewegung des Sliders pumpt Energie in das System.
			
		            // Initialisierung der internen Zustände
		            if (typeof slider1._lastNorm !== 'number') {
		                slider1._lastNorm = norm;
		                slider1._vel = 0;
		                slider1._energy = 0;
		                slider1._phaseJitter = 0;
		            }
			
		            // Geschwindigkeitsänderung seit letztem Frame
		            const vel = norm - slider1._lastNorm;
		            slider1._lastNorm = norm;
			
		            // Instant-Energie aus aktueller Geschwindigkeitsänderung
		            const instantEnergy = Math.min(1, Math.abs(vel) * 400);
			
		            // Energie langsam auf- und abbauen (Dämpfung)
		            const energyDecay = 0.9;
		            slider1._energy = (slider1._energy || 0) * energyDecay + instantEnergy;
		            if (slider1.isDragging) {
		                slider1._energy = Math.min(1, slider1._energy + 0.02);
		            }
		            const energy = slider1._energy;
			
		            // Leichte zufällige Phase, abhängig von der Energie (mehr Chaos bei mehr Input)
		            slider1._phaseJitter = (slider1._phaseJitter || 0) * 0.9
		                + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5 * energy;
			
		            // Amplitude: praktisch 0 bei keiner Energie, kräftig bei viel Energie.
		            // Richtung 1 (norm hoch) verstärkt zusätzlich.
		            const maxAmp = 16; // maximale Amplitude in px
		            const amp = maxAmp * energy * (0.3 + norm * 0.7);
			
		            const baseSpeed = 0.004;
		            const extraSpeed = 0.018 * energy;
		            const speed = baseSpeed + extraSpeed;
		            const t = (typeof time === 'number' ? time : performance.now()) * speed;
			
		            // Zeichenkette: erst der Punkt, dann len-mal 'x'
		            const chars = ['.'];
		            for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) chars.push('x');
			
		            // 2D-Schlangenpfad: wir starten an der 0 in der Mitte und laufen in einem
		            // Winkel los. Der Winkel wird über Zeit und Energie leicht verbogen
		            // und an den Rändern reflektiert (wie ein Lichtstrahl).
		            const positions = [];
		            let angle = 0; // 0rad = nach rechts
		            let x = centerX;
		            let y = centerY;
		            for (let i = 0; i < chars.length; i++) {
		                const idx = i; // 0 = Punkt, 1..len = x-Segmente
		                const ratio = len <= 1 ? 1 : Math.max(0, (idx - 1)) / Math.max(1, len - 1);
		                const bendStrength = 0.4 + 0.8 * energy; // wie stark die Schlange abknicken darf
		                const localNoise = Math.sin(t + idx * 0.5 + slider1._phaseJitter * 2.0);
		                angle += localNoise * bendStrength * 0.3; // kleine Krümmel in den Winkel
				
		                let dx = Math.cos(angle);
		                let dy = Math.sin(angle);
		                let nx = x + dx * step;
		                let ny = y + dy * step;
				
		                // Reflektion an allen vier Rändern der Arbeitsfläche
		                let reflected = false;
		                if (nx < leftLimit || nx > rightLimit) {
		                    dx = -dx;
		                    reflected = true;
		                }
		                if (ny < topLimit || ny > bottomLimit) {
		                    dy = -dy;
		                    reflected = true;
		                }
		                if (reflected) {
		                    nx = x + dx * step;
		                    ny = y + dy * step;
		                    angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
		                }
				
		                positions.push({ x: nx, y: ny, ch: chars[i], angle });
		                x = nx;
		                y = ny;
		            }
			
		            // HTML aufbauen: Anker "0" bleibt im Zentrum, die Kette folgt dem 2D-Pfad und
		            // reagiert zusätzlich auf Maus/Touch (Schlange wird in einem Radius weggedrückt).
		            let chainHtml = '';
		            for (let i = 0; i < positions.length; i++) {
		                const p = positions[i];
		                const isX = p.ch === 'x';
		                let extraWobble = 0;
		                if (isX) {
		                    const segIndex = i - 1;
		                    const ratio = len <= 1 ? 1 : segIndex / Math.max(1, len - 1);
		                    const stiffness = 0.3 + ratio * 0.7;
		                    const phase = segIndex * 0.6 + slider1._phaseJitter * (0.3 + ratio);
		                    extraWobble = Math.sin(t + phase) * amp * stiffness;
		                }

		                // Pointer-Einfluss: in der Nähe von Maus/Touch wird die Schlange leicht weggedrückt.
		                let offsetX = 0;
		                let offsetY = extraWobble;
		                if (snakePointer && snakePointer.active) {
		                    const dxp = p.x - snakePointer.x;
		                    const dyp = p.y - snakePointer.y;
		                    const dist = Math.hypot(dxp, dyp) || 1e-6;
		                    const influenceRadius = Math.min(width, height) * 0.25;
		                    if (dist < influenceRadius) {
		                        const strength = 1 - dist / influenceRadius; // 0..1
		                        const basePush = 40; // in px
		                        const push = basePush * strength * (0.3 + energy * 0.7);
		                        offsetX += (dxp / dist) * push;
		                        offsetY += (dyp / dist) * push;
		                    }
		                }

		                const angleDeg = (p.angle * 180) / Math.PI;
		                chainHtml += `
		                    <span class="seg" style="left:${p.x.toFixed(1)}px; top:${p.y.toFixed(1)}px; transform:translate(-50%, -50%) translate(${offsetX.toFixed(2)}px, ${offsetY.toFixed(2)}px) rotate(${angleDeg.toFixed(1)}deg);">${p.ch}</span>
		                `;
		            }
			
		            const html = `
		                <div class="slider-value-display-inner">
		                    <span class="anchor" style="left:${centerX}px; top:${centerY}px; transform:translate(-50%, -50%);">0</span>
		                    ${chainHtml}
		                </div>
		            `;
			
		            slider1ValueDisplay.innerHTML = html;
		        }

		    function animationLoop(time) {
		        // Bis wir eine textbasierte Shader-Variante haben, immer die DOM-Variante
		        // der 0.xxxx-Schlange verwenden.
		        updateSlider1Display(time);
		        requestAnimationFrame(animationLoop);
		    }

		    // === STEPPER BUTTONS mit Hold-Repeat (angepasst von shadows.html) ===
			    document.querySelectorAll('.stepper-btn').forEach(btn => {
			        const paramKey = btn.dataset.param;
			        const cfg = PARAMS_CONFIG[paramKey];
			        if (!cfg) return;
			
			        const stepOnce = (isPlus) => {
			            const direction = isPlus ? 1 : -1;
			            const current = typeof params[paramKey] === 'number' ? params[paramKey] : cfg.default;
			            let newVal = current + direction * cfg.step;
			
			            // Rotation Wraparound
			            if (paramKey === 'rotation') {
			                newVal = ((newVal % 360) + 360) % 360;
			            } else {
			                newVal = Math.max(cfg.min, Math.min(cfg.max, newVal));
			            }
			
			            // Rundung
			            const factor = Math.pow(10, cfg.decimals);
			            newVal = Math.round(newVal * factor) / factor;
			
			            params[paramKey] = newVal;
			            const inputEl = document.getElementById(cfg.id);
			            if (inputEl) inputEl.value = newVal;
			            updateStyles();
			            if (paramKey === 'rotation') {
			                updateVerticalToggleUI();
			            }
			        };
			
			        let holdInterval = null;
			        let holdTimeout = null;
			
			        const stopHold = () => {
			            if (holdTimeout) {
			                clearTimeout(holdTimeout);
			                holdTimeout = null;
			            }
			            if (holdInterval) {
			                clearInterval(holdInterval);
			                holdInterval = null;
			            }
			        };
			
			        // Pointer-Events: funktionieren ffcr Maus & Touch, inkl. "gedr�88ckt halten"
			        btn.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
			            e.preventDefault();
			            const isPlus = btn.classList.contains('plus');
			            stepOnce(isPlus);
			            // Nach kurzer Verz�88gerung startet Repeat
			            holdTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
			                holdInterval = setInterval(() => stepOnce(isPlus), 80);
			            }, 400);
			        });
			
			        btn.addEventListener('pointerup', stopHold);
			        btn.addEventListener('pointerleave', stopHold);
			        btn.addEventListener('pointercancel', stopHold);
			    });

		    // === INPUT FIELDS (in Echtzeit anwenden) ===
		    document.querySelectorAll('.value-input').forEach(input => {
		        const paramKey = input.dataset.param;
		        const cfg = PARAMS_CONFIG[paramKey];
		        if (!cfg) return;
		
		        input.addEventListener('input', () => {
		            let val = parseFloat(input.value.replace(',', '.'));
		            if (isNaN(val)) val = cfg.default;
		
		            // Rotation Wraparound
		            if (paramKey === 'rotation') {
		                val = ((val % 360) + 360) % 360;
		            } else {
		                val = Math.max(cfg.min, Math.min(cfg.max, val));
		            }
		
		            params[paramKey] = val;
		            input.value = val;
		            updateStyles();
		            if (paramKey === 'rotation') {
		                updateVerticalToggleUI();
		            }
		        });
		    });

		        // Spezielles Eingabefeld f�fcr x (Slider-Wert 0..1) wurde aus dem UI entfernt.
		        // Falls es sp�ter wieder gebraucht wird, kann hier die Live-Verkn�pfung reaktiviert werden.

        // Font-Select
        fontSelect.addEventListener('change', updateStyles);

        // Track/Thumb Character Inputs
        trackCharInput.addEventListener('input', () => {
            slider1.trackChar = trackCharInput.value || '1';
            updateStyles();
        });

        thumbCharInput.addEventListener('input', () => {
            slider1.thumbChar = thumbCharInput.value || '0';
            updateStyles();
        });

        // === SLIDER THUMB DRAG (einfach mit mousedown/mousemove) ===
		        sliders.forEach(slider => {
		            slider.thumb.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
                slider.isDragging = true;
                slider.dragStartPos = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY };
	                const range = getSliderRange(slider);
	                const currentVal = (typeof slider.value === 'number')
	                    ? slider.value
	                    : (range.min + range.max) / 2;
	                slider.dragStartValue = currentVal; // logischer Wert
	                slider.dragStartNorm = slider.currentValue ?? valueToNormalized(slider, currentVal);
                e.preventDefault();
            });

	            // Touch-Drag auf dem Thumb (Mobil)
	            slider.thumb.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
	                const t = e.touches && e.touches[0];
	                if (!t) return;
	                slider.isDragging = true;
	                slider.dragStartPos = { x: t.clientX, y: t.clientY };
	                const range = getSliderRange(slider);
	                const currentVal = (typeof slider.value === 'number')
	                    ? slider.value
	                    : (range.min + range.max) / 2;
	                slider.dragStartValue = currentVal; // logischer Wert
	                slider.dragStartNorm = slider.currentValue ?? valueToNormalized(slider, currentVal);
	                e.preventDefault();
	            }, { passive: false });

		            // Klick auf die Bahn / den Container: Wert wie beim HTML-Slider setzen
		            // und direkt in einen Drag übergehen
			            slider.container.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
			                // Wenn direkt auf dem Thumb geklickt wurde, übernimmt der Thumb-Handler
			                if (e.target === slider.thumb) return;
			                if (!slider.bounds) return;
			
			                const rect = slider.container.getBoundingClientRect();
			                const px = e.clientX - rect.left;  // Position im Container-Koordinatensystem
			                const py = e.clientY - rect.top;
			
			                // Abstand vom Track-Zentrum
			                const dx = px - slider.bounds.centerX;
			                const dy = py - slider.bounds.centerY;
			
			                // Auf die Slider-Achse (rote Linie) projizieren, egal wie rotiert
			                const rotRad = slider.bounds.slideRotation * Math.PI / 180;
			                const proj = dx * Math.cos(rotRad) + dy * Math.sin(rotRad);
				
			                const halfRange = slider.bounds.halfRange;
			                const fullRange = halfRange * 2;
			                if (fullRange <= 0) return;
				
			                // proj liefert eine Geo-Norm (0..1 entlang der Achse). Für den Benutzer
			                // soll 0 links und 1 rechts sein, daher invertieren wir auf userNorm.
			                let geoNorm = 0.5 + (proj / fullRange); // 0..1 entlang der Bahn
			                geoNorm = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, geoNorm));
			                const userNorm = 1 - geoNorm;
				
			                const newValue = normalizedToValue(slider, userNorm);
			                setSliderValue(slider, newValue, { fromUser: true });
			
			                // Direktes Drag-Verhalten wie beim nativen Slider:
			                // Wir starten jetzt einen Drag an genau dieser Position.
			                slider.isDragging = true;
			                slider.dragStartPos = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY };
			                slider.dragStartValue = newValue;
			                slider.dragStartNorm = slider.currentValue ?? userNorm;
			
			                e.preventDefault();
			            });

		            // Touch auf Bahn/Container: wie Maus-Klick plus anschließender Drag
		            slider.container.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
		                const t = e.touches && e.touches[0];
		                if (!t) return;
		                if (t.target === slider.thumb) return;
		                if (!slider.bounds) return;
		
		                const rect = slider.container.getBoundingClientRect();
		                const px = t.clientX - rect.left;
		                const py = t.clientY - rect.top;
		
		                const dx = px - slider.bounds.centerX;
		                const dy = py - slider.bounds.centerY;
		                const rotRad = slider.bounds.slideRotation * Math.PI / 180;
		                const proj = dx * Math.cos(rotRad) + dy * Math.sin(rotRad);
		                const halfRange = slider.bounds.halfRange;
		                const fullRange = halfRange * 2;
		                if (fullRange <= 0) return;
		
		                let geoNorm = 0.5 + (proj / fullRange);
		                geoNorm = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, geoNorm));
		                const userNorm = 1 - geoNorm;
		                const newValue = normalizedToValue(slider, userNorm);
		                setSliderValue(slider, newValue, { fromUser: true });
		
		                slider.isDragging = true;
		                slider.dragStartPos = { x: t.clientX, y: t.clientY };
		                slider.dragStartValue = newValue;
		                slider.dragStartNorm = slider.currentValue ?? userNorm;
		
		                e.preventDefault();
		            }, { passive: false });
        });

        document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
            sliders.forEach(slider => {
                if (!slider.isDragging || !slider.dragStartPos) return;
                if (!slider.bounds) return;

                const dx = e.clientX - slider.dragStartPos.x;
                const dy = e.clientY - slider.dragStartPos.y;

                const slideRot = slider.bounds.slideRotation;
                const rotRad = slideRot * Math.PI / 180;
	
		                const movement = dx * Math.cos(rotRad) + dy * Math.sin(rotRad);
		                const fullRange = slider.bounds.halfRange * 2;
		                const deltaGeo = fullRange > 0 ? movement / fullRange : 0;
		
		                // dragStartNorm und currentValue speichern die Benutzer-Norm (0 = links, 1 = rechts).
		                // Die Geometrie-Norm l�ufuht umgekehrt, daher �e4ndert sich User-Norm mit -deltaGeo.
		                const startUserNorm = typeof slider.dragStartNorm === 'number'
		                    ? slider.dragStartNorm
		                    : (slider.currentValue ?? 0.5);
		                const newUserNorm = startUserNorm - deltaGeo;
		                const newValue = normalizedToValue(slider, newUserNorm);
		
		                setSliderValue(slider, newValue, { fromUser: true });
            });
        });

	        // Touch-Move: gleiche Logik wie Mouse-Move, nur mit Touch-Koordinaten
	        document.addEventListener('touchmove', (e) => {
	            const t = e.touches && e.touches[0];
	            if (!t) return;
	            sliders.forEach(slider => {
	                if (!slider.isDragging || !slider.dragStartPos) return;
	                if (!slider.bounds) return;
	
	                const dx = t.clientX - slider.dragStartPos.x;
	                const dy = t.clientY - slider.dragStartPos.y;
	                const slideRot = slider.bounds.slideRotation;
	                const rotRad = slideRot * Math.PI / 180;
	                const movement = dx * Math.cos(rotRad) + dy * Math.sin(rotRad);
	                const fullRange = slider.bounds.halfRange * 2;
	                const deltaGeo = fullRange > 0 ? movement / fullRange : 0;
	
	                const startUserNorm = typeof slider.dragStartNorm === 'number'
	                    ? slider.dragStartNorm
	                    : (slider.currentValue ?? 0.5);
	                const newUserNorm = startUserNorm - deltaGeo;
	                const newValue = normalizedToValue(slider, newUserNorm);
	                setSliderValue(slider, newValue, { fromUser: true });
	            });
	            e.preventDefault();
	        }, { passive: false });

        document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
            sliders.forEach(slider => {
                slider.isDragging = false;
                slider.dragStartPos = null;
            });
        });

	        document.addEventListener('touchend', () => {
	            sliders.forEach(slider => {
	                slider.isDragging = false;
	                slider.dragStartPos = null;
	            });
	        });

	        document.addEventListener('touchcancel', () => {
	            sliders.forEach(slider => {
	                slider.isDragging = false;
	                slider.dragStartPos = null;
	            });
	        });

	        // === GLOBALE MAUS-/TOUCH-EINGABE FÜR DIE SCHLANGE ===
	        function updateSnakePointerFromEvent(clientX, clientY, active) {
	            if (!snakePointer) return;
	            snakePointer.active = active;
	            snakePointer.x = clientX;
	            snakePointer.y = clientY;
	            if (active) {
	                // Ein bisschen Energie in die Schlange pumpen, auch wenn der Slider stillsteht
	                slider1._energy = Math.min(1, (slider1._energy || 0) + 0.03);
	            }
	        }

	        // Maus-Ereignisse: bewegen und klicken lassen die Schlange reagieren
	        window.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
	            updateSnakePointerFromEvent(e.clientX, e.clientY, true);
	        });

	        window.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
	            updateSnakePointerFromEvent(e.clientX, e.clientY, true);
	        });

	        window.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
	            if (!snakePointer) return;
	            snakePointer.active = false;
	        });

	        window.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
	            if (!snakePointer) return;
	            snakePointer.active = false;
	        });

	        // Touch-Ereignisse: volle Mobil-Unterstützung
	        window.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
	            const t = e.touches && e.touches[0];
	            if (!t) return;
	            updateSnakePointerFromEvent(t.clientX, t.clientY, true);
	        }, { passive: true });

	        window.addEventListener('touchmove', (e) => {
	            const t = e.touches && e.touches[0];
	            if (!t) return;
	            updateSnakePointerFromEvent(t.clientX, t.clientY, true);
	        }, { passive: true });

	        window.addEventListener('touchend', () => {
	            if (!snakePointer) return;
	            snakePointer.active = false;
	        });

	        window.addEventListener('touchcancel', () => {
	            if (!snakePointer) return;
	            snakePointer.active = false;
	        });

		        // === UPDATE STYLES ===
		        function updateStyles() {
		            // Basis: Slider neu rendern und Debug-Klasse passend zum Zustand setzen
		            sliders.forEach(slider => {
		                renderSliderImages(slider);
		                slider.container.classList.toggle('debug-mode', isDebugMode);
		            });
		
		            // Debug-Geometrie nur berechnen, wenn Debug an ist
		            if (!isDebugMode) return;
		
		            const lineW = params.debugLineWidth;
		            const crossSize = 20 + lineW * 2;
		
		            sliders.forEach(slider => {
		                // Debug: Track-Fadenkreuz positionieren (im Track-Zentrum)
		                slider.trackCenterCross.style.width = crossSize + 'px';
		                slider.trackCenterCross.style.height = crossSize + 'px';
		                slider.trackCenterCross.style.left = (slider.bounds.centerX - crossSize / 2) + 'px';
		                slider.trackCenterCross.style.top = (slider.bounds.centerY - crossSize / 2) + 'px';
		                slider.trackCenterCross.style.setProperty('--line-width', lineW + 'px');
		
		                // Debug: Thumb-Fadenkreuz Linienstärke
		                slider.thumbCenterCross.style.width = crossSize + 'px';
		                slider.thumbCenterCross.style.height = crossSize + 'px';
		                slider.thumbCenterCross.style.setProperty('--line-width', lineW + 'px');
		
		                // Debug-Linie aktualisieren - volle Track-Länge
		                const slideRot = slider.bounds.slideRotation;
		                const lineLength = slider.bounds.trackLength;
		                slider.debugLine.style.width = lineLength + 'px';
		                slider.debugLine.style.height = lineW + 'px';
		                slider.debugLine.style.left = (slider.bounds.centerX - lineLength / 2) + 'px';
		                slider.debugLine.style.top = (slider.bounds.centerY - lineW / 2) + 'px';
		                slider.debugLine.style.transform = `rotate(${slideRot}deg)`;
		            });
		        }
		
		        // Debug Toggle Event
		        debugToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
		            isDebugMode = !isDebugMode;
		            debugToggle.textContent = isDebugMode ? 'An' : 'Aus';
		            debugToggle.classList.toggle('active', isDebugMode);
		            debugToggle.setAttribute('aria-pressed', isDebugMode ? 'true' : 'false');
		            updateStyles();
		        });

		        // Toggle Event: zwischen Breite (0°) und Länge (90°) umschalten
		        verticalToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
		            const currentlyVertical = isVerticalMode();
		            // Breite-Modus  -> Rotation = 0°
		            // Länge-Modus   -> Rotation = 90°
		            const newRotation = currentlyVertical ? 0 : 90;
		            params.rotation = newRotation;
		            const rotCfg = PARAMS_CONFIG.rotation;
		            const rotInput = document.getElementById(rotCfg.id);
		            if (rotInput) rotInput.value = newRotation;
		
		            updateStyles();
		            updateVerticalToggleUI();
		        });

		        // Init: Input-Felder mit Defaults füllen
		        Object.entries(PARAMS_CONFIG).forEach(([key, cfg]) => {
		            const el = document.getElementById(cfg.id);
			            if (el) el.value = params[key];
		        });
			
			        updateStyles();
			        updateVerticalToggleUI();
			        // Start der kontinuierlichen Anzeige-Animation für den Slider-Wert (0.xxxx mit Wobble)
			        requestAnimationFrame(animationLoop);

        // === DRAGGABLE SETTINGS PANEL (nur über Header) ===
	    const settingsPanel = document.getElementById('settingsPanel');
	    const dragHandle = document.querySelector('.settings-header');
	    const settingsBody = document.querySelector('.settings-body');
	    let isPanelDragging = false;
	    let panelDragStart = { x: 0, y: 0 };
	    let panelStartPos = { x: 0, y: 0 };

	    function updateSettingsBodyHeight() {
	        if (!settingsPanel || !settingsBody) return;
	        const rect = settingsPanel.getBoundingClientRect();
	        const headerHeight = (dragHandle && dragHandle.offsetHeight) || 40;
	        const availableHeight = window.innerHeight - rect.top - headerHeight - 8;
	        if (availableHeight > 0) {
	            settingsBody.style.maxHeight = availableHeight + 'px';
	        }
	    }

	    dragHandle.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
	        isPanelDragging = true;
	        settingsPanel.classList.add('dragging');

	        const rect = settingsPanel.getBoundingClientRect();
	        panelDragStart = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY };
	        panelStartPos = { x: rect.left, y: rect.top };

	        // Transform entfernen für absolute Positionierung
	        settingsPanel.style.transform = 'none';
	        settingsPanel.style.left = rect.left + 'px';
	        settingsPanel.style.top = rect.top + 'px';

	        e.preventDefault();
	    });

	    document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
	        if (!isPanelDragging) return;

	        const dx = e.clientX - panelDragStart.x;
	        const dy = e.clientY - panelDragStart.y;
	        let newLeft = panelStartPos.x + dx;
	        let newTop = panelStartPos.y + dy;

	        // Begrenzen:
	        // - horizontal komplett im Viewport lassen
	        // - vertikal: Panel immer voll im Viewport halten,
	        //   Hhe dynamisch begrenzen und innen scrollen
	        const maxLeft = Math.max(0, window.innerWidth - settingsPanel.offsetWidth);
	        const minLeft = 0;
	        newLeft = Math.max(minLeft, Math.min(maxLeft, newLeft));

	        const minTop = 0; // nicht nach oben raus
	        const headerHeight = (dragHandle && dragHandle.offsetHeight) || 40;
	        const maxTop = Math.max(0, window.innerHeight - headerHeight - 8);
	        newTop = Math.max(minTop, Math.min(maxTop, newTop));

	        // Sichtbare H6he des scrollbaren Inhalts anpassen,
	        // damit der Inhalt scrollbar bleibt, wenn wenig Platz ist
	        const availableHeight = window.innerHeight - newTop - headerHeight - 8;
	        if (settingsBody && availableHeight > 0) {
	            settingsBody.style.maxHeight = availableHeight + 'px';
	        }

	        settingsPanel.style.left = newLeft + 'px';
	        settingsPanel.style.top = newTop + 'px';
	    });

	    // Initial & bei Resize: H�0fhe des scrollbaren Bereichs anpassen
	    updateSettingsBodyHeight();
	    window.addEventListener('resize', updateSettingsBodyHeight);

		    document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
		        if (isPanelDragging) {
		            isPanelDragging = false;
		            settingsPanel.classList.remove('dragging');
		        }
		    });

		    // Mobile: Bottom-Sheet-Verhalten wie in shadows (Header als Griff)
		    if (settingsPanel && dragHandle) {
		        let isPanelTouchDragging = false;
		        let panelTouchStartY = 0;
		        let currentPanelY = 0; // 0 = voll offen, max = eingeklappt
		        const MOBILE_HANDLE_HEIGHT = 56;
		        const isMobileLayout = () => window.innerWidth <= 768;
		        const slidersArea = document.querySelector('.sliders-area');
		        const MAX_SLIDER_OFFSET_VH = 12; // wie weit die Sliders Area maximal nach oben schiebt
		
		        const getPanelMaxY = () => {
		            const fullHeight = settingsPanel.offsetHeight || 0;
		            return Math.max(0, fullHeight - MOBILE_HANDLE_HEIGHT);
		        };
		
		        const clampPanelY = (y) => {
		            const maxY = getPanelMaxY();
		            return Math.max(0, Math.min(maxY, y));
		        };
		
		        const updateSlidersAreaPosition = (panelY, animate = false) => {
		            if (!slidersArea || !isMobileLayout()) return;
		            const maxY = getPanelMaxY();
		            const openRatio = maxY > 0 ? 1 - (panelY / maxY) : 1; // 0 = zu, 1 = voll offen
		            const offsetVh = openRatio * MAX_SLIDER_OFFSET_VH;
		            slidersArea.style.transition = animate ? 'transform 0.25s ease-out' : 'none';
		            // Basis ist -55% (wie im CSS), bei offen weiter nach oben schieben
		            slidersArea.style.transform = `translate(-50%, calc(-55% - ${offsetVh}vh))`;
		        };
		
		        const setPanelPositionMobile = (y, animate = false) => {
		            if (!isMobileLayout()) return;
		            currentPanelY = clampPanelY(y);
		            settingsPanel.style.transition = animate ? 'transform 0.25s ease-out' : 'none';
		            settingsPanel.style.transform = `translateY(${currentPanelY}px)`;
		            updateSlidersAreaPosition(currentPanelY, animate);
		        };
		
		        const initMobilePanelPosition = () => {
		            if (!isMobileLayout()) {
		                // Desktop: Positionen zur�fccksetzen
		                settingsPanel.style.transition = '';
		                settingsPanel.style.transform = '';
		                if (slidersArea) {
		                    slidersArea.style.transition = '';
		                    slidersArea.style.transform = '';
		                }
		                return;
		            }
		            // Auf Mobile ggf. CSS-max-height wieder freigeben; Medien-Query steuert das
		            if (settingsBody) {
		                settingsBody.style.maxHeight = '';
		            }
		            const maxY = getPanelMaxY();
		            currentPanelY = maxY;
		            settingsPanel.style.transform = `translateY(${currentPanelY}px)`;
		            updateSlidersAreaPosition(currentPanelY, false);
		        };
		
		        // Startzustand + Re-Init bei Orientation- / Gr�f6�dfenwechsel
		        initMobilePanelPosition();
		        window.addEventListener('resize', initMobilePanelPosition);
		
		        // Tap auf Header toggelt Stufen: closed �f0 half �f0 full �f0 closed
		        dragHandle.addEventListener('click', () => {
		            if (!isMobileLayout()) return;
		            const maxY = getPanelMaxY();
		            const halfY = maxY * 0.5;
		
		            if (currentPanelY > halfY) {
		                // Von closed �f0 half open
		                setPanelPositionMobile(halfY, true);
		            } else if (currentPanelY > 10) {
		                // Von half �f0 full open
		                setPanelPositionMobile(0, true);
		            } else {
		                // Von full �f0 closed
		                setPanelPositionMobile(maxY, true);
		            }
		        });
		
		        // Touch-Drag f�fcr stufenloses Schieben
		        dragHandle.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
		            if (!isMobileLayout()) return;
		            isPanelTouchDragging = false;
		            panelTouchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
		            settingsPanel.style.transition = 'none';
		        }, { passive: true });
		
		        dragHandle.addEventListener('touchmove', (e) => {
		            if (!isMobileLayout()) return;
		            isPanelTouchDragging = true;
		            const deltaY = e.touches[0].clientY - panelTouchStartY;
		            const newY = currentPanelY + deltaY;
		            const clampedY = clampPanelY(newY);
		            settingsPanel.style.transform = `translateY(${clampedY}px)`;
		            updateSlidersAreaPosition(clampedY, false);
		        }, { passive: true });
		
		        dragHandle.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
		            if (!isMobileLayout()) return;
		            if (isPanelTouchDragging) {
		                const endY = e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
		                const deltaY = endY - panelTouchStartY;
		                currentPanelY = clampPanelY(currentPanelY + deltaY);
		                settingsPanel.style.transform = `translateY(${currentPanelY}px)`;
		                updateSlidersAreaPosition(currentPanelY, false);
		            }
		            isPanelTouchDragging = false;
		        });
		    }
	    </script>

/* =====================================================================
   Stapel-Rendering: Wirbelsäule + Panel
   ===================================================================== */
function kraftScopeIds() {
  /* Bausteine im Feld der ausgewählten Kraft = alle darunter */
  const i = stack.findIndex(b => b.id === selectedId);
  if (i < 0 || stack[i].kind !== 'kraft') return new Set();
  return new Set(stack.slice(i + 1).map(b => b.id));
}

function renderStack() {
  const scope = kraftScopeIds();
  /* Wirbelsäule */
  spineList.innerHTML = '';
  stack.forEach(b => {
    const v = document.createElement('button');
    v.className = 'vertebra ' + b.kind
      + (b.id === selectedId ? ' selected' : '')
      + (b.vis ? '' : ' hidden-block');
    v.textContent = b.ico;
    v.title = KIND_LABEL[b.kind] + ' — ' + b.name;
    v.setAttribute('aria-label', v.title);
    v.dataset.id = b.id;
    v.addEventListener('click', e => { e.stopPropagation(); openStack(); selectBlock(b.id); });
    spineList.appendChild(v);
  });
  /* Panel-Liste */
  stackList.innerHTML = '';
  stack.forEach((b, i) => {
    const li = document.createElement('li');
    li.className = 'row k-' + b.kind
      + (b.id === selectedId ? ' selected' : '')
      + (b.vis ? '' : ' hidden-block')
      + (scope.has(b.id) ? ' in-scope' : '');
    li.dataset.id = b.id;
    li.innerHTML =
      '<span class="grip" title="Ziehen zum Umsortieren">⠿</span>' +
      '<span class="r-ico">' + b.ico + '</span>' +
      '<span class="r-label"><span class="r-kind">' + KIND_LABEL[b.kind] + '</span>' +
      '<span class="r-name">' + b.name + '</span></span>' +
      '<button class="r-act act-eye" title="' + (b.vis ? 'Ausblenden' : 'Einblenden') + '">' + (b.vis ? '◉' : '○') + '</button>' +
      '<button class="r-act act-del" title="Löschen">✕</button>';
    li.addEventListener('click', () => selectBlock(b.id));
    li.querySelector('.act-eye').addEventListener('click', e => { e.stopPropagation(); toggleVis(b.id); });
    li.querySelector('.act-del').addEventListener('click', e => { e.stopPropagation(); deleteBlock(b.id); });
    stackList.appendChild(li);
  });
  stackPanel.classList.toggle('kraft-selected', scope.size > 0);
  $('m-stack-n').textContent = stack.length;
}

function toggleVis(id) {
  const b = stack.find(x => x.id === id);
  if (!b) return;
  b.vis = !b.vis;
  if (b.layer && scene[b.layer]) scene[b.layer].on = b.vis;
  renderStack();
}

let lastDeleted = null;
function deleteBlock(id) {
  const i = stack.findIndex(x => x.id === id);
  if (i < 0) return;
  const [b] = stack.splice(i, 1);
  lastDeleted = { block: b, index: i };
  if (b.layer && scene[b.layer]) scene[b.layer].on = false;
  if (selectedId === id) deselect();
  renderStack();
  showToast(b.name + ' entfernt', true);
}
$('toast-undo').addEventListener('click', () => {
  if (!lastDeleted) return;
  stack.splice(lastDeleted.index, 0, lastDeleted.block);
  const b = lastDeleted.block;
  if (b.layer && scene[b.layer]) scene[b.layer].on = b.vis;
  lastDeleted = null;
  renderStack();
  hideToast();
});

/* ---------- Stapel öffnen/schließen ---------- */
function openStack() { stackPanel.classList.add('open'); }
function closeStack() { stackPanel.classList.remove('open'); }
$('spine-hint');
document.getElementById('spine').addEventListener('click', e => {
  if (e.target.id !== 'spine-add') openStack();
});
$('stack-close').addEventListener('click', closeStack);
$('m-stack-pill').addEventListener('click', () => {
  stackPanel.classList.contains('open') ? closeStack() : (closeLibrary(), closeDockMobile(), openStack());
});

function closeDockMobile() {
  if (window.matchMedia('(max-width: 720px)').matches) closeDock();
}

/* =====================================================================
   Auswahl: Rahmen + Chip + Regie-Dock
   ===================================================================== */
function selectBlock(id) {
  selectedId = id;
  markWorked();
  renderStack();
  renderDock();
  openDock();
  if (window.matchMedia('(max-width: 720px)').matches) closeStack();
}

function deselect() {
  selectedId = null;
  renderStack();
  closeDock();
  chip.classList.remove('show');
  selframe.classList.remove('show');
}

function openDock() { dock.classList.add('open'); document.body.classList.add('dock-open'); dockOpen = true; }
function closeDock() { dock.classList.remove('open'); document.body.classList.remove('dock-open'); dockOpen = false; }

function renderDock() {
  const b = stack.find(x => x.id === selectedId);
  if (!b) return;
  const i = stack.indexOf(b);
  $('dock-ico').textContent = b.ico;
  $('dock-name').textContent = b.name;
  let meta = KIND_LABEL[b.kind] + ' · ' + (i + 1) + ' von ' + stack.length;
  if (b.kind === 'kraft') {
    const n = stack.length - i - 1;
    meta = 'Kraft · wirkt auf ' + n + ' Baustein' + (n === 1 ? '' : 'e') + ' darunter <span class="down">↓</span>';
  } else {
    const above = stack.slice(0, i).filter(x => x.kind === 'kraft' && x.vis).map(x => x.name);
    if (above.length) meta += ' · im Feld von: ' + above.join(', ');
  }
  $('dock-meta').innerHTML = meta;
  /* Chip */
  $('chip-ico').textContent = b.ico;
  $('chip-name').textContent = b.name;
  $('chip-kind').textContent = KIND_LABEL[b.kind];
  /* Regler-Zeilen (Optik controls.js) */
  const rows = $('ctrl-rows');
  rows.innerHTML = '';
  (PROPS[b.id] || PROPS.generic).forEach(p => {
    const row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = 'ctrl-row';
    if (p.t === 'select') {
      row.innerHTML = '<span class="ctrl-label">' + p.label + '</span>' +
        '<button class="ctrl-select"><span>' + p.val + '</span><span class="caret"></span></button>';
    } else {
      row.innerHTML = '<span class="ctrl-label">' + p.label + '</span>' +
        '<span class="ctrl-group">' +
        '<button class="ctrl-step" aria-label="weniger">−</button>' +
        '<input class="ctrl-range" type="range" min="' + p.min + '" max="' + p.max + '" step="' + (p.step || 1) + '" value="' + p.val + '">' +
        '<button class="ctrl-step" aria-label="mehr">+</button>' +
        '<span class="ctrl-val">' + p.val + '</span></span>';
      const input = row.querySelector('input');
      const val = row.querySelector('.ctrl-val');
      const apply = v => {
        val.textContent = (p.step && p.step < 1) ? (+v).toFixed(2).replace(/\.?0+$/, '') : Math.round(v);
        p.val = +v;
        if (p.bind) p.bind(+v);
      };
      input.addEventListener('input', () => apply(input.value));
      const [minus, plus] = row.querySelectorAll('.ctrl-step');
      minus.addEventListener('click', () => { input.value = +input.value - (+(p.step || 1)); apply(input.value); });
      plus.addEventListener('click', () => { input.value = +input.value + (+(p.step || 1)); apply(input.value); });
    }
    rows.appendChild(row);
  });
}

$('chip-regler').addEventListener('click', () => openDock());
$('dock-close').addEventListener('click', deselect);
$('chip-dup').addEventListener('click', () => showToast('Dupliziert — liegt direkt darüber im Stapel'));
$('chip-del').addEventListener('click', () => { if (selectedId) deleteBlock(selectedId); });

/* ---------- Rahmen + Chip folgen dem Objekt ---------- */
function updateSelectionOverlay() {
  const b = stack.find(x => x.id === selectedId);
  const canFrame = b && b.vis && (b.id === 'b3' || b.id === 'b2');
  if (!canFrame) {
    selframe.classList.remove('show');
    if (!b) chip.classList.remove('show');
    else chip.classList.remove('show');
    return;
  }
  const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const cx = r.left + r.width / 2 - scene.cam.x;
  const cy = r.top + r.height / 2 - scene.cam.y;
  let x, y, w, h;
  if (b.id === 'b3') {
    /* echte Hüllbox der Kurve abtasten */
    const s = scene.heart.size * Math.min(r.width, r.height) / 900 * 1.9;
    let x0 = 1e9, y0 = 1e9, x1 = -1e9, y1 = -1e9;
    for (let i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
      const [px, py] = curvePoint((i / 64) * Math.PI * 2, scene.heart.morph, s);
      if (px < x0) x0 = px; if (px > x1) x1 = px;
      if (py < y0) y0 = py; if (py > y1) y1 = py;
    }
    const pad = 14;
    x = cx + scene.heart.x + x0 - pad;
    y = cy + scene.heart.y + y0 - pad;
    w = (x1 - x0) + pad * 2;
    h = (y1 - y0) + pad * 2;
  } else {
    const s = Math.min(r.width, r.height) * scene.symbol.size;
    w = s * 1.72; h = s * 0.94;
    x = cx - w / 2; y = cy - h / 2;
  }
  selframe.style.left = x + 'px';
  selframe.style.top = y + 'px';
  selframe.style.width = w + 'px';
  selframe.style.height = h + 'px';
  selframe.classList.add('show');
  chip.style.left = (x + w / 2) + 'px';
  chip.style.top = Math.max(60, y - 52) + 'px';
  chip.classList.add('show');
}

/* =====================================================================
   Bibliothek
   ===================================================================== */
function buildLibrary() {
  const wrap = $('lib-scroll');
  LIB.forEach(f => {
    const sec = document.createElement('div');
    sec.className = 'fam' + (f.kind === 'kraft' ? ' kraefte' : '');
    sec.innerHTML = '<div class="fam-head"><span class="fam-name">' + f.fam + '</span>' +
      '<span class="fam-desc">' + f.desc + '</span></div>';
    const grid = document.createElement('div');
    grid.className = 'tiles';
    f.items.forEach(item => {
      const t = document.createElement('button');
      t.className = 'tile';
      t.innerHTML = svgWrap(item.svg) + '<span class="tl-name">' + item.name + '</span>' +
        '<span class="tl-sub">' + item.sub + '</span>';
      t.addEventListener('click', () => addFromLibrary(f.kind, item));
      grid.appendChild(t);
    });
    sec.appendChild(grid);
    wrap.appendChild(sec);
  });
}

function addFromLibrary(kind, item) {
  const block = { id: 'n' + (uid++), kind, ico: item.ico, name: item.name, layer: null, vis: true };
  let msg;
  if (kind === 'kraft') {
    stack.unshift(block);
    msg = item.name + ' liegt oben — wirkt ab jetzt auf alles darunter';
  } else {
    /* Neues landet UNTER den Kräften, damit deren Feld es erfasst */
    let i = 0;
    while (i < stack.length && stack[i].kind === 'kraft') i++;
    stack.splice(i, 0, block);
    msg = item.name + ' in den Stapel gelegt — unter den Kräften, in ihrem Feld';
  }
  closeLibrary();
  renderStack();
  selectBlock(block.id);
  showToast(msg);
  const v = spineList.querySelector('[data-id="' + block.id + '"]');
  if (v) { v.classList.add('pulse'); setTimeout(() => v.classList.remove('pulse'), 950); }
}

function openLibrary() {
  closeStack(); closeDockMobile();
  library.classList.add('open');
  libBackdrop.classList.add('show');
  markWorked();
}
function closeLibrary() {
  library.classList.remove('open');
  libBackdrop.classList.remove('show');
}
$('spine-add').addEventListener('click', e => { e.stopPropagation(); openLibrary(); });
$('stack-add').addEventListener('click', e => { e.stopPropagation(); openLibrary(); });
$('m-add-pill').addEventListener('click', openLibrary);
$('lib-close').addEventListener('click', closeLibrary);
libBackdrop.addEventListener('click', closeLibrary);

document.querySelectorAll('.tool').forEach(btn => {
  btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    currentTool = btn.dataset.tool;
    document.querySelectorAll('.tool').forEach(b => b.classList.toggle('active', b === btn));
    stageEl.className = 'tool-' + currentTool;
    markWorked();
    if (currentTool === 'draw') showToast('Zeichnen — ziehe frei über die Leinwand');
