    if (currentTool === 'move') hideToast();
  });
});

/* =====================================================================
   Leinwand-Interaktion
   ===================================================================== */
const strokes = [];
let activeStroke = null;
const ripples = [];
let drag = null;

function canvasPos(e) {
  const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  return { x: e.clientX - r.left, y: e.clientY - r.top };
}

function heartHit(p) {
  const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const cx = r.width / 2 - scene.cam.x + scene.heart.x;
  const cy = r.height / 2 - scene.cam.y + scene.heart.y;
  const s = scene.heart.size * (Math.min(r.width, r.height) / 900) * 1.25;
  return Math.abs(p.x - cx) < s && Math.abs(p.y - cy) < s;
}

canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => {
  const p = canvasPos(e);
  canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
  markWorked();
  if (currentTool === 'draw') {
    activeStroke = [p];
    strokes.push(activeStroke);
  } else if (currentTool === 'warp') {
    drag = { type: 'warp', last: p };
    pulseKraft();
  } else {
    drag = heartHit(p)
      ? { type: 'heart', last: p, moved: 0 }
      : { type: 'pan', last: p, moved: 0 };
  }
});

canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', e => {
  const p = canvasPos(e);
  if (activeStroke) { activeStroke.push(p); return; }
  if (!drag) return;
  const dx = p.x - drag.last.x, dy = p.y - drag.last.y;
  drag.moved = (drag.moved || 0) + Math.abs(dx) + Math.abs(dy);
  if (drag.type === 'heart') { scene.heart.x += dx; scene.heart.y += dy; }
  else if (drag.type === 'pan') { scene.cam.x -= dx; scene.cam.y -= dy; }
  else if (drag.type === 'warp') {
    ripples.push({ x: p.x, y: p.y, born: perf, strength: Math.min(26, Math.hypot(dx, dy) * 1.6) });
    if (ripples.length > 24) ripples.shift();
  }
  drag.last = p;
});

canvas.addEventListener('pointerup', e => {
  const p = canvasPos(e);
  if (activeStroke) {
    if (activeStroke.length > 4) {
      const block = { id: 'n' + (uid++), kind: 'ding', ico: '✎', name: 'Pfad', layer: null, vis: true };
      let i = 0;
      while (i < stack.length && stack[i].kind === 'kraft') i++;
      stack.splice(i, 0, block);
      renderStack();
      showToast('Pfad in den Stapel gelegt');
    } else {
      strokes.pop();
    }
    activeStroke = null;
    return;
  }
  if (drag && drag.moved < 6) {
    /* Klick statt Zug: auswählen / abwählen */
    if (drag.type === 'heart') selectBlock('b3');
    else deselect();
  }
  drag = null;
});

function pulseKraft() {
  const v = spineList.querySelector('[data-id="b5"]');
  if (v) { v.classList.add('pulse'); setTimeout(() => v.classList.remove('pulse'), 950); }
}

let idleTimer = null;
function wake() {
  document.body.classList.remove('idle');
  clearTimeout(idleTimer);
  idleTimer = setTimeout(() => {
    if (!document.body.classList.contains('focus')) document.body.classList.add('idle');
  }, 3500);
}
['pointermove', 'pointerdown', 'keydown', 'touchstart'].forEach(ev =>
  window.addEventListener(ev, wake, { passive: true }));
wake();

let worked = false;
function markWorked() {
  if (worked) return;
  worked = true;
  document.body.classList.add('worked');
}

$('btn-focus').addEventListener('click', e => {
  e.stopPropagation();
  document.body.classList.add('focus');
  deselect();
  closeStack(); closeLibrary();
  showToast('Fokus — nur das Werk. Der Punkt unten rechts führt zurück.');
  setTimeout(hideToast, 2600);
});

window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  if (e.key === 'Escape') { document.body.classList.remove('focus'); closeLibrary(); }
});

/* ---------- Toast ---------- */
let toastTimer = null;
function showToast(msg, withUndo) {
  $('toast-text').textContent = msg;
  $('toast-undo').hidden = !withUndo;
  toast.classList.add('show');
  clearTimeout(toastTimer);
  toastTimer = setTimeout(hideToast, withUndo ? 6000 : 3200);
}
function hideToast() { toast.classList.remove('show'); }

/* =====================================================================
   Lebendige Szene — Canvas 2D
   ===================================================================== */
let W = 0, H = 0, DPR = 1;
function resize() {
  const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  DPR = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
  W = Math.max(1, r.width);
  H = Math.max(1, r.height);
  canvas.width = Math.round(W * DPR);
  canvas.height = Math.round(H * DPR);
  ctx.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);
}
new ResizeObserver(resize).observe(canvas);
resize();

let perf = 0, last = 0;

function warp(x, y, t) {
  let wx = x, wy = y;
  if (scene.warp.on && scene.warp.amp > 0) {
    const a = scene.warp.amp;
    const f = scene.warp.freq * 0.008;
    wx += a * Math.sin(y * f * 2.2 + t * 0.7);
    wy += a * 0.6 * Math.cos(x * f * 2.6 + t * 0.55);
  }
  for (const rp of ripples) {
    const age = perf - rp.born;
    if (age > 1.6) continue;
    const d = Math.hypot(x - rp.x, y - rp.y);
    if (d > 260 || d < 0.5) continue;
    const damp = (1 - age / 1.6) * Math.exp(-d / 130);
    const push = Math.sin(d * 0.05 - age * 6) * rp.strength * damp;
    wx += (x - rp.x) / d * push;
    wy += (y - rp.y) / d * push;
  }
  return [wx, wy];
}

function curvePoint(u, m, s) {
  const hx = 16 * Math.pow(Math.sin(u), 3);
  const hy = -(13 * Math.cos(u) - 5 * Math.cos(2 * u) - 2 * Math.cos(3 * u) - Math.cos(4 * u));
  /* Kreis phasengleich zum Herz (u=0 oben) — Morph bleibt spiegelsymmetrisch */
  const cx2 = 15 * Math.sin(u);
  const cy2 = -15 * Math.cos(u);
  return [((1 - m) * cx2 + m * hx) * s / 16, ((1 - m) * cy2 + m * hy) * s / 16];
}

/* Spawner-Symbole */
const symbols = [];
const GLYPHS = ['∞', '0', '1'];
let spawnAcc = 0;
function spawnSymbol() {
  symbols.push({
    char: GLYPHS[Math.floor(Math.random() * GLYPHS.length)],
    x: W * (0.2 + Math.random() * 0.6),
    y: H * (0.18 + Math.random() * 0.64),
    vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 7,
    vy: -4 - Math.random() * 6,
    born: perf,
    life: 7,
    rot: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.7,
    size: 15 + Math.random() * 16,
  });
  if (symbols.length > 40) symbols.shift();
}

function draw(ms) {
  requestAnimationFrame(draw);
  const dt = Math.min(0.05, (ms - last) / 1000) || 0.016;
  last = ms;
  if (!REDUCED) perf += dt;
  const t = perf * scene.warp.speed;
  const cx = W / 2 - scene.cam.x;
  const cy = H / 2 - scene.cam.y;

  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

  /* dunkle Vignette */
  const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 0, cx, cy, Math.max(W, H) * 0.75);
  grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(18,18,24,0.5)');
  grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = grad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  /* Koordinatengitter */
  if (scene.grid.on && scene.grid.alpha > 0) {
    const sp = scene.grid.spacing;
    const al = scene.grid.alpha;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    const step = 28;
    const ox = ((cx % sp) + sp) % sp, oy = ((cy % sp) + sp) % sp;
    for (let gx = ox - sp; gx <= W + sp; gx += sp) {
      const axis = Math.abs(gx - cx) < 1;
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (axis ? al * 2.6 : al) + ')';
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (let y = -step; y <= H + step; y += step) {
        const [px, py] = warp(gx, y, t);
        (y === -step) ? ctx.moveTo(px, py) : ctx.lineTo(px, py);
      }
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    for (let gy = oy - sp; gy <= H + sp; gy += sp) {
      const axis = Math.abs(gy - cy) < 1;
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (axis ? al * 2.6 : al) + ')';
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (let x = -step; x <= W + step; x += step) {
        const [px, py] = warp(x, gy, t);
        (x === -step) ? ctx.moveTo(px, py) : ctx.lineTo(px, py);
      }
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  /* Symbol ∞ — zwei glühende Kreise */
  if (scene.symbol.on && scene.symbol.alpha > 0) {
    const s = Math.min(W, H) * scene.symbol.size;
    const R = s * 0.42;
    const breathe = 1 + 0.025 * Math.sin(perf * 0.4);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.lineWidth = scene.symbol.width;
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (scene.symbol.alpha * 0.55) + ')';
    ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)';
    ctx.shadowBlur = scene.symbol.glow;
    [-1, 1].forEach(side => {
      ctx.beginPath();
      const N = 90;
      for (let i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
        const u = (i / N) * Math.PI * 2;
        let x = cx + side * R * 0.96 + R * breathe * Math.cos(u);
        let y = cy + R * breathe * Math.sin(u);
        [x, y] = warp(x, y, t);
        (i === 0) ? ctx.moveTo(x, y) : ctx.lineTo(x, y);
      }
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.stroke();
    });
    ctx.restore();
    /* gestrichelter Wirkungsring */
    ctx.save();
    ctx.setLineDash([4, 7]);
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(168,184,232,0.28)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, s * 0.92, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
    /* Mittelpunkt */
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(168,184,232,0.8)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, 2.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  /* Kurve (Kreis ↔ Herz) */
  if (scene.heart.on) {
    const m = scene.heart.morph;
    const pulse = 1 + 0.02 * Math.sin(perf * 1.1);
    const s = scene.heart.size * pulse * Math.min(W, H) / 900;
    const hx = cx + scene.heart.x, hy = cy + scene.heart.y;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.lineWidth = scene.heart.width;
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.92)';
    ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.55)';
    ctx.shadowBlur = scene.heart.glow;
    ctx.beginPath();
    const N = 220;
    for (let i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
      const u = (i / N) * Math.PI * 2;
      let [x, y] = curvePoint(u, m, s * 1.9);
      [x, y] = warp(hx + x, hy + y, t);
      (i === 0) ? ctx.moveTo(x, y) : ctx.lineTo(x, y);
    }
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  /* Spawner */
  if (scene.spawner.on && scene.spawner.rate > 0 && !REDUCED) {
    spawnAcc += dt * scene.spawner.rate;
    while (spawnAcc >= 1) { spawnAcc -= 1; spawnSymbol(); }
  }
  ctx.save();
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  for (let i = symbols.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const sym = symbols[i];
    const age = perf - sym.born;
    if (age > sym.life) { symbols.splice(i, 1); continue; }
    sym.x += sym.vx * dt;
    sym.y += sym.vy * dt;
    const p = age / sym.life;
    const alpha = 0.5 * Math.sin(Math.PI * Math.min(1, p));
    const [px, py] = warp(sym.x, sym.y, t);
    ctx.font = '100 ' + sym.size + 'px Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + alpha.toFixed(3) + ')';
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(px, py);
    ctx.rotate(sym.rot * p);
    ctx.fillText(sym.char, 0, 0);
    ctx.restore();
  }
  ctx.restore();

  /* gezeichnete Pfade */
  if (strokes.length) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.85)';
    ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(168,184,232,0.5)';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
    for (const st of strokes) {
      if (st.length < 2) continue;
      ctx.beginPath();
      st.forEach((pt, i) => (i === 0) ? ctx.moveTo(pt.x, pt.y) : ctx.lineTo(pt.x, pt.y));
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  /* alte Ripples entsorgen */
  for (let i = ripples.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    if (perf - ripples[i].born > 1.6) ripples.splice(i, 1);
  }

  updateSelectionOverlay();
}

/* ---------- Start ---------- */
buildLibrary();
renderStack();
requestAnimationFrame(draw);
</script>
</body>
</html>

function spiralPath(cx,cy,rmax,turns){
  var p='M'+cx+' '+cy,n=64;
  for(var i=1;i<=n;i++){var f=i/n,a=f*turns*Math.PI*2,r=f*rmax;
    p+=' L'+(cx+Math.cos(a)*r).toFixed(2)+' '+(cy+Math.sin(a)*r).toFixed(2);}
  return p;
}

var uid=1;
function makeLayer(type,over){
  var T=TYPES[type],params={};
  T.schema.forEach(function(r){params[r.key]=r.value;});
  var L={id:uid++,type:type,kind:T.kind,name:T.name,visible:true,params:params,x:0,y:0,st:{}};
  if(over)Object.assign(L,over);
  return L;
}

  DPR=Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1,2);
  W=r.width;H=r.height;
  canvas.width=Math.round(W*DPR);canvas.height=Math.round(H*DPR);
}
window.addEventListener('resize',resize);

var REDUCED=window.matchMedia&&window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
var T0=performance.now(),lastT=0;

function heartPt(a,size,m){
  // Kreis <-> Herz Morph
  var hx=16*Math.pow(Math.sin(a),3);
  var hy=-(13*Math.cos(a)-5*Math.cos(2*a)-2*Math.cos(3*a)-Math.cos(4*a));
  hx*=size/16;hy*=size/16;
  var cx=Math.cos(a-Math.PI/2)*size,cy=Math.sin(a-Math.PI/2)*size;
  return [cx+(hx-cx)*m,cy+(hy-cy)*m];
}
var wordCache={};
function wordPoints(word){
  if(wordCache[word])return wordCache[word];
  var oc=document.createElement('canvas');oc.width=260;oc.height=80;
  var o=oc.getContext('2d');o.fillStyle='#fff';o.font='58px Verdana';o.textAlign='center';o.textBaseline='middle';
  o.fillText(word,130,40);
  var d=o.getImageData(0,0,260,80).data,pts=[];
  for(var y=0;y<80;y+=5)for(var x=0;x<260;x+=5)
    if(d[(y*260+x)*4+3]>120)pts.push([(x-130)/130,(y-40)/130]);
  wordCache[word]=pts;return pts;
}

var EMIT={
  gitter:function(L,t){
    var it=[],sp=Math.max(6,L.params.abstand),a=L.params.deckkraft/100;
    var ext=Math.ceil(900/sp)*sp;
    for(var x=-ext;x<=ext;x+=sp){
      var axis=L.params.achsen&&Math.abs(x)<0.1;
      it.push({k:'poly',pts:vline(x,-ext,ext),w:axis?1.2:0.7,a:axis?a*2.4:a,glow:0});
    }
    for(var y=-ext;y<=ext;y+=sp){
      var ax2=L.params.achsen&&Math.abs(y)<0.1;
      it.push({k:'poly',pts:hline(y,-ext,ext),w:ax2?1.2:0.7,a:ax2?a*2.4:a,glow:0});
    }
    return it;
  },
  kurve:function(L,t){
    var p=L.params,pts=[],n=140,m=p.morph/100,s=p.groesse*(1+(REDUCED?0:0.012*Math.sin(t*1.4)));
    for(var i=0;i<=n;i++){var q=heartPt(i/n*Math.PI*2,s,m);pts.push(q[0]+L.x,q[1]+L.y);}
    var it=[{k:'poly',pts:pts,closed:true,w:p.staerke,a:0.92,glow:p.gluehen}];
    if(p.fuellung)it.push({k:'poly',pts:pts,closed:true,fill:true,a:0.07,glow:0,w:0});
    return it;
  },
  symbol:function(L,t){
    var p=L.params;
    return [{k:'glyph',ch:p.zeichen,x:L.x,y:L.y,size:p.groesse*(1+(REDUCED?0:0.02*Math.sin(t*0.9))),a:p.deckkraft/100,glow:p.gluehen}];
  },
  pfad:function(L,t){
    var p=L.params,src=L.st.pts||[],pts=src;
    if(p.glaettung>0&&src.length>7){
      pts=[];var w=1+Math.round(p.glaettung/25);
      for(var i=0;i<src.length;i+=2){
        var sx=0,sy=0,c=0;
        for(var j=-w;j<=w;j++){var k=Math.min(src.length-2,Math.max(0,i+j*2));sx+=src[k];sy+=src[k+1];c++;}
        pts.push(sx/c+L.x,sy/c+L.y);
      }
    }
    return [{k:'poly',pts:pts,closed:p.schliessen,w:p.staerke,a:0.9,glow:p.gluehen}];
  },
  textpunkte:function(L,t){
    var p=L.params,pts=wordPoints(p.wort),it=[],s=p.groesse;
    for(var i=0;i<pts.length;i++){
      var jx=Math.sin(t*1.3+i)*p.streuung*0.4,jy=Math.cos(t*1.1+i*1.7)*p.streuung*0.4;
      it.push({k:'dot',x:pts[i][0]*s+L.x+jx,y:pts[i][1]*s+L.y+jy,r:1.6,a:0.8,glow:4});
    }
    return it;
  },
  linienschar:function(L,t){
    var p=L.params,n=Math.max(0,Math.round(p.anzahl)),R=p.groesse,it=[],f=p.faktor;
    for(var i=0;i<n;i++){
      var a1=i/n*Math.PI*2+t*0.05,a2=(i*(f+1))/n*Math.PI*2+t*0.05;
      it.push({k:'poly',pts:[Math.cos(a1)*R+L.x,Math.sin(a1)*R+L.y,Math.cos(a2)*R+L.x,Math.sin(a2)*R+L.y],w:0.7,a:p.deckkraft/100,glow:0});
    }
    return it;
  },
  spirale:function(L,t){
    var p=L.params,pts=[],n=260,tw=p.windungen,rot=t*p.tempo*0.02;
    for(var i=0;i<=n;i++){var f=i/n,a=f*tw*Math.PI*2+rot,r=f*p.groesse;
      pts.push(Math.cos(a)*r+L.x,Math.sin(a)*r+L.y);}
    return [{k:'poly',pts:pts,w:p.staerke,a:0.85,glow:8}];
  },
  ringschrift:function(L,t){
    var p=L.params,txt=(p.text+' · ').repeat(3),it=[],rot=t*p.tempo*0.015;
    var n=Math.min(txt.length,Math.max(8,Math.floor(p.radius/(p.groesse*0.62))));
    for(var i=0;i<n;i++){
      var a=i/n*Math.PI*2+rot,ch=txt[i%txt.length];
      if(ch===' ')continue;
      it.push({k:'glyph',ch:ch,x:Math.cos(a)*p.radius+L.x,y:Math.sin(a)*p.radius+L.y,size:p.groesse,a:0.75,glow:5,rot:a+Math.PI/2});
    }
    return it;
  },
  spawner:function(L,t,dt){
    var p=L.params,st=L.st;
    if(!st.parts)st.parts=[];
    st.acc=(st.acc||0)+dt*p.rate*0.28;
    var glyphs=p.zeichen==='nur ∞'?['∞']:p.zeichen==='Punkte'?['·']:['0','1','∞'];
    while(st.acc>1&&st.parts.length<90){
      st.acc-=1;
      var a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2;
      st.parts.push({x:L.x,y:L.y,vx:Math.cos(a)*(14+Math.random()*26),vy:Math.sin(a)*(14+Math.random()*26),age:0,ch:glyphs[Math.floor(Math.random()*glyphs.length)],rot:Math.random()*0.8-0.4});
    }
    var it=[];
    for(var i=st.parts.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      var q=st.parts[i];q.age+=dt;q.x+=q.vx*dt;q.y+=q.vy*dt;
      if(q.age>p.leben){st.parts.splice(i,1);continue;}
      var f=q.age/p.leben,al=f<0.15?f/0.15:1-(f-0.15)/0.85;
      it.push({k:'glyph',ch:q.ch,x:q.x,y:q.y,size:p.groesse*(0.7+f*0.6),a:al*0.5,glow:3,rot:q.rot});
    }
    it.push({k:'dot',x:L.x,y:L.y,r:2.2,a:0.65,glow:8});
    return it;
  },
  leben:function(L,t,dt){
    var p=L.params,st=L.st,N=22;
    if(!st.cells){st.cells=[];for(var i=0;i<N*N;i++)st.cells.push(Math.random()<0.24?1:0);st.tacc=0;}
    st.tacc+=dt*p.takt;
    if(st.tacc>1){st.tacc=0;
      var nx=new Array(N*N);
      for(var y=0;y<N;y++)for(var x=0;x<N;x++){
        var c=0;
        for(var dy=-1;dy<=1;dy++)for(var dx=-1;dx<=1;dx++){
          if(!dx&&!dy)continue;
          c+=st.cells[((y+dy+N)%N)*N+((x+dx+N)%N)];
        }
        var al=st.cells[y*N+x];
        nx[y*N+x]=al?(c===2||c===3?1:0):(c===3?1:0);
      }
      st.cells=nx;
    }
    var it=[],cs=p.zellgroesse,off=-N*cs/2;
    for(var y2=0;y2<N;y2++)for(var x2=0;x2<N;x2++)
      if(st.cells[y2*N+x2])it.push({k:'dot',x:off+x2*cs+L.x,y:off+y2*cs+L.y,r:cs*0.32,a:p.deckkraft/100,glow:2});
    return it;
  },
  strahlen:function(L,t){
    var p=L.params,it=[],rot=t*p.tempo*0.02;
    for(var i=0;i<p.anzahl;i++){
      var a=i/Math.max(1,p.anzahl)*Math.PI*2+rot,len=p.laenge*(0.72+0.28*Math.sin(t*1.5+i*1.3));
      it.push({k:'poly',pts:[L.x+Math.cos(a)*14,L.y+Math.sin(a)*14,L.x+Math.cos(a)*len,L.y+Math.sin(a)*len],w:0.7,a:0.4,glow:3});
    }
    return it;
  },
  textbaum:function(L,t){
    var p=L.params,it=[];
    function branch(x,y,a,len,d){
      if(d<=0||len<3)return;
      var sway=REDUCED?0:Math.sin(t*0.9+d*1.7)*0.05;
      var nx=x+Math.cos(a+sway)*len,ny=y+Math.sin(a+sway)*len;
      it.push({k:'poly',pts:[x,y,nx,ny],w:0.5+d*0.28,a:0.32+d*0.09,glow:2});
      var w=p.winkel*Math.PI/180;
      branch(nx,ny,a+sway-w,len*0.74,d-1);
      branch(nx,ny,a+sway+w,len*0.74,d-1);
    }
    branch(L.x,L.y+p.laenge*1.4,-Math.PI/2,p.laenge,Math.min(8,p.tiefe));
    return it;
  },
  fourier:function(L,t,dt){
    var p=L.params,st=L.st;if(!st.trail)st.trail=[];
    var r1=p.radius,r2=p.radius*0.42;
    var a1=t*0.7,a2=t*0.7*p.f2;
    var x1=L.x+Math.cos(a1)*r1,y1=L.y+Math.sin(a1)*r1;
    var x2=x1+Math.cos(a2)*r2,y2=y1+Math.sin(a2)*r2;
    st.trail.push(x2,y2);
    while(st.trail.length>p.spur*2)st.trail.splice(0,2);
    var it=[];
    if(p.kreise){
      it.push({k:'circle',x:L.x,y:L.y,r:r1,w:0.6,a:0.22,glow:0});
      it.push({k:'circle',x:x1,y:y1,r:r2,w:0.6,a:0.3,glow:0});
      it.push({k:'poly',pts:[L.x,L.y,x1,y1,x2,y2],w:0.6,a:0.3,glow:0});
    }
    it.push({k:'dot',x:x2,y:y2,r:2.4,a:0.9,glow:8});
    if(st.trail.length>=4)it.push({k:'poly',pts:st.trail.slice(),w:1.1,a:0.75,glow:6});
    return it;
  }
};
function vline(x,y0,y1){var p=[];for(var y=y0;y<=y1;y+=34)p.push(x,y);return p;}
function hline(y,x0,x1){var p=[];for(var x=x0;x<=x1;x+=34)p.push(x,y);return p;}

/* Kräfte */
function forcesAbove(i){
  var fs=[];
  for(var j=0;j<i;j++){var L=stack[j];if(L.kind==='kraft'&&L.visible)fs.push(L);}
  return fs;
}
function buildCopies(fs){
  var copies=[{rot:0,scale:1,tx:0,ty:0,am:1}];
  fs.forEach(function(F){
    var p=F.params,vars=[];
    if(F.type==='kaleidoskop'){
      var n=Math.max(1,Math.round(p.segmente));
      for(var k=0;k<n;k++)vars.push({rot:k/n*Math.PI*2,scale:1,tx:0,ty:0,am:1});
    }else if(F.type==='fraktal'){
      var s=1,r=0;
      for(var k2=0;k2<Math.max(1,Math.round(p.stufen));k2++){
        vars.push({rot:r,scale:s,tx:0,ty:0,am:Math.pow(0.72,k2)});
        s*=p.faktor/100;r+=p.drehung*Math.PI/180;
      }
    }else if(F.type==='tapete'){
      var g=Math.max(1,Math.round(p.raster)),half=Math.floor(g/2);
      for(var gy=-half;gy<=half;gy++)for(var gx=-half;gx<=half;gx++){
        var d=Math.max(Math.abs(gx),Math.abs(gy));
        vars.push({rot:0,scale:1,tx:gx*p.abstand,ty:gy*p.abstand,am:Math.pow(1-p.abnahme/100,d)});
      }
    }else return;
    var nxt=[];
    for(var a=0;a<copies.length&&nxt.length<36;a++)
      for(var b=0;b<vars.length&&nxt.length<36;b++){
        var c=copies[a],v=vars[b];
        nxt.push({rot:c.rot+v.rot,scale:c.scale*v.scale,tx:c.tx+v.tx*c.scale,ty:c.ty+v.ty*c.scale,am:c.am*v.am,baseRot:c.rot});
      }
    copies=nxt;
  });
  return copies;
}
function warpPoint(x,y,fs,t){
  for(var i=0;i<fs.length;i++){
    var F=fs[i];if(F.type!=='verzerren')continue;
    var p=F.params,k=Math.PI*2/Math.max(20,p.welle),sp=p.tempo*0.06;
    x+=Math.sin(y*k+t*sp)*p.staerke;
    y+=Math.cos(x*k*0.8+t*sp*0.9)*p.staerke*0.6;
  }
  for(var r=0;r<ripples.length;r++){
    var R=ripples[r],age=t-R.t0;if(age<0||age>2)continue;
    var dx=x-R.x,dy=y-R.y,d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy)||1;
    var wave=Math.sin(d*0.045-age*7)*38*(1-age/2)*Math.exp(-d/420);
    x+=dx/d*wave;y+=dy/d*wave;
  }
  return [x,y];
}
function applyCopy(x,y,c){
  var ca=Math.cos(c.rot),sa=Math.sin(c.rot);
  var nx=(x*ca-y*sa)*c.scale+c.tx,ny=(x*sa+y*ca)*c.scale+c.ty;
  return [nx,ny];
}

function draw(now){
  var t=REDUCED?3.2:(now-T0)/1000;
  var dt=Math.min(0.05,(now-lastT)/1000||0.016);lastT=now;
  ripples=ripples.filter(function(R){return t-R.t0<2;});
  ctx.setTransform(DPR,0,0,DPR,0,0);
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(W/2+cam.x,H/2+cam.y);

  var anyVisible=false;
  for(var i=stack.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    var L=stack[i];
    if(!L.visible||L.kind==='kraft')continue;
    anyVisible=true;
    var em=EMIT[L.type];if(!em)continue;
    var items=em(L,t,dt);
    var fs=forcesAbove(i);
    var copies=buildCopies(fs);
    var hasWarp=fs.some(function(f){return f.type==='verzerren';})||ripples.length>0;
    for(var ci=0;ci<copies.length;ci++){
      var c=copies[ci];
      if(c.am<0.03)continue;
      for(var ii=0;ii<items.length;ii++)drawItem(items[ii],c,fs,t,hasWarp);
    }
  }
  document.getElementById('empty-hint').classList.toggle('on',!anyVisible&&!drawing);

  // aktiver Zeichen-Strich
  if(drawing&&drawing.length>=4){
    ctx.shadowBlur=10;ctx.shadowColor='rgba(168,184,232,0.8)';
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(220,228,255,0.95)';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.lineCap='round';ctx.lineJoin='round';
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(drawing[0],drawing[1]);
    for(var d2=2;d2<drawing.length;d2+=2)ctx.lineTo(drawing[d2],drawing[d2+1]);
    ctx.stroke();ctx.shadowBlur=0;
  }

  // Auswahl-Ring
  if(sel){
    var SL=stack.find(function(l){return l.id===sel;});
    if(SL&&SL.visible){
      var rad=selRadius(SL);
      ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(168,184,232,0.55)';ctx.lineWidth=1;
      ctx.setLineDash([5,7]);
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(SL.x,SL.y,rad,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();
      ctx.setLineDash([]);
      ctx.fillStyle='rgba(168,184,232,0.9)';
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(SL.x,SL.y,2.5,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
    }
  }
  ctx.restore();
  requestAnimationFrame(draw);
}
function drawItem(item,c,fs,t,hasWarp){
  var a=(item.a==null?1:item.a)*c.am;
  if(a<=0.004)return;
  var col='rgba(255,255,255,'+a.toFixed(3)+')';
  ctx.shadowBlur=item.glow?item.glow*Math.min(1,c.scale):0;
  ctx.shadowColor=item.glow?'rgba(255,255,255,'+Math.min(0.9,a+0.15)+')':'transparent';
  if(item.k==='poly'){
    var pts=item.pts;if(pts.length<4)return;
    ctx.beginPath();
    for(var i=0;i<pts.length;i+=2){
      var q=applyCopy(pts[i],pts[i+1],c);
      if(hasWarp)q=warpPoint(q[0],q[1],fs,t);
      if(i===0)ctx.moveTo(q[0],q[1]);else ctx.lineTo(q[0],q[1]);
    }
    if(item.closed)ctx.closePath();
    if(item.fill){ctx.fillStyle=col;ctx.fill();}
    else{ctx.strokeStyle=col;ctx.lineWidth=Math.max(0.4,(item.w||1)*c.scale);ctx.lineCap='round';ctx.lineJoin='round';ctx.stroke();}
  }else if(item.k==='dot'){
    var q2=applyCopy(item.x,item.y,c);
    if(hasWarp)q2=warpPoint(q2[0],q2[1],fs,t);
    ctx.fillStyle=col;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(q2[0],q2[1],Math.max(0.4,item.r*c.scale),0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
  }else if(item.k==='circle'){
    var q3=applyCopy(item.x,item.y,c);
    if(hasWarp)q3=warpPoint(q3[0],q3[1],fs,t);
    ctx.strokeStyle=col;ctx.lineWidth=Math.max(0.4,(item.w||1)*c.scale);
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(q3[0],q3[1],item.r*c.scale,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();
  }else if(item.k==='glyph'){
    var q4=applyCopy(item.x,item.y,c);
    if(hasWarp)q4=warpPoint(q4[0],q4[1],fs,t);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(q4[0],q4[1]);
    ctx.rotate((item.rot||0)+c.rot);
    ctx.fillStyle=col;
    ctx.font=(item.size*c.scale)+'px Verdana';
    ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';
    ctx.fillText(item.ch,0,0);
    ctx.restore();
  }
  ctx.shadowBlur=0;
}
function selRadius(L){
  var p=L.params;
  switch(L.type){
    case 'kurve':return p.groesse*1.15+14;
    case 'symbol':return p.groesse*0.62+14;
    case 'spirale':return p.groesse+14;
    case 'linienschar':return p.groesse+14;
    case 'ringschrift':return p.radius+p.groesse+8;
    case 'textpunkte':return p.groesse+16;
    case 'strahlen':return p.laenge*0.6+20;
    case 'fourier':return p.radius*1.5+16;
    case 'leben':return 11*p.zellgroesse+12;
    case 'textbaum':return p.laenge*2+20;
    case 'spawner':return 70;
    case 'pfad':return (L.st.rad||60)+16;
    default:return 90;
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   UI — Strahl
   ============================================================ */
var beamList=document.getElementById('beam-list');
var miniBeam=document.getElementById('mini-beam');
document.getElementById('term-eye').innerHTML=UI.eye;

function renderBeam(){
  beamList.innerHTML='';
  stack.forEach(function(L,idx){
    var li=document.createElement('li');
    li.className='node kind-'+L.kind+(L.id===sel?' sel':'')+(L.visible?'':' hid');
    li.dataset.id=L.id;
    li.innerHTML='<span class="port"><i></i></span>'+
      (L.kind==='kraft'?'<span class="scope"></span>':'')+
      '<span class="node-icon">'+ICONS[L.type]+'</span>'+
      '<span class="node-text"><span class="node-kind">'+KINDS[L.kind]+'</span><span class="node-name">'+L.name+'</span></span>'+
      '<span class="node-acts">'+
        '<button class="n-act n-vis" title="'+(L.visible?'Ausblenden':'Einblenden')+'">'+(L.visible?UI.eye:UI.eyeOff)+'</button>'+
        '<button class="n-act n-dup" title="Duplizieren">'+UI.dup+'</button>'+
        '<button class="n-act n-del" title="Löschen">'+UI.del+'</button>'+
      '</span>';
    li.addEventListener('click',function(e){
      if(e.target.closest('.n-vis')){toggleVis(L.id);e.stopPropagation();return;}
      if(e.target.closest('.n-dup')){dupLayer(L.id);e.stopPropagation();return;}
      if(e.target.closest('.n-del')){delLayer(L.id);e.stopPropagation();return;}
      select(L.id);
    });
    if(L.kind==='kraft'){
      li.addEventListener('mouseenter',function(){showScope(li,idx);});
      li.addEventListener('mouseleave',function(){if(L.id!==sel)hideScope(li);});
    }
    beamList.appendChild(li);
  });
  // Scope des selektierten Kraft-Nodes dauerhaft zeigen
  var selL=stack.find(function(l){return l.id===sel;});
  if(selL&&selL.kind==='kraft'){
    var li2=beamList.querySelector('[data-id="'+sel+'"]');
    if(li2)showScope(li2,stack.indexOf(selL));
  }
  renderMini();
}
function showScope(li,idx){
  var sc=li.querySelector('.scope');if(!sc)return;
  var scroll=document.getElementById('beam-scroll');
  var bottomTerm=scroll.querySelectorAll('.beam-terminal')[1];
  var h=(bottomTerm.offsetTop+bottomTerm.offsetHeight/2)-(li.offsetTop+li.offsetHeight/2)-12;
  sc.style.height=Math.max(14,h)+'px';
  for(var j=idx+1;j<stack.length;j++){
    var n=beamList.children[j];if(n)n.classList.add('in-scope');
  }
}
function hideScope(li){
  var sc=li.querySelector('.scope');if(sc)sc.style.height='';
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(beamList.children,function(n){n.classList.remove('in-scope');});
}
function renderMini(){
  var html='<span class="mb-eye">'+UI.eye+'</span><span class="mb-line"></span>';
  stack.forEach(function(L){
    html+='<i class="mb-'+L.kind+(L.id===sel?' mb-sel':'')+'"></i><span class="mb-line"></span>';
  });
  html+='<span class="mb-zero">0</span>';
  miniBeam.innerHTML=html;
}

/* ============================================================
   UI — Auswahl + Regler-Rahmen (Dock / Mobile-Detail)
   ============================================================ */
var dock=document.getElementById('dock');
function isMobile(){return window.matchMedia('(max-width:900px)').matches;}

function select(id){
  sel=id;
  renderBeam();
  var L=stack.find(function(l){return l.id===id;});
  if(!L){dock.classList.remove('on');document.body.classList.remove('m-detail');return;}
  renderParams(L);
  if(isMobile()){
    document.body.classList.add('m-detail');
    document.body.classList.remove('sheet-peek');
    syncSheetVar();
  }else{
    dock.classList.add('on');
    dock.classList.remove('folded');
  }
}
function deselect(){
  sel=null;renderBeam();
  dock.classList.remove('on');
  document.body.classList.remove('m-detail');
  syncSheetVar();
}
function toggleVis(id){
  var L=stack.find(function(l){return l.id===id;});
  if(L){L.visible=!L.visible;renderBeam();if(sel===id)renderParams(L);}
}
function dupLayer(id){
  var i=stack.findIndex(function(l){return l.id===id;});
  if(i<0)return;
  var src=stack[i],cp=makeLayer(src.type);
  cp.params=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(src.params));
  cp.x=src.x+34;cp.y=src.y+26;
  if(src.st.pts)cp.st.pts=src.st.pts.slice();
  if(src.st.rad)cp.st.rad=src.st.rad;
  stack.splice(i,0,cp);
  select(cp.id);
  toast(src.name+' verdoppelt — 1 wird 2');
}
function delLayer(id){
  var i=stack.findIndex(function(l){return l.id===id;});
  if(i<0)return;
  var L=stack[i];
  stack.splice(i,1);
  if(sel===id)deselect();else renderBeam();
  toast(L.name+' verlässt den Strahl','Rückgängig',function(){
    stack.splice(Math.min(i,stack.length),0,L);renderBeam();
  });
}

function paramRows(L){
  var T=TYPES[L.type],rows='';
  T.schema.forEach(function(r,ri){
    if(r.ctrl==='slider'){
      rows+='<div class="crow"><label>'+r.label+'</label><div class="cslide">'+
        '<button class="stepper" data-ri="'+ri+'" data-d="-1">&#8722;</button>'+
        '<input type="range" min="'+r.min+'" max="'+r.max+'" step="'+r.step+'" value="'+L.params[r.key]+'" data-ri="'+ri+'" aria-label="'+r.label+'">'+
        '<button class="stepper" data-ri="'+ri+'" data-d="1">+</button>'+
        '<span class="cval" data-val="'+ri+'">'+fmt(L.params[r.key])+'</span></div></div>';
    }else if(r.ctrl==='select'){
      var opts=r.opts.map(function(o){return '<option'+(o===L.params[r.key]?' selected':'')+'>'+o+'</option>';}).join('');
      rows+='<div class="crow"><label>'+r.label+'</label><select class="csel" data-ri="'+ri+'">'+opts+'</select></div>';
    }else if(r.ctrl==='check'){
      rows+='<div class="crow"><label>'+r.label+'</label><div><input type="checkbox" class="ccheck" data-ri="'+ri+'"'+(L.params[r.key]?' checked':'')+' aria-label="'+r.label+'"></div></div>';
    }
  });
  return rows;
}
function fmt(v){return (Math.round(v*100)/100).toString().replace('.',',');}
function identHTML(L){
  return '<span class="node-icon">'+ICONS[L.type]+'</span>'+
    '<span style="min-width:0"><span class="dock-kind">'+KINDS[L.kind]+'</span><span class="dock-name">'+L.name+'</span></span>';
}
function bindParams(container,L){
  var T=TYPES[L.type];
  container.querySelectorAll('input[type=range]').forEach(function(inp){
    inp.addEventListener('input',function(){
      var r=T.schema[+inp.dataset.ri];
      L.params[r.key]=parseFloat(inp.value);
      var v=container.querySelector('[data-val="'+inp.dataset.ri+'"]');
      if(v)v.textContent=fmt(L.params[r.key]);
      if(L.type==='fourier')L.st.trail=[];
    });
  });
  container.querySelectorAll('.stepper').forEach(function(b){
    b.addEventListener('click',function(){
      var r=T.schema[+b.dataset.ri];
      var nv=L.params[r.key]+r.step*(+b.dataset.d);
      nv=Math.min(r.max,Math.max(r.min,nv));
      L.params[r.key]=Math.round(nv*100)/100;
      var inp=container.querySelector('input[data-ri="'+b.dataset.ri+'"]');
      if(inp)inp.value=L.params[r.key];
      var v=container.querySelector('[data-val="'+b.dataset.ri+'"]');
      if(v)v.textContent=fmt(L.params[r.key]);
    });
  });
  container.querySelectorAll('.csel').forEach(function(s){
    s.addEventListener('change',function(){
      var r=T.schema[+s.dataset.ri];
      L.params[r.key]=s.value;
      if(r.key==='wort')L.st={};
    });
  });
  container.querySelectorAll('.ccheck').forEach(function(cbx){
    cbx.addEventListener('change',function(){
      var r=T.schema[+cbx.dataset.ri];
      L.params[r.key]=cbx.checked;
    });
  });
}
function renderParams(L){
  document.getElementById('dock-id').innerHTML=identHTML(L);
  var body=document.getElementById('dock-body');
  body.innerHTML=paramRows(L);
  bindParams(body,L);
  // Mobile-Detail
  document.getElementById('det-id').innerHTML=identHTML(L);
  document.getElementById('det-acts').innerHTML=
    '<button class="n-act" id="det-vis" title="Ein-/Ausblenden">'+(L.visible?UI.eye:UI.eyeOff)+'</button>'+
    '<button class="n-act" id="det-dup" title="Duplizieren">'+UI.dup+'</button>'+
    '<button class="n-act" id="det-del" title="Löschen">'+UI.del+'</button>';
  document.getElementById('det-vis').addEventListener('click',function(){toggleVis(L.id);});
  document.getElementById('det-dup').addEventListener('click',function(){dupLayer(L.id);});
  document.getElementById('det-del').addEventListener('click',function(){delLayer(L.id);});
  var mp=document.getElementById('m-params');
  mp.innerHTML=paramRows(L);
  bindParams(mp,L);
}
document.getElementById('dock-close').addEventListener('click',deselect);
document.getElementById('dock-fold').innerHTML=UI.fold;
document.getElementById('dock-fold').addEventListener('click',function(){dock.classList.toggle('folded');});
document.getElementById('dock-close').innerHTML=UI.close;
document.getElementById('det-back').innerHTML=UI.back;
document.getElementById('det-back').addEventListener('click',function(){
  document.body.classList.remove('m-detail');sel=null;renderBeam();syncSheetVar();
});

function buildConstellation(){
  var stage=document.getElementById('const-stage');
  stage.innerHTML='';
  var core=document.createElement('div');
  core.className='const-core';
  core.id='const-core';
  stage.appendChild(core);
  resetCore();
  // Orbits: innen Kräfte, Mitte Erzeuger, außen Dinge
  var rings=[
    {group:GROUPS[2],rf:0.36,label:'Kräfte — das Verwandelnde',off:0.786},
    {group:GROUPS[1],rf:0.66,label:'Erzeuger — das Werdende',off:0},
    {group:GROUPS[0],rf:0.96,label:'Dinge — das Sichtbare',off:0.3927}
  ];
  rings.forEach(function(ring){
    var o=document.createElement('div');o.className='orbit';
    o.style.width=o.style.height='calc('+(ring.rf*100)+'% - 0px)';
    stage.appendChild(o);
    var lab=document.createElement('div');lab.className='orbit-label';
    lab.style.left='50%';
    lab.style.top='calc(50% + '+(ring.rf*50)+'%)';
    lab.textContent=ring.label;
    stage.appendChild(lab);
    var n=ring.group.types.length;
    ring.group.types.forEach(function(type,i){
      var a=(i/n)*Math.PI*2-Math.PI/2+ring.off;
      var b=document.createElement('button');
      b.className='const-item';
      b.style.left='calc(50% + '+(Math.cos(a)*ring.rf*50)+'%)';
      b.style.top='calc(50% + '+(Math.sin(a)*ring.rf*50)+'%)';
      b.innerHTML='<span class="ci-orb">'+ICONS[type]+'</span><span>'+TYPES[type].name+'</span>';
      b.addEventListener('mouseenter',function(){previewCore(type);});
      b.addEventListener('focus',function(){previewCore(type);});
      b.addEventListener('mouseleave',resetCore);
      b.addEventListener('click',function(){addFromLib(type);});
      stage.appendChild(b);
    });
  });
  // Mobile Liste
  var list=document.getElementById('const-list');
  list.innerHTML='';
  GROUPS.forEach(function(g){
    var sec=document.createElement('div');sec.className='cl-group';
    sec.innerHTML='<h3>'+g.label+'</h3><div class="cl-whisper">'+g.whisper+'</div>';
    g.types.forEach(function(type){
      var b=document.createElement('button');
      b.className='cl-item';
      b.innerHTML='<span class="ci-orb">'+ICONS[type]+'</span><span class="cl-text"><span class="cl-name">'+TYPES[type].name+'</span><span class="cl-sub">'+TYPES[type].whisper+'</span></span>';
      b.addEventListener('click',function(){addFromLib(type);});
      sec.appendChild(b);
    });
    list.appendChild(sec);
  });
}
function previewCore(type){
  var T=TYPES[type];
  document.getElementById('const-core').innerHTML=
    '<span class="core-glyph">'+ICONS[type]+'</span>'+
    '<span class="core-name">'+T.name+'</span>'+
    '<span class="core-whisper">'+T.whisper+'</span>';
}
function resetCore(){
  document.getElementById('const-core').innerHTML=
    '<span class="core-glyph">0</span>'+
    '<span class="core-whisper">Was tritt in den Strahl?<br>Je näher an 0, desto unstofflicher.</span>';
}

function closeLib(){lib.classList.remove('on');}

function addFromLib(type){
  var L=makeLayer(type);
  if(L.kind!=='kraft'&&type!=='gitter'){
    L.x=Math.round((Math.random()*2-1)*180);
    L.y=Math.round((Math.random()*2-1)*120);
  }
  // Kräfte treten oben ein (nah am Blick), Dinge/Erzeuger unter die unterste Kraft
  if(L.kind==='kraft'){stack.unshift(L);}
  else{
    var last=-1;
    stack.forEach(function(l,i){if(l.kind==='kraft')last=i;});
    stack.splice(last+1,0,L);
  }
  closeLib();
  select(L.id);
  toast(L.name+' tritt in den Strahl');
}

});

/* ============================================================
   Canvas-Interaktion
   ============================================================ */
function scenePt(e){
  var r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  return [e.clientX-r.left-W/2-cam.x,e.clientY-r.top-H/2-cam.y];
}
var pDown=null,pMoved=false;
canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown',function(e){
  canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
  var q=scenePt(e);
  pDown={x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY,cx:cam.x,cy:cam.y};pMoved=false;
  if(tool==='draw'){drawing=[q[0],q[1]];}
  else if(tool==='warp'){ripples.push({x:q[0],y:q[1],t0:(performance.now()-T0)/1000});}
});
canvas.addEventListener('pointermove',function(e){
  if(!pDown)return;
  var dx=e.clientX-pDown.x,dy=e.clientY-pDown.y;
  if(Math.abs(dx)+Math.abs(dy)>4)pMoved=true;
  if(tool==='move'&&pMoved){cam.x=pDown.cx+dx;cam.y=pDown.cy+dy;}
  else if(tool==='draw'&&drawing){
    var q=scenePt(e);
    var lx=drawing[drawing.length-2],ly=drawing[drawing.length-1];
    if((q[0]-lx)*(q[0]-lx)+(q[1]-ly)*(q[1]-ly)>9)drawing.push(q[0],q[1]);
  }
  else if(tool==='warp'&&pMoved){
    var q2=scenePt(e);
    var lastR=ripples[ripples.length-1];
    var now=(performance.now()-T0)/1000;
    if(!lastR||now-lastR.t0>0.12)ripples.push({x:q2[0],y:q2[1],t0:now});
  }
});
canvas.addEventListener('pointerup',function(e){
  if(tool==='draw'&&drawing){
    if(drawing.length>=8){
      var pts=drawing;drawing=null;
      // Anker = Schwerpunkt
      var mx=0,my=0,n=pts.length/2;
      for(var i=0;i<pts.length;i+=2){mx+=pts[i];my+=pts[i+1];}
      mx/=n;my/=n;
      var rel=[],rad=0;
      for(var j=0;j<pts.length;j+=2){
        rel.push(pts[j]-mx,pts[j+1]-my);
        rad=Math.max(rad,Math.hypot(pts[j]-mx,pts[j+1]-my));
      }
      var L=makeLayer('pfad',{x:mx,y:my});
      L.st.pts=rel;L.st.rad=rad;
      var lastK=-1;
      stack.forEach(function(l,i2){if(l.kind==='kraft')lastK=i2;});
      stack.splice(lastK+1,0,L);
      renderBeam();select(L.id);
      toast('Dein Strich ist jetzt ein Pfad im Strahl');
    }else drawing=null;
  }
  else if(tool==='move'&&!pMoved){
    // Hit-Test: oberstes Objekt zuerst
    var q=scenePt(e),hit=null;
    for(var i3=0;i3<stack.length;i3++){
      var L2=stack[i3];
      if(!L2.visible||L2.kind==='kraft'||L2.type==='gitter')continue;
      var d=Math.hypot(q[0]-L2.x,q[1]-L2.y);
      if(d<Math.max(70,selRadius(L2))){hit=L2;break;}
    }
    if(hit)select(hit.id);else deselect();
  }
  pDown=null;
});

var toastEl=document.getElementById('toast'),toastTimer=null;
function toast(text,actLabel,actFn){
  document.getElementById('toast-text').textContent=text;
  var act=document.getElementById('toast-act');
  if(actLabel){act.hidden=false;act.textContent=actLabel;
    act.onclick=function(){actFn&&actFn();hideToast();};}
  else{act.hidden=true;act.onclick=null;}
  toastEl.classList.add('on');
  clearTimeout(toastTimer);
  toastTimer=setTimeout(hideToast,actLabel?5200:2800);
}
function hideToast(){toastEl.classList.remove('on');}

document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
  if(e.key==='Escape'){
    if(lib.classList.contains('on'))closeLib();
    else if(ob.classList.contains('on'))ob.classList.remove('on');
    else deselect();
  }
  if((e.key==='Delete'||e.key==='Backspace')&&sel&&!e.target.closest('input,select,textarea')){
    delLayer(sel);
  }
});

<script>
(function () {
'use strict';

/* =================== Daten =================== */

var LIB = [

  ]},
  { cat: 'Erzeuger', note: 'lassen laufend Neues entstehen', items: [

    { type: 'textbaum', icon: '⋔', name: 'Text-Baum',         desc: 'Wörter verzweigen sich' },
    { type: 'fourier',  icon: '∿', name: 'Fourier-Zeichner',  desc: 'Kreise zeichnen die Linie' }
  ]},
  { cat: 'Kräfte', note: 'wirken auf alles darunter', items: [
    { type: 'verzerren',  icon: '≈', name: 'Raum verzerren',  desc: 'Wellen biegen den Raum' },
    { type: 'fraktal',    icon: '∆', name: 'Fraktal',         desc: 'Das Ganze in jedem Teil' },
    { type: 'kaleidoskop', icon: '✻', name: 'Kaleidoskop',    desc: 'Spiegelung um ein Zentrum' },
    { type: 'tapete',     icon: '▩', name: 'Tapete',          desc: 'Muster füllt die Fläche' }
  ]}
];

function libFind(type) {
  for (var c = 0; c < LIB.length; c++)
    for (var i = 0; i < LIB[c].items.length; i++)
      if (LIB[c].items[i].type === type) return LIB[c].items[i];
  return null;
}
function kindOf(type) {
  if (['verzerren','fraktal','kaleidoskop','tapete'].indexOf(type) >= 0) return 'kraft';
  if (['spawner','leben','strahlen','textbaum','fourier'].indexOf(type) >= 0) return 'erzeuger';
  return 'ding';
}
var KIND_LABEL = { ding: 'Ding', erzeuger: 'Erzeuger', kraft: 'Kraft' };

/* Eigenschaften-Schemata (Attrappe; Handling = echtes controls.js) */
var SCHEMAS = {
  verzerren: [
    { k: 'art', ctrl: 'select', label: 'Art', options: ['Welle', 'Sog', 'Wirbel', 'Chirp'], value: 'Welle' },
    { k: 'staerke', label: 'Stärke', min: 0, max: 60, step: 1, value: 12, live: 'warpAmp' },
    { k: 'radius', label: 'Radius', min: 0, max: 2000, step: 10, value: 700 },
    { k: 'zx', label: 'Zentrum X', min: -1000, max: 1000, step: 1, value: 0 },
    { k: 'zy', label: 'Zentrum Y', min: -1000, max: 1000, step: 1, value: 0 }
  ],
  kurve: [
    { k: 'groesse', label: 'Größe', min: 0, max: 600, step: 1, value: 160, live: 'heartSize' },
    { k: 'morph', label: 'Morph Kreis ↔ Herz (%)', min: 0, max: 100, step: 1, value: 72, live: 'morph' },
    { k: 'rundung', ctrl: 'select', label: 'Rundung', options: ['Echter Bogen', 'Bezier', 'Eckig'], value: 'Echter Bogen' },
    { k: 'wfreq', label: 'Wellen-Frequenz', min: 0, max: 40, step: 1, value: 0 },
    { k: 'staerke', label: 'Strichstärke', min: 0, max: 12, step: 0.5, value: 1.5 },
    { k: 'gluehen', label: 'Glühen', min: 0, max: 40, step: 1, value: 12, live: 'glow' }
  ],
  symbol: [
    { k: 'zeichen', ctrl: 'select', label: 'Zeichen', options: ['∞', '0', '1', '≡'], value: '∞' },
    { k: 'groesse', label: 'Größe', min: 0, max: 800, step: 1, value: 300, live: 'symSize' },
    { k: 'deckung', label: 'Deckung (%)', min: 0, max: 100, step: 1, value: 24 },
    { k: 'gluehen', label: 'Glühen', min: 0, max: 40, step: 1, value: 8 }
  ],
  gitter: [
    { k: 'zelle', label: 'Zellgröße', min: 0, max: 300, step: 1, value: 60, live: 'gridStep' },
    { k: 'staerke', label: 'Linienstärke', min: 0, max: 6, step: 0.25, value: 1 },
    { k: 'deckung', label: 'Deckung (%)', min: 0, max: 100, step: 1, value: 14 }
  ],
  spawner: [
    { k: 'rate', label: 'Rate (je Sekunde)', min: 0, max: 60, step: 1, value: 3 },
    { k: 'leben', label: 'Lebensdauer (s)', min: 0, max: 60, step: 1, value: 9 },
    { k: 'streuung', label: 'Streuung', min: 0, max: 1000, step: 10, value: 420 },
    { k: 'drift', label: 'Drift', min: 0, max: 100, step: 1, value: 12 }
  ],
  pfad: [
    { k: 'staerke', label: 'Strichstärke', min: 0, max: 12, step: 0.5, value: 1.5 },
    { k: 'glaetten', label: 'Glätten (%)', min: 0, max: 100, step: 1, value: 30 },
    { k: 'gluehen', label: 'Glühen', min: 0, max: 40, step: 1, value: 10 }
  ],
  spirale: [
    { k: 'windungen', label: 'Windungen', min: 0, max: 40, step: 0.5, value: 5, live: 'spiralTurns' },
    { k: 'radius', label: 'Radius', min: 0, max: 800, step: 5, value: 230 },
    { k: 'staerke', label: 'Strichstärke', min: 0, max: 8, step: 0.25, value: 1 }
  ],
  _default: [
    { k: 'groesse', label: 'Größe', min: 0, max: 600, step: 1, value: 200 },
    { k: 'deckung', label: 'Deckung (%)', min: 0, max: 100, step: 1, value: 80 },
    { k: 'tempo', label: 'Tempo', min: 0, max: 100, step: 1, value: 30 }
  ]
};

/* Stapel — oben = vorne; Kräfte wirken nach unten */
var idSeq = 0;
function mkBlock(type, name) {
  var it = libFind(type);
  return { id: 'b' + (++idSeq), type: type, kind: kindOf(type),
           icon: it ? it.icon : '✧', name: name || (it ? it.name : type), visible: true };
}
var stack = [
  mkBlock('verzerren'),
  mkBlock('spawner'),
  mkBlock('kurve'),
  mkBlock('symbol'),
  mkBlock('gitter')
];
var selectedId = stack[2].id;
var hoverKraftIdx = -1;

/* =================== Szene (Attrappe) =================== */

var canvas = document.getElementById('scene');
var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
var reduceMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

var scene = {
  zoom: 1, camX: 0, camY: 0,
  heartSize: 160, morph: 72, glow: 12,
  symSize: 300, gridStep: 60, spiralTurns: 5,
  warpAmp: 12, warpX: 0, warpY: 0, warpBoost: 0,
  paths: [], instances: 0
};
var drift = [];
(function () {
  var glyphs = ['0', '1', '∞', '∞', '0', '1', '∞', '0'];
  for (var i = 0; i < glyphs.length; i++) {
    drift.push({ ch: glyphs[i], x: (Math.sin(i * 999) * 520), y: (Math.cos(i * 373) * 380),
                 vx: 3 + (i % 3) * 2, vy: 2 + (i % 4), ph: i * 1.7, s: 16 + (i % 3) * 10 });
  }
})();

function hasVisible(type) {
  for (var i = 0; i < stack.length; i++) if (stack[i].type === type && stack[i].visible) return true;
  return false;
}
function warp(px, py, t) {
  var dx = px - scene.warpX, dy = py - scene.warpY;
  var d = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) + 0.001;
  var fall = Math.exp(-d / 700);
  var amp = (scene.warpAmp + scene.warpBoost) * fall;
  var w = Math.sin(d * 0.010 - t * 0.9) * amp;
  return [px + (dx / d) * w, py + (dy / d) * w];
}
function heartPoint(a, size, morphPct, t) {
  var pulse = 1 + 0.015 * Math.sin(t * 1.6);
  var hx = Math.pow(Math.sin(a), 3);
  var hy = -(13 * Math.cos(a) - 5 * Math.cos(2 * a) - 2 * Math.cos(3 * a)) / 16;
  var r = Math.sqrt(hx * hx + hy * hy) || 0.0001;
  var m = morphPct / 100;
  /* radial morph: gleiche Richtung, Radius zwischen Kreis (1) und Herz (r) */
  var mag = (1 * (1 - m) + r * m) * size * pulse;
  return [(hx / r) * mag, (hy / r) * mag];
}

var fpsEma = 60, lastTs = 0, timeAcc = 0;

function draw(ts) {
  var dt = lastTs ? (ts - lastTs) / 1000 : 0.016;
  lastTs = ts;
  if (dt > 0 && dt < 0.5) fpsEma = fpsEma * 0.92 + (1 / dt) * 0.08;
  if (!reduceMotion) timeAcc += dt;
  var t = timeAcc;

  var w = canvas.width, h = canvas.height;
  var dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
  ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
  ctx.setTransform(dpr * scene.zoom, 0, 0, dpr * scene.zoom,
    w / 2 + scene.camX * dpr * scene.zoom, h / 2 + scene.camY * dpr * scene.zoom);

  var inst = 0;
  var worldW = (w / dpr) / scene.zoom, worldH = (h / dpr) / scene.zoom;
  var half = Math.max(worldW, worldH) * 0.75 + 200;
  scene.warpBoost *= 0.94;

  /* Gitter */
  if (hasVisible('gitter')) {
    var step = Math.max(14, scene.gridStep);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.13)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1 / scene.zoom;
    var n0 = Math.floor(-half / step), n1 = Math.ceil(half / step);
    for (var gx = n0; gx <= n1; gx++) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (var yy = -half; yy <= half; yy += 30) {
        var p = warp(gx * step, yy, t);
        if (yy === -half) ctx.moveTo(p[0], p[1]); else ctx.lineTo(p[0], p[1]);
      }
      ctx.stroke(); inst++;
    }
    for (var gy = n0; gy <= n1; gy++) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (var xx = -half; xx <= half; xx += 30) {
        var q = warp(xx, gy * step, t);
        if (xx === -half) ctx.moveTo(q[0], q[1]); else ctx.lineTo(q[0], q[1]);
      }
      ctx.stroke(); inst++;
    }
  }

  /* Symbol ∞ */
  if (hasVisible('symbol')) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.font = scene.symSize + 'px "Times New Roman", Georgia, serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.22)';
    ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.35)';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 22;
    ctx.fillText('∞', 0, 6);
    ctx.restore(); inst++;
  }

  /* Spawner-Drift */
  if (hasVisible('spawner')) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.16)';
    ctx.font = '22px "Times New Roman", Georgia, serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    for (var di = 0; di < drift.length; di++) {
      var g = drift[di];
      var px2 = g.x + Math.sin(t * 0.12 * g.vx + g.ph) * 130;
      var py2 = g.y + Math.cos(t * 0.1 * g.vy + g.ph) * 90;
      var pw = warp(px2, py2, t);
      ctx.font = g.s + 'px "Times New Roman", Georgia, serif';
      ctx.fillText(g.ch, pw[0], pw[1]); inst++;
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  /* Spirale (falls hinzugefügt) */
  if (hasVisible('spirale')) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1 / scene.zoom;
    ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)'; ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
    ctx.beginPath();
    var turns = scene.spiralTurns, steps = Math.max(60, turns * 40);
    for (var si = 0; si <= steps; si++) {
      var sa = (si / steps) * turns * Math.PI * 2 + t * 0.15;
      var sr = (si / steps) * 230;
      var sp = warp(Math.cos(sa) * sr, Math.sin(sa) * sr, t);
      if (si === 0) ctx.moveTo(sp[0], sp[1]); else ctx.lineTo(sp[0], sp[1]);
    }
    ctx.stroke(); ctx.restore(); inst++;
  }

  /* Linienschar (falls hinzugefügt) */
  if (hasVisible('linienschar')) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1 / scene.zoom;
    for (var li = -6; li <= 6; li++) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (var lx = -420; lx <= 420; lx += 28) {
        var lp = warp(lx, li * 34 + Math.sin(t * 0.6 + li) * 8, t);
        if (lx === -420) ctx.moveTo(lp[0], lp[1]); else ctx.lineTo(lp[0], lp[1]);
      }
      ctx.stroke(); inst++;
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  /* Herz-Kurve */
  if (hasVisible('kurve')) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.92)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.6 / scene.zoom;
    ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
    ctx.shadowBlur = scene.glow;
    ctx.beginPath();
    var N = 200;
    for (var i2 = 0; i2 <= N; i2++) {
      var a2 = (i2 / N) * Math.PI * 2;
      var hp = heartPoint(a2, scene.heartSize, scene.morph, t);
      var wp = warp(hp[0], hp[1], t);
      if (i2 === 0) ctx.moveTo(wp[0], wp[1]); else ctx.lineTo(wp[0], wp[1]);
    }
    ctx.closePath(); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore(); inst++;
  }

  /* gezeichnete Pfade */
  ctx.save();
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.85)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.6 / scene.zoom;
  ctx.lineJoin = 'round'; ctx.lineCap = 'round';
  ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)'; ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
  for (var pi = 0; pi < scene.paths.length; pi++) {
    var path = scene.paths[pi];
    if (path.blockId) {
      var blk = blockById(path.blockId);
      if (blk && !blk.visible) continue;
    }
    if (path.pts.length < 4) continue;
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (var pj = 0; pj < path.pts.length; pj += 2) {
      var wpt = warp(path.pts[pj], path.pts[pj + 1], t);
      if (pj === 0) ctx.moveTo(wpt[0], wpt[1]); else ctx.lineTo(wpt[0], wpt[1]);
    }
    ctx.stroke(); inst++;
  }
  ctx.restore();

  /* Selektions-Overlay */
  var sel = blockById(selectedId);
  if (sel && sel.visible) drawSelection(sel, t);

  scene.instances = inst;
  updateMetrics();
  requestAnimationFrame(draw);
}

function drawSelection(sel, t) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(168,184,232,0.75)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1 / scene.zoom;
  ctx.setLineDash([5 / scene.zoom, 5 / scene.zoom]);
  var r = 0, box = null;
  if (sel.type === 'kurve') r = scene.heartSize * 1.18;
  else if (sel.type === 'symbol') box = [-scene.symSize * 0.42, -scene.symSize * 0.26, scene.symSize * 0.84, scene.symSize * 0.52];
  else if (sel.type === 'verzerren') r = 240;
  else if (sel.type === 'spawner') r = 420;
  else if (sel.type === 'spirale') r = 240;
  else if (sel.type === 'gitter') { ctx.restore(); return; }
  else r = 200;

  if (box) {
    ctx.strokeRect(box[0], box[1], box[2], box[3]);
    drawHandles(box[0], box[1], box[2], box[3]);
  } else {
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
    drawHandles(-r, -r, r * 2, r * 2);
  }
  if (sel.kind === 'kraft') {
    ctx.setLineDash([]);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-10, 0); ctx.lineTo(10, 0); ctx.moveTo(0, -10); ctx.lineTo(0, 10);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}
function drawHandles(x, y, w2, h2) {
  var s = 6 / scene.zoom;
  ctx.setLineDash([]);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#0a0a0c';
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(168,184,232,0.9)';
  var pts = [[x, y], [x + w2, y], [x, y + h2], [x + w2, y + h2]];
  for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    ctx.fillRect(pts[i][0] - s / 2, pts[i][1] - s / 2, s, s);
    ctx.strokeRect(pts[i][0] - s / 2, pts[i][1] - s / 2, s, s);
  }
}

function resize() {
  var dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
  var r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(r.width * dpr));
  canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(r.height * dpr));
}
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

/* =================== Stapel-UI =================== */

var stackEl = document.getElementById('stack');

function blockById(id) {
  for (var i = 0; i < stack.length; i++) if (stack[i].id === id) return stack[i];
  return null;
}
function kraftDepth(idx) {
  var d = 0;
  for (var i = 0; i < idx; i++) if (stack[i].kind === 'kraft' && stack[i].visible) d++;
  return d;
}

function renderStack() {
  stackEl.innerHTML = '';
  var maxDepth = 0;
  for (var i = 0; i < stack.length; i++) maxDepth = Math.max(maxDepth, kraftDepth(i) + (stack[i].kind === 'kraft' ? 1 : 0));

  stack.forEach(function (b, idx) {
    var li = document.createElement('li');
    li.className = 'stack-row' + (b.id === selectedId ? ' selected' : '') + (b.visible ? '' : ' hidden-block');
    li.dataset.id = b.id;
    li.dataset.idx = idx;
    li.draggable = true;

    var below = 0;
    if (b.kind === 'kraft') below = stack.length - 1 - idx;

    var gut = document.createElement('span');
    gut.className = 'scope-gutter';
    var depth = kraftDepth(idx);
    for (var d = 0; d < depth; d++) {
      var ln = document.createElement('span'); ln.className = 'scope-line'; gut.appendChild(ln);
    }
    if (b.kind === 'kraft' && b.visible) {
      var src = document.createElement('span'); src.className = 'scope-line src'; gut.appendChild(src);
    }
    li.appendChild(gut);

    var dh = document.createElement('span');
    dh.className = 'drag-handle'; dh.title = 'Ziehen zum Umsortieren'; dh.textContent = '⠿';
    li.appendChild(dh);

    var ic = document.createElement('span');
    ic.className = 'type-icon ' + b.kind; ic.textContent = b.icon;
    li.appendChild(ic);

    var lab = document.createElement('span');
    lab.className = 'row-label';
    lab.innerHTML = '<span class="row-kind">' + KIND_LABEL[b.kind] + '</span><span class="row-name"></span>';
    lab.querySelector('.row-name').textContent = b.name;
    li.appendChild(lab);

    if (b.kind === 'kraft') {
      var tag = document.createElement('span');
      tag.className = 'row-tag';
      tag.title = 'Diese Kraft wirkt auf alle Bausteine darunter';
      tag.textContent = 'wirkt ↓ ' + below;
      li.appendChild(tag);
    }

    var act = document.createElement('span');
    act.className = 'row-actions';
    act.innerHTML =
      '<button class="mini-btn" data-act="dup" title="Duplizieren">⧉</button>' +
      '<button class="mini-btn' + (b.visible ? '' : ' eye-off') + '" data-act="eye" title="' + (b.visible ? 'Ausblenden' : 'Einblenden') + '">◉</button>' +
      '<button class="mini-btn" data-act="del" title="Löschen">✕</button>';
    li.appendChild(act);

    stackEl.appendChild(li);
  });

  document.getElementById('st-blocks').textContent = stack.length;
  document.getElementById('mtab-count').textContent = stack.length;
  renderCtx();
  renderProps();
}

stackEl.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
  var row = e.target.closest('.stack-row');
  if (!row) return;
  var b = blockById(row.dataset.id);
  var btn = e.target.closest('.mini-btn');
  if (btn) {
    var actn = btn.dataset.act;
    if (actn === 'eye') { b.visible = !b.visible; toast(b.visible ? 'Eingeblendet' : 'Ausgeblendet — bleibt im Stapel'); }
    else if (actn === 'del') {
      stack = stack.filter(function (x) { return x.id !== b.id; });
      if (selectedId === b.id) selectedId = stack.length ? stack[0].id : null;
      toast('Gelöscht — Rückgängig mit ⌘Z (Attrappe)');
    }
    else if (actn === 'dup') {
      var copy = mkBlock(b.type, b.name + ' Kopie');
      stack.splice(stack.indexOf(b) + 1, 0, copy);
      selectedId = copy.id;
      toast('Dupliziert');
    }
    renderStack();
    return;
  }
  selectedId = b.id;
  renderStack();
});

stackEl.addEventListener('mouseover', function (e) {
  var row = e.target.closest('.stack-row');
  if (!row) return;
  var b = blockById(row.dataset.id);
  if (b && b.kind === 'kraft') {
    var idx = parseInt(row.dataset.idx, 10);
    var rows = stackEl.querySelectorAll('.stack-row');
    for (var i = idx + 1; i < rows.length; i++) rows[i].classList.add('in-hover-scope');
  }
});
stackEl.addEventListener('mouseout', function () {
  stackEl.querySelectorAll('.in-hover-scope').forEach(function (r) { r.classList.remove('in-hover-scope'); });
});

/* Drag-Reorder */
var dragId = null;
stackEl.addEventListener('dragstart', function (e) {
  var row = e.target.closest('.stack-row');
  if (!row) return;
  dragId = row.dataset.id;
  e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
  try { e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', dragId); } catch (err) {}
});
stackEl.addEventListener('dragover', function (e) {
  e.preventDefault();
  var row = e.target.closest('.stack-row');
  stackEl.querySelectorAll('.drag-over-top,.drag-over-bot').forEach(function (r) { r.classList.remove('drag-over-top', 'drag-over-bot'); });
  if (!row || row.dataset.id === dragId) return;
  var rect = row.getBoundingClientRect();
  row.classList.add(e.clientY < rect.top + rect.height / 2 ? 'drag-over-top' : 'drag-over-bot');
});
stackEl.addEventListener('drop', function (e) {
  e.preventDefault();
  var row = e.target.closest('.stack-row');
  stackEl.querySelectorAll('.drag-over-top,.drag-over-bot').forEach(function (r) { r.classList.remove('drag-over-top', 'drag-over-bot'); });
  if (!row || !dragId || row.dataset.id === dragId) { dragId = null; return; }
  var from = stack.indexOf(blockById(dragId));
  var rect = row.getBoundingClientRect();
  var to = stack.indexOf(blockById(row.dataset.id));
  if (e.clientY >= rect.top + rect.height / 2) to++;
  if (from < to) to--;
  var moved = stack.splice(from, 1)[0];
  stack.splice(to, 0, moved);
  dragId = null;
  renderStack();
  toast('Umsortiert — die Wirkung folgt der Reihenfolge');
});
stackEl.addEventListener('dragend', function () {
  stackEl.querySelectorAll('.drag-over-top,.drag-over-bot').forEach(function (r) { r.classList.remove('drag-over-top', 'drag-over-bot'); });
  dragId = null;
});

/* =================== Kontextleiste =================== */

function forcesAbove(id) {
  var n = 0;
  for (var i = 0; i < stack.length; i++) {
    if (stack[i].id === id) break;
    if (stack[i].kind === 'kraft' && stack[i].visible) n++;
  }
  return n;
}

function renderCtx() {
  var el = document.getElementById('ctxbar');
  var b = blockById(selectedId);
  if (!b) { el.innerHTML = '<span class="ctx-empty">Nichts ausgewählt — Baustein im Stapel wählen</span>'; return; }
  var fa = forcesAbove(b.id);
  var note = b.kind === 'kraft'
    ? 'wirkt auf <b>' + (stack.length - 1 - stack.indexOf(b)) + '</b> darunter'
    : (fa > 0 ? '<b>' + fa + '</b> ' + (fa === 1 ? 'Kraft wirkt' : 'Kräfte wirken') + ' darauf' : 'keine Kraft darüber');
  el.innerHTML =
    '<span class="ctx-inner">' +
      '<span class="ctx-icon ' + b.kind + '">' + b.icon + '</span>' +
      '<span class="ctx-kind">' + KIND_LABEL[b.kind] + '</span>' +
      '<span class="ctx-name"></span>' +
      '<span class="ctx-note">' + note + '</span>' +
      '<span class="ctx-sep"></span>' +
      '<span class="ctx-actions">' +
        '<button class="mini-btn" data-act="dup" title="Duplizieren">⧉</button>' +
        '<button class="mini-btn' + (b.visible ? '' : ' eye-off') + '" data-act="eye" title="Ein-/Ausblenden">◉</button>' +
        '<button class="mini-btn" data-act="del" title="Löschen">✕</button>' +
      '</span>' +
    '</span>';
  el.querySelector('.ctx-name').textContent = b.name;
  el.querySelectorAll('.mini-btn').forEach(function (btn) {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
      var row = stackEl.querySelector('.stack-row[data-id="' + b.id + '"] .mini-btn[data-act="' + btn.dataset.act + '"]');
      if (row) row.click();
    });
  });
}

/* =================== Eigenschaften =================== */

function renderProps() {
  var body = document.getElementById('props-body');
  var sub = document.getElementById('props-sub');
  var ctxLine = document.getElementById('props-ctx');
  var b = blockById(selectedId);
  if (!b) {
    sub.textContent = '';
    ctxLine.innerHTML = '';
    body.innerHTML = '<div class="props-empty">Kein Baustein ausgewählt.<br />Wähle im Stapel, was du formen willst.</div>';
    return;
  }
  sub.textContent = '';
  var fa = forcesAbove(b.id);
  ctxLine.innerHTML = '<b>' + b.icon + ' ' + '</b><b></b><span>&middot; ' + KIND_LABEL[b.kind] + '</span>' +
    (b.kind !== 'kraft' && fa > 0 ? '<span>&middot; unter ' + fa + ' ' + (fa === 1 ? 'Kraft' : 'Kräften') + '</span>' : '');
  ctxLine.querySelectorAll('b')[1].textContent = b.name;

  var schema = SCHEMAS[b.type] || SCHEMAS._default;
  var html = '<div class="ctl-head"><span class="ctl-grip"></span><span class="spacer"></span>' +
    '<button class="ctl-ico" title="Alle Werte zurücksetzen">↺</button>' +
    '<button class="ctl-ico" title="Panel lösen — frei über der Fläche platzieren">↔</button></div>';
  body.innerHTML = html;

  schema.forEach(function (f) {
    if (f.ctrl === 'select') {
      var rowW = document.createElement('div');
      rowW.className = 'ctl-row-wide';
      var l = document.createElement('label'); l.textContent = f.label; rowW.appendChild(l);
      var s = document.createElement('select');
      f.options.forEach(function (o) {
        var opt = document.createElement('option'); opt.textContent = o; opt.selected = (o === f.value);
        s.appendChild(opt);
      });
      rowW.appendChild(s);
      body.appendChild(rowW);
      return;
    }
    var row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = 'ctl-row';
    var lab = document.createElement('label'); lab.textContent = f.label;
    var minus = document.createElement('button'); minus.className = 'ctl-pm'; minus.textContent = '−';
    var input = document.createElement('input');
    input.type = 'range'; input.min = f.min; input.max = f.max; input.step = f.step; input.value = f.value;
    var plus = document.createElement('button'); plus.className = 'ctl-pm'; plus.textContent = '+';
    var out = document.createElement('output'); out.textContent = f.value;

    function apply(v) {
      f.value = v; out.textContent = v;
      if (f.live && scene.hasOwnProperty(f.live)) scene[f.live] = parseFloat(v);
    }
    input.addEventListener('input', function () { apply(input.value); });
    minus.addEventListener('click', function () { input.value = Math.max(f.min, parseFloat(input.value) - parseFloat(f.step)); apply(input.value); });
    plus.addEventListener('click', function () { input.value = Math.min(f.max, parseFloat(input.value) + parseFloat(f.step)); apply(input.value); });

    row.appendChild(lab); row.appendChild(minus); row.appendChild(input); row.appendChild(plus); row.appendChild(out);
    body.appendChild(row);
  });
}

/* =================== Werkzeuge =================== */

var tool = 'move';
var TOOL_HINTS = {
  move: 'Bewegen — Ziehen schwenkt die Fläche · Rad zoomt · <kbd>F</kbd> passt ein',
  warp: 'Verzerren — Ziehen biegt den Raum unter dem Zeiger',
  draw: 'Zeichnen — Freihand ziehen legt ein neues Ding „Pfad“ in den Stapel'
};
function setTool(name) {
  tool = name;
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-tool]').forEach(function (btn) {
    btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.tool === name);
  });
  var stage = document.getElementById('stage');
  stage.className = 'tool-' + name;
  document.getElementById('st-hint').innerHTML = TOOL_HINTS[name];
}
document.querySelectorAll('[data-tool]').forEach(function (btn) {
  btn.addEventListener('click', function () { setTool(btn.dataset.tool); });
});

/* Canvas-Interaktion */
var ptr = { down: false, x: 0, y: 0, moved: false, path: null };
function toWorld(cx, cy) {
  var r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  var x = (cx - r.left - r.width / 2) / scene.zoom - scene.camX;
  var y = (cy - r.top - r.height / 2) / scene.zoom - scene.camY;
  return [x, y];
}
canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) {
  canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
  ptr.down = true; ptr.moved = false; ptr.x = e.clientX; ptr.y = e.clientY;
  if (tool === 'draw') {
    var wp = toWorld(e.clientX, e.clientY);
    ptr.path = { pts: [wp[0], wp[1]], blockId: null };
    scene.paths.push(ptr.path);
  } else if (tool === 'warp') {
    var ww = toWorld(e.clientX, e.clientY);
    scene.warpX = ww[0]; scene.warpY = ww[1];
  }
});
canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', function (e) {
  if (!ptr.down) return;
  var dx = e.clientX - ptr.x, dy = e.clientY - ptr.y;
  if (Math.abs(dx) + Math.abs(dy) > 3) ptr.moved = true;
  if (tool === 'move') {
    scene.camX += dx / scene.zoom; scene.camY += dy / scene.zoom;
  } else if (tool === 'warp') {
    var ww = toWorld(e.clientX, e.clientY);
    scene.warpX = ww[0]; scene.warpY = ww[1];
    scene.warpBoost = Math.min(46, scene.warpBoost + Math.abs(dx) * 0.12 + Math.abs(dy) * 0.12);
  } else if (tool === 'draw' && ptr.path) {
    var wp = toWorld(e.clientX, e.clientY);
    ptr.path.pts.push(wp[0], wp[1]);
  }
  ptr.x = e.clientX; ptr.y = e.clientY;
});
canvas.addEventListener('pointerup', function (e) {
  if (tool === 'draw' && ptr.path) {
    if (ptr.path.pts.length >= 8) {
      var nb = mkBlock('pfad');
      /* neue Dinge landen UNTER den Kräften — damit sie sofort mitverwandelt werden */
      var at = 0;
      while (at < stack.length && stack[at].kind === 'kraft') at++;
      stack.splice(at, 0, nb);
      ptr.path.blockId = nb.id;
      selectedId = nb.id;
      renderStack();
      toast('Neues Ding „Pfad“ — unterhalb der Kräfte eingeordnet');
    } else {
      scene.paths.pop();
    }
    ptr.path = null;
  } else if (tool === 'move' && !ptr.moved) {
    var wp2 = toWorld(e.clientX, e.clientY);
    var d = Math.sqrt(wp2[0] * wp2[0] + wp2[1] * wp2[1]);
    if (d < scene.heartSize * 1.3 && hasVisible('kurve')) {
      var kb = stack.filter(function (x) { return x.type === 'kurve'; })[0];
      if (kb) { selectedId = kb.id; renderStack(); }
    }
  }
  ptr.down = false;
});
canvas.addEventListener('wheel', function (e) {
  e.preventDefault();
  var f = Math.exp(-e.deltaY * 0.0012);
  scene.zoom = Math.min(5, Math.max(0.2, scene.zoom * f));
}, { passive: false });

/* Einpassen / Neu */
function fitView() {
  scene.zoom = 1; scene.camX = 0; scene.camY = 0;
  toast('Eingepasst — Szene zentriert');
}
document.getElementById('fit-btn').addEventListener('click', fitView);
document.getElementById('m-fit-btn').addEventListener('click', fitView);
document.getElementById('new-btn').addEventListener('click', function () {
  toast('Neu würde die Szene leeren — in der Attrappe deaktiviert');
});
document.getElementById('export-btn').addEventListener('click', function () { toast('PNG exportiert (Attrappe)'); });
document.getElementById('share-btn').addEventListener('click', function () { toast('Szenen-Link kopiert (Attrappe)'); });
document.getElementById('fullscreen-btn').addEventListener('click', function () {
  if (document.fullscreenElement) document.exitFullscreen();
  else document.documentElement.requestFullscreen().catch(function () {});
});

/* =================== Bibliothek =================== */

var lib = document.getElementById('library');
function renderLib(q) {
  var body = document.getElementById('lib-body');
  body.innerHTML = '';
  q = (q || '').toLowerCase();
  LIB.forEach(function (cat) {
    var hits = cat.items.filter(function (it) {
      return !q || it.name.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) >= 0 || it.desc.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) >= 0;
    });
    if (!hits.length) return;
    var h = document.createElement('div');
    h.className = 'lib-cat';
    h.innerHTML = '<span>' + cat.cat + '</span><small>' + cat.note + '</small>';
    body.appendChild(h);
    var grid = document.createElement('div');
    grid.className = 'tile-grid';
    hits.forEach(function (it) {
      var tile = document.createElement('button');
      tile.className = 'tile';
      tile.innerHTML = '<span class="t-icon">' + it.icon + '</span><span class="t-name"></span><span class="t-desc"></span>';
      tile.querySelector('.t-name').textContent = it.name;
      tile.querySelector('.t-desc').textContent = it.desc;
      tile.addEventListener('click', function () {
        var nb = mkBlock(it.type);
        var at = 0;
        if (nb.kind !== 'kraft') { while (at < stack.length && stack[at].kind === 'kraft') at++; }
        stack.splice(at, 0, nb);
        selectedId = nb.id;
        closeOverlays();
        renderStack();
        toast(KIND_LABEL[nb.kind] + ' „' + nb.name + '“ hinzugefügt');
      });
      grid.appendChild(tile);
    });
    body.appendChild(grid);
  });
  if (!body.children.length) {
    body.innerHTML = '<div class="props-empty">Nichts gefunden — anderes Wort probieren.</div>';
  }
}
function openLib() {
  renderLib('');
  document.getElementById('lib-q').value = '';
  lib.classList.add('open');
  if (window.innerWidth > 760) document.getElementById('lib-q').focus();
}
document.getElementById('add-btn').addEventListener('click', openLib);
document.getElementById('lib-close').addEventListener('click', closeOverlays);
document.getElementById('lib-q').addEventListener('input', function (e) { renderLib(e.target.value); });

/* =================== Kommando-Palette =================== */

var pal = document.getElementById('palette');
var PAL_CMDS = [
  { icon: '+', label: 'Baustein hinzufügen', sub: 'Bibliothek öffnen', kbd: 'A', run: openLib },
  { icon: '✥', label: 'Werkzeug: Bewegen', sub: '', kbd: 'V', run: function () { setTool('move'); } },
  { icon: '≈', label: 'Werkzeug: Verzerren', sub: '', kbd: 'W', run: function () { setTool('warp'); } },
  { icon: '✎', label: 'Werkzeug: Zeichnen', sub: '', kbd: 'Z', run: function () { setTool('draw'); } },
  { icon: '⊡', label: 'Ansicht einpassen', sub: 'Kamera zurück zur Szene', kbd: 'F', run: fitView },
  { icon: '⤓', label: 'Als PNG exportieren', sub: '', kbd: '⌘E', run: function () { toast('PNG exportiert (Attrappe)'); } },
  { icon: '⧉', label: 'Szene teilen', sub: 'Link mit gesamtem Zustand', kbd: '', run: function () { toast('Szenen-Link kopiert (Attrappe)'); } },
  { icon: '∅', label: 'Neue Szene', sub: 'alles leeren', kbd: '', run: function () { toast('In der Attrappe deaktiviert'); } },
  { icon: '◉', label: 'Auswahl ein-/ausblenden', sub: '', kbd: 'H', run: function () {
      var row = stackEl.querySelector('.stack-row.selected .mini-btn[data-act="eye"]'); if (row) row.click();
    } },
  { icon: '⧉', label: 'Auswahl duplizieren', sub: '', kbd: '⌘D', run: function () {
      var row = stackEl.querySelector('.stack-row.selected .mini-btn[data-act="dup"]'); if (row) row.click();
    } }
];
var palIdx = 0;
function renderPal(q) {
  var listEl = document.getElementById('pal-list');
  listEl.innerHTML = '';
  q = (q || '').toLowerCase();
  var shown = PAL_CMDS.filter(function (c) { return !q || (c.label + ' ' + c.sub).toLowerCase().indexOf(q) >= 0; });
  palIdx = Math.min(palIdx, Math.max(0, shown.length - 1));
  shown.forEach(function (c, i) {
    var li = document.createElement('li');
    li.className = 'pal-item' + (i === palIdx ? ' act' : '');
    li.innerHTML = '<span class="p-icon">' + c.icon + '</span><span class="p-label"></span>' + (c.kbd ? '<kbd>' + c.kbd + '</kbd>' : '');
    var lb = li.querySelector('.p-label');
    lb.textContent = c.label;
    if (c.sub) { var sm = document.createElement('small'); sm.textContent = c.sub; lb.appendChild(sm); }
    li.addEventListener('click', function () { closeOverlays(); c.run(); });
    listEl.appendChild(li);
  });
}
function openPal() {
  palIdx = 0;
  renderPal('');
  document.getElementById('pal-q').value = '';
  pal.classList.add('open');
  document.getElementById('pal-q').focus();
}
document.getElementById('pal-btn').addEventListener('click', openPal);
document.getElementById('pal-q').addEventListener('input', function (e) { palIdx = 0; renderPal(e.target.value); });
document.getElementById('pal-q').addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
  var items = pal.querySelectorAll('.pal-item');
  if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') { e.preventDefault(); palIdx = Math.min(items.length - 1, palIdx + 1); renderPal(e.target.value); }
  else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') { e.preventDefault(); palIdx = Math.max(0, palIdx - 1); renderPal(e.target.value); }
  else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
    var act = pal.querySelector('.pal-item.act');
    if (act) act.click();
  }
});

function closeOverlays() {
  lib.classList.remove('open');
  pal.classList.remove('open');
}
[lib, pal].forEach(function (ov) {
  ov.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (e.target === ov) closeOverlays(); });
});

/* =================== Tastatur =================== */

document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
  var typing = /INPUT|SELECT|TEXTAREA/.test(document.activeElement.tagName);
  if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'k') {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (pal.classList.contains('open')) closeOverlays(); else { closeOverlays(); openPal(); }
    return;
  }
  if (e.key === 'Escape') { closeOverlays(); return; }
  if (typing) return;
  var k = e.key.toLowerCase();
  if (k === 'v') setTool('move');
  else if (k === 'w') setTool('warp');
  else if (k === 'z') setTool('draw');
  else if (k === 'f') fitView();
  else if (k === 'a') openLib();
});

/* =================== Mobile Sheet =================== */

var side = document.getElementById('side');
var sheetState = 'peek';
function setSheet(st) {
  sheetState = st;
  side.classList.toggle('half', st === 'half');
  side.classList.toggle('full', st === 'full');
}
document.getElementById('sheet-grab').addEventListener('click', function () {
  setSheet(sheetState === 'peek' ? 'half' : (sheetState === 'half' ? 'full' : 'peek'));
});
document.querySelectorAll('[data-mtab-btn]').forEach(function (btn) {
  btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
    side.dataset.mtab = btn.dataset.mtabBtn;
    document.querySelectorAll('.m-tab').forEach(function (t) { t.classList.toggle('active', t === btn); });
    if (sheetState === 'peek') setSheet('half');
  });
});

/* =================== Status / Toast / Coach =================== */

function updateMetrics() {
  document.getElementById('st-zoom').innerHTML = Math.round(scene.zoom * 100) + '&nbsp;%';
  document.getElementById('st-fps').textContent = Math.round(Math.min(60, fpsEma));
  document.getElementById('st-inst').textContent = scene.instances;
  document.getElementById('mchip-txt').textContent = Math.round(scene.zoom * 100) + ' % · ' + Math.round(Math.min(60, fpsEma)) + ' fps';
}

}

          { key: 'size', ctrl: 'slider', label: 'Größe', min: 10, max: 400, step: 1, value: 120 }
        ],

          var pts = [];
          var n = 96;
          for (var i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            var a = (i / n) * Math.PI * 2;
            var r = block.params.size * (1 + 0.12 * Math.sin(t * 2 + a * 3));
            pts.push(Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r);
          }
          return [
            { k: 'poly', pts: pts, closed: true, w: 1.5, col: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)', glow: 12 },
            { k: 'glyph', ch: '∞', x: 0, y: 0, size: 60, col: 'rgba(168,184,232,0.8)', glow: 8 },
            { k: 'dot', x: 160, y: 0, r: 4, col: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)' }
          ];
        }
      });
      sc.add('_selftest');
      console.log('ENGINE OK');
    }

        OneCanvasUI.init(sc);

<!DOCTYPE html>

  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  
  
  
  <title>Kreis-Animation</title>
  <style>
    html, body {
    }
    canvas {
      display: block;
    }

  <script>
    const canvas = document.getElementById('canvas');
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

    // Passe die Canvas-Größe an den Viewport an
    function resizeCanvas() {
      canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
      canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
    }
    resizeCanvas();
    window.addEventListener('resize', resizeCanvas);

    // Farben aus den CSS-Variablen
    const computedStyle = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement);
    const textColor = computedStyle.getPropertyValue('--text-color').trim() || '#000';
    const bgColor   = computedStyle.getPropertyValue('--bg-color').trim() || '#fff';

    const cycleDuration = 2000; // Zyklusdauer in Millisekunden (2 Sekunden)

    function animate(timestamp) {
      // Mittelpunkt des Canvas
      const centerX = canvas.width / 2;
      const centerY = canvas.height / 2;
      
      // Relativer Radius: (min(width, height) / 3) / 2
      const radius = Math.min(canvas.width, canvas.height) / 6;
      const displacement = radius; // Verschiebung entspricht dem Radius

      // Canvas löschen und Hintergrund setzen
      ctx.fillStyle = bgColor;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

      ctx.strokeStyle = textColor;
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;

      // Ersten (statischen) Kreis zeichnen – zentriert
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(centerX, centerY, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();

      // Berechne den mod-basierten Wert (Dreieckswellen-Verlauf)
      let t = (timestamp % cycleDuration) / cycleDuration; // normierter Wert 0 ... 1
      let modVal = t < 0.5 ? (t * 2) : (2 - t * 2);

      // Verschiebung in X-Richtung (nach rechts)
      let offsetX = modVal * displacement;

      // Zweiten Kreis zeichnen – verschoben in X-Richtung
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(centerX + offsetX, centerY, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();

      requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    }

    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  </script>
