<script>
"use strict";
(() => {
  const feld = document.getElementById("feld");
  const bild = document.getElementById("bild");
  const kreis = document.getElementById("kreis");
  const ctx = bild.getContext("2d");
  const klein = document.createElement("canvas");
  const kctx = kreis.getContext("2d");
  const eingabe = document.getElementById("k");
  const knopf = document.getElementById("normalisieren");
  const satz = document.getElementById("satz");
  const fehler = document.getElementById("fehler");

  // The login editor's toolbar (tools/editor.js) is fixed to the bottom edge and
  // would cover the formula; keep the formula above it while it is there.
  const editorLeisteFreihalten = () => {
    let beobachtet = null;
    const messen = () => {
      const platz = beobachtet ? Math.max(0, window.innerHeight - beobachtet.getBoundingClientRect().top) : 0;
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--oe-bar-platz", platz + "px");
    };
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(messen);
    const pruefen = () => {
      const bar = document.getElementById("oe-bar");
      if (bar === beobachtet) return;
      if (beobachtet) ro.unobserve(beobachtet);
      beobachtet = bar;
      if (bar) ro.observe(bar);
      messen();
    };
    new MutationObserver(pruefen).observe(document.body, { childList: true });
    window.addEventListener("resize", messen);
    pruefen();
  };
  editorLeisteFreihalten();

  const fail = (msg) => {
    console.error(msg);
    fehler.textContent = msg;
    fehler.hidden = false;
  };

  const workers = Array.from({ length: Math.max(1, Math.min(8, (navigator.hardwareConcurrency || 4) - 1)) }, () => {
    const w = new Worker("/tools/workers/normales-mandelbrot-worker.js");
    w.onerror = (e) => fail("Rechenfehler: " + e.message);
    return w;
  });

  // view: center (cx, cy) in the c-plane, s = c units per canvas pixel
  let k = 1, cx = 0, cy = 0, s = 1, W = 0, H = 0, dpr = 1, R0 = 2;
  let gen = 0, timer = 0;

  function parseK(text) {
    const t = text.trim().replace(/,/g, ".").replace(/−/g, "-");
    const m = t.match(/^(-?\d*\.?\d+)\s*\/\s*(-?\d*\.?\d+)$/);
    const v = m ? Number(m[1]) / Number(m[2]) : (t === "" ? NaN : Number(t));
    return Number.isFinite(v) ? v : null;
  }

  function fit() {
    // the escape disk |c| <= 2/|k| fills the shorter side; k = 0 never escapes
    R0 = k === 0 ? 2 : 2 / Math.abs(k);
    cx = 0; cy = 0;
    s = (2 * R0 * 1.12) / Math.min(W, H);
  }

  function resize() {
    dpr = Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
    const r = feld.getBoundingClientRect();
    W = Math.max(1, Math.round(r.width * dpr));
    H = Math.max(1, Math.round(r.height * dpr));
    const old = Math.min(bild.width, bild.height);
    bild.width = kreis.width = W;
    bild.height = kreis.height = H;
    if (old > 0) s *= old / Math.min(W, H); else fit();
    render();
  }

  function drawCircle() {
    kctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
    const px = (0 - cx) / s + W / 2, py = H / 2 - (0 - cy) / s, r = 1 / s;
    if (!(r > 0.5 && r < 1e7)) return;
    kctx.beginPath();
    kctx.arc(px, py, r, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
    kctx.lineWidth = dpr;
    kctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)";
    kctx.stroke();
  }

  function pass(step, myGen) {
    const w = Math.ceil(W / step), h = Math.ceil(H / step);
    const ss = s * step;
    const x0 = cx - (W / 2) * s, y0 = cy + (H / 2) * s;
    const maxit = Math.round(400 + 200 * Math.max(0, Math.log2(R0 / (s * Math.min(W, H) / 2))));
    const img = new ImageData(w, h);
    const BAND = 16;
    const jobs = [];
    for (let r = 0; r < h; r += BAND) jobs.push([r, Math.min(h, r + BAND)]);
    // middle bands first, so the center appears first
    jobs.sort((a, b) => Math.abs(a[0] - h / 2) - Math.abs(b[0] - h / 2));
    let open = jobs.length;
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      const next = (wk) => {
        const j = jobs.shift();
        if (j) wk.postMessage({ id: myGen, w, row0: j[0], row1: j[1], x0, y0, s: ss, k, maxit });
      };
      for (const wk of workers) {
        wk.onmessage = (e) => {
          const m = e.data;
          if (myGen !== gen) return resolve(false);
          if (m.id !== myGen) return;   // late answer to an older view
          img.data.set(m.out, m.row0 * w * 4);
          if (--open === 0) {
            if (step === 1) ctx.putImageData(img, 0, 0);
            else {
              klein.width = w; klein.height = h;
              klein.getContext("2d").putImageData(img, 0, 0);
              ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
              ctx.drawImage(klein, 0, 0, w * step, h * step);
            }
            return resolve(true);
          }
          next(wk);
        };
        next(wk);
      }
    });
  }

  async function render() {
    const myGen = ++gen;
    drawCircle();
    if (await pass(4, myGen) && await pass(1, myGen)) keepSnap();
  }

  // the last finished picture, moved and scaled to the current view
  const snap = document.createElement("canvas");
  let snapView = null;
  function keepSnap() {
    snap.width = W; snap.height = H;
    snap.getContext("2d").drawImage(bild, 0, 0);
    snapView = { cx, cy, s };
  }
  function preview() {
    if (!snapView) return;
    const f = snapView.s / s;
    const ox = (snapView.cx - cx) / s + W / 2 - f * snap.width / 2;
    const oy = (cy - snapView.cy) / s + H / 2 - f * snap.height / 2;
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgb(6, 6, 6)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
    ctx.drawImage(snap, ox, oy, snap.width * f, snap.height * f);
  }

  function later() {
    gen++;
    preview();
    drawCircle();
    clearTimeout(timer);
    timer = setTimeout(render, 90);
  }

  function setK(v, text) {
    k = v;
    snapView = null;
    eingabe.removeAttribute("aria-invalid");
    if (text !== undefined) eingabe.value = text;
    sizeInput();
    const normal = k === 2;
    knopf.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(normal));
    satz.hidden = !normal;
    const url = new URL(location.href);
    url.searchParams.set("k", eingabe.value.trim());
    history.replaceState(null, "", url);
    fit();
    render();
  }

  function sizeInput() {
    eingabe.style.width = Math.max(1.6, eingabe.value.length * 0.62 + 0.7) + "em";
  }

  eingabe.addEventListener("input", () => {
    sizeInput();
    const v = parseK(eingabe.value);
    if (v === null) { eingabe.setAttribute("aria-invalid", "true"); return; }
    setK(v);
  });
  eingabe.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => { if (e.key === "Enter") eingabe.blur(); });
  knopf.addEventListener("click", () => setK(2, "2"));

  // ---- zoom and pan: wheel, drag, pinch ----
  const pts = new Map();
  let pinch = null;
  const toC = (x, y) => [cx + (x * dpr - W / 2) * s, cy - (y * dpr - H / 2) * s];
  function zoomAt(f, x, y) {
    const [ar, ai] = toC(x, y);
    s *= f;
    cx = ar - (x * dpr - W / 2) * s;
    cy = ai + (y * dpr - H / 2) * s;
  }
  feld.addEventListener("wheel", (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const r = feld.getBoundingClientRect();
    zoomAt(Math.exp(e.deltaY * 0.0015), e.clientX - r.left, e.clientY - r.top);
    later();
  }, { passive: false });
  feld.addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => {
    feld.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    pts.set(e.pointerId, { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY });
  });
  feld.addEventListener("pointermove", (e) => {
    const p = pts.get(e.pointerId);
    if (!p) return;
    const r = feld.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (pts.size === 1) {
      cx -= (e.clientX - p.x) * dpr * s;
      cy += (e.clientY - p.y) * dpr * s;
    } else if (pts.size === 2) {
      const [a, b] = [...pts.values()];
      const before = Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y);
      p.x = e.clientX; p.y = e.clientY;
      const after = Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y);
      if (before > 0 && after > 0) zoomAt(before / after, (a.x + b.x) / 2 - r.left, (a.y + b.y) / 2 - r.top);
    }
    p.x = e.clientX; p.y = e.clientY;
    later();
  });
  const up = (e) => pts.delete(e.pointerId);
  feld.addEventListener("pointerup", up);
  feld.addEventListener("pointercancel", up);
  feld.addEventListener("dblclick", () => { fit(); render(); });

  window.addEventListener("resize", resize);

  const start = new URL(location.href).searchParams.get("k");
  const sv = start === null ? null : parseK(start);
  if (sv !== null) { k = sv; eingabe.value = start.trim(); }
  sizeInput();
  knopf.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(k === 2));
  satz.hidden = k !== 2;
  resize();
  fit();
  render();
})();
</script>

    <script>
        const factorDisplay = document.getElementById('factorDisplay');
        const factorDisplayText = factorDisplay.querySelector('span');
        const button = document.getElementById('button');
        const minValueInput = document.getElementById('minValue');
        const maxValueInput = document.getElementById('maxValue');
        const pressTimeInput = document.getElementById('pressTime');
        const releaseTimeInput = document.getElementById('releaseTime');
        const infinitySizeInput = document.getElementById('infinitySize');

        let factor = 1;
        let interval;
        let startTime;
        let increasing = true;
        let factorStart = 1;
        let factorEnd = 1000;
        let timeToMaxFactor = 10 * 1000;
        let timeToMinFactor = 2 * 1000;

        function getNumberValue(input, fallback) {
            const value = Number(input.value);
            return Number.isFinite(value) ? value : fallback;
        }

        function formatLargeNumber(number) {
            return BigInt(Math.floor(number)).toString();
        }

        function updateFactorDisplay() {
            const maxValue = getNumberValue(maxValueInput, 1e308);
            const infinitySize = getNumberValue(infinitySizeInput, 250);
            const displayValue = factor >= maxValue ? '∞' : formatLargeNumber(factor);

            factorDisplayText.textContent = displayValue;
            factorDisplay.style.fontSize = `${displayValue === '∞' ? infinitySize : 24}px`;

            let fontSize = parseFloat(factorDisplay.style.fontSize);
            while (factorDisplay.scrollWidth > factorDisplay.clientWidth && fontSize > 1) {
                fontSize -= 0.5;
                factorDisplay.style.fontSize = `${fontSize}px`;
            }

            factorDisplayText.style.transform = displayValue === '∞'
                ? 'translate(-50%, calc(-50% + 10px))'
                : 'translate(-50%, -50%)';
        }

        function changeFactor() {
            const elapsedTime = Date.now() - startTime;
            const targetTime = increasing ? timeToMaxFactor : timeToMinFactor;
            const progress = elapsedTime / targetTime;

            if (increasing) {
                factor = factorStart * Math.pow(factorEnd / factorStart, progress);
            } else {
                factor = factorStart / Math.pow(factorStart / factorEnd, progress);
            }

            updateFactorDisplay();

            if (progress >= 1) {
                clearInterval(interval);
                factor = factorEnd;
                updateFactorDisplay();
            }
        }

        function startIncreasingFactor() {
            increasing = true;
            clearInterval(interval);
            factorStart = factor;
            factorEnd = getNumberValue(maxValueInput, 1e308);
            timeToMaxFactor = getNumberValue(pressTimeInput, 3) * 1000;
            startTime = Date.now();
            interval = setInterval(changeFactor, 100);
        }

        function startDecreasingFactor() {
            increasing = false;
            clearInterval(interval);
            factorStart = factor;
            factorEnd = getNumberValue(minValueInput, 1);
            timeToMinFactor = getNumberValue(releaseTimeInput, 1) * 1000;
            startTime = Date.now();
            interval = setInterval(changeFactor, 100);
        }

        function resizeFactorDisplay() {
            updateFactorDisplay();
        }

        button.addEventListener('mousedown', startIncreasingFactor);
        button.addEventListener('mouseup', startDecreasingFactor);
        button.addEventListener('mouseleave', startDecreasingFactor);
        button.addEventListener('touchstart', event => {
            event.preventDefault();
            startIncreasingFactor();
        }, { passive: false });
        button.addEventListener('touchend', event => {
            event.preventDefault();
            startDecreasingFactor();
        }, { passive: false });
        button.addEventListener('touchcancel', event => {
            event.preventDefault();
            startDecreasingFactor();
        }, { passive: false });

        [minValueInput, maxValueInput, infinitySizeInput].forEach(input => {
            input.addEventListener('input', updateFactorDisplay);
        });

        window.addEventListener('resize', resizeFactorDisplay);
        resizeFactorDisplay();
    </script>

        // ===== SPRITE-CACHE für effizientes Rendering =====
        // Statt bei jedem Punkt fillText() aufzurufen (sehr langsam),

	        }

	        // Funktion zum Abrufen der CSS-Variable
	        function getCSSVariable(variable) {

		        function findAlphaBounds(ctx, width, height) {
		            const imageData = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, width, height);
		            const data = imageData.data;
		            let minX = width;
		            let minY = height;
		            let maxX = -1;
		            let maxY = -1;

		            for (let y = 0; y < height; y++) {
		                for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) {
		                    const alpha = data[(y * width + x) * 4 + 3];
		                    if (alpha <= 0) continue;
		                    if (x < minX) minX = x;
		                    if (x > maxX) maxX = x;
		                    if (y < minY) minY = y;
		                    if (y > maxY) maxY = y;
		                }
		            }

		            if (maxX < minX || maxY < minY) {
		                return { x: 0, y: 0, width: 1, height: 1 };
		            }

		            return {
		                x: minX,
		                y: minY,
		                width: maxX - minX + 1,
		                height: maxY - minY + 1
		            };
		        }

		        function createOrGetMasterSprite(cacheObj, keyPrefix, font, symbolLines, lineHeightRatio) {
		            const safeLines = (symbolLines && symbolLines.length) ? symbolLines : [''];
		            const safeRatio = Math.max(0.1, lineHeightRatio || 1);
		            const masterKey = `${keyPrefix}${font}|${safeRatio.toFixed(4)}|${safeLines.join('\\n')}`;

		            if (cacheObj.masterKey === masterKey && cacheObj.masterCanvas) {
		                return cacheObj;
		            }

		            const masterFontSize = CONFIG.sprite.masterFontSize;
		            const masterLineHeight = masterFontSize * safeRatio;
		            const linesCount = safeLines.length || 1;
		            const padding = CONFIG.sprite.masterPadding;

		            const measureCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
		            const measureCtx = measureCanvas.getContext('2d');
		            measureCtx.font = `${masterFontSize}px ${font}`;

		            let maxWidth = 0;
		            for (const line of safeLines) {
		                const w = measureCtx.measureText(line || ' ').width;
		                if (w > maxWidth) maxWidth = w;
		            }

		            const masterWidth = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(maxWidth + padding * 2));
		            const masterHeight = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(masterLineHeight * linesCount + padding * 2));

		            let masterCanvas = cacheObj.masterCanvas;
		            if (!masterCanvas) {
		                masterCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
		            }
		            masterCanvas.width = masterWidth;
		            masterCanvas.height = masterHeight;

		            const masterCtx = masterCanvas.getContext('2d');
		            masterCtx.clearRect(0, 0, masterWidth, masterHeight);
		            masterCtx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
		            masterCtx.font = `${masterFontSize}px ${font}`;
		            masterCtx.textAlign = 'center';
		            masterCtx.textBaseline = 'middle';

		            const centerX = masterWidth / 2;
		            const centerY = masterHeight / 2;
		            if (linesCount === 1) {
		                masterCtx.fillText(safeLines[0] || '', centerX, centerY);
		            } else {
		                const totalHeight = masterLineHeight * linesCount;
		                const startY = centerY - (totalHeight - masterLineHeight) / 2;
		                for (let i = 0; i < linesCount; i++) {
		                    masterCtx.fillText(safeLines[i] || '', centerX, startY + i * masterLineHeight);
		                }
		            }

		            const bounds = findAlphaBounds(masterCtx, masterWidth, masterHeight);

		            cacheObj.masterCanvas = masterCanvas;
		            cacheObj.masterKey = masterKey;
		            cacheObj.masterWidth = masterWidth;
		            cacheObj.masterHeight = masterHeight;
		            cacheObj.masterSourceX = bounds.x;
		            cacheObj.masterSourceY = bounds.y;
		            cacheObj.masterSourceWidth = bounds.width;
		            cacheObj.masterSourceHeight = bounds.height;
		            cacheObj.masterFontSize = masterFontSize;

		            return cacheObj;
		        }

	        // ===== SPRITE-ERSTELLUNG =====
	        // Generische Funktion zum Erstellen eines gecachten Sprites.
	        // cacheObj: Referenz auf spriteCache oder bgSpriteCache
	        // keyPrefix: optionaler Prefix für den Cache-Key (z.B. 'bg_')
	        function createOrGetCachedSprite(cacheObj, keyPrefix, font, fontSize, color, symbolLines, lineHeight) {
	            const key = `${keyPrefix}${font}|${fontSize.toFixed(2)}|${color}|${symbolLines.join('\\n')}`;

	            // Cache-Hit: bestehendes Sprite zurückgeben
	            if (cacheObj.key === key && cacheObj.canvas) {
	                return cacheObj;
	            }

		            const safeLines = (symbolLines && symbolLines.length) ? symbolLines : [''];
		            const safeFontSize = Math.max(0, fontSize || 0);
		            const safeLineHeight = Math.max(0, lineHeight || 0);

		            let spriteCanvas = cacheObj.canvas;
		            if (!spriteCanvas) {
		                spriteCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
		            }

		            if (safeFontSize <= 0 || safeLineHeight <= 0) {
		                spriteCanvas.width = 1;
		                spriteCanvas.height = 1;
		                cacheObj.canvas = spriteCanvas;
		                cacheObj.key = key;
		                cacheObj.width = 1;
		                cacheObj.height = 1;
		                cacheObj.offsetX = 0.5;
		                cacheObj.offsetY = 0.5;
		                return cacheObj;
		            }

		            const lineHeightRatio = safeLineHeight / Math.max(safeFontSize, 0.0001);
		            createOrGetMasterSprite(cacheObj, keyPrefix, font, safeLines, lineHeightRatio);

		            const padding = CONFIG.sprite.padding;
		            const scaleFactor = safeFontSize / cacheObj.masterFontSize;
		            const contentWidth = Math.max(1, cacheObj.masterSourceWidth * scaleFactor);
		            const contentHeight = Math.max(1, cacheObj.masterSourceHeight * scaleFactor);
		            const spriteWidth = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(contentWidth + padding * 2));
		            const spriteHeight = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(contentHeight + padding * 2));

	            spriteCanvas.width = spriteWidth;
	            spriteCanvas.height = spriteHeight;

	            const spriteCtx = spriteCanvas.getContext('2d');
	            spriteCtx.clearRect(0, 0, spriteWidth, spriteHeight);
		            spriteCtx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
		            if ('imageSmoothingQuality' in spriteCtx) {
		                spriteCtx.imageSmoothingQuality = 'high';
		            }

		            // Schatten komplett deaktiviert
		            spriteCtx.shadowColor = 'transparent';
		            spriteCtx.shadowBlur = 0;
		            spriteCtx.shadowOffsetX = 0;
		            spriteCtx.shadowOffsetY = 0;

		            spriteCtx.drawImage(
		                cacheObj.masterCanvas,
		                cacheObj.masterSourceX,
		                cacheObj.masterSourceY,
		                cacheObj.masterSourceWidth,
		                cacheObj.masterSourceHeight,
		                padding,
		                padding,
		                contentWidth,
		                contentHeight
		            );

		            spriteCtx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-in';
		            spriteCtx.fillStyle = color;
		            spriteCtx.fillRect(0, 0, spriteWidth, spriteHeight);
		            spriteCtx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';

	            // Cache-Objekt in-place aktualisieren
	            cacheObj.canvas = spriteCanvas;
	            cacheObj.key = key;
	            cacheObj.width = spriteWidth;
	            cacheObj.height = spriteHeight;
	            cacheObj.offsetX = spriteWidth / 2;
	            cacheObj.offsetY = spriteHeight / 2;

	            return cacheObj;
	        }

	        // Wrapper für Punkt-Sprites
	        function getOrCreateSprite(font, fontSize, color, symbolLines, lineHeight) {
	            return createOrGetCachedSprite(spriteCache, '', font, fontSize, color, symbolLines, lineHeight);
	        }

	        // Initialisiert alle Eingabeelemente - jetzt vom Panel übernommen
	        function initializeUIFromConfig() {
	            // Panel ist bereits initialisiert mit Werten aus CONFIG
	            // BG-Controls initial ein-/ausblenden
