		    // === ORIENTIERUNGSHILFEN (aus Rotation abgeleitet) ===
		    function getOrientation(rotationDeg) {
		        if (typeof rotationDeg !== 'number' || !isFinite(rotationDeg)) return 'horizontal';
		        const r = ((rotationDeg % 360) + 360) % 360; // 0..360
		        const distTo90 = Math.min(Math.abs(r - 90), Math.abs(r - 270));
		        const distTo0  = Math.min(Math.abs(r), Math.abs(r - 180));
		        return distTo90 > distTo0 ? 'horizontal' : 'vertical';
		    }

		    function isVerticalMode() {
		        return getOrientation(params.rotation) === 'vertical';
		    }

		    function updateVerticalToggleUI() {
		        if (!verticalToggle) return;
		        const vertical = isVerticalMode();
		        verticalToggle.textContent = vertical ? 'An' : 'Aus';
		        verticalToggle.classList.toggle('active', vertical);
		        verticalToggle.setAttribute('aria-pressed', vertical ? 'true' : 'false');
		    }

		    // === ERZEUGE NORMALISIERTES GLYPH-BILD (HiDPI, optional gestreckt) ===
		    // Rendert Text DIREKT mit moderater Skalierung, damit die Canvas-Größe nicht explodiert
		    function createGlyphImage(text, fontFamily, fontSize, color = 'white', strokeOnly = false, stretchY = 1) {
		        // Moderate HiDPI-Skalierung (max. 2x) für Schärfe ohne riesige Canvas
		        const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
		        const scale = Math.min(2, Math.max(1, dpr));
		        const scaledFontSize = fontSize * scale;
		
		        // Canvas-Größe: proportional zur Fontgröße und Streckung, aber kompakt
		        const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
		        const safeStretch = Math.max(1, stretchY);
		        const padding = Math.ceil(scaledFontSize * 0.5);
		        const textLen = text && text.length ? text.length : 1;
		        const canvasWidth = Math.ceil(scaledFontSize * textLen) + padding * 2;
		        const canvasHeight = Math.ceil(scaledFontSize * safeStretch) + padding * 2;
            canvas.width = canvasWidth;
            canvas.height = canvasHeight;
            const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

            // Text DIREKT mit Skalierung rendern (nicht nachträglich strecken!)
            ctx.save();
            ctx.translate(padding, padding);
            ctx.scale(1, stretchY); // Vertikale Streckung VOR dem Zeichnen

            ctx.font = `${scaledFontSize}px ${fontFamily}`;
            ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
            ctx.textAlign = 'left';

            if (strokeOnly) {
                ctx.strokeStyle = color;
                ctx.lineWidth = scale;
                ctx.strokeText(text, 0, 0);
            } else {
                ctx.fillStyle = color;
                ctx.fillText(text, 0, 0);
            }
            ctx.restore();

            // Pixel scannen um Grenzen zu finden
            const imageData = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, canvasWidth, canvasHeight);
            const data = imageData.data;

            let minX = canvasWidth, maxX = 0, minY = canvasHeight, maxY = 0;

            for (let y = 0; y < canvasHeight; y++) {
                for (let x = 0; x < canvasWidth; x++) {
                    if (data[(y * canvasWidth + x) * 4 + 3] > 0) {
                        minX = Math.min(minX, x);
                        maxX = Math.max(maxX, x);
                        minY = Math.min(minY, y);
                        maxY = Math.max(maxY, y);
                    }
                }
            }

            // Falls keine Pixel gefunden (leerer Text)
            if (minX > maxX || minY > maxY) {
                return { dataUrl: '', width: 0, height: 0, scale };
            }

            // Gecropte Größe (bereits gestreckt!)
            const cropWidth = maxX - minX + 1;
            const cropHeight = maxY - minY + 1;

            const croppedCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
            croppedCanvas.width = cropWidth;
            croppedCanvas.height = cropHeight;
            const croppedCtx = croppedCanvas.getContext('2d');

            // Einfach kopieren - keine Streckung mehr nötig
            croppedCtx.drawImage(canvas, minX, minY, cropWidth, cropHeight, 0, 0, cropWidth, cropHeight);

            return {
                dataUrl: croppedCanvas.toDataURL('image/png'),
                // CSS-Größe = Canvas-Größe / scale
                width: cropWidth / scale,
                height: cropHeight / scale,
                scale
            };
        }

	        // === WERT-HELPER (HTML-Range-ähnliches Modell: min/max/step, value) ===
	        function getSliderRange(slider) {
	            let min = typeof slider.min === 'number' ? slider.min : 0;
	            let max = typeof slider.max === 'number' ? slider.max : 1;
	            const step = typeof slider.step === 'number' ? slider.step : 0;
	            if (max < min) {
	                const tmp = min;
	                min = max;
	                max = tmp;
	            }
	            return { min, max, step };
	        }

	        function valueToNormalized(slider, value) {
	            const { min, max } = getSliderRange(slider);
	            if (max <= min) return 0;
	            return (value - min) / (max - min);
	        }

	        function normalizedToValue(slider, norm) {
	            const { min, max } = getSliderRange(slider);
	            if (max <= min) return min;
	            return min + norm * (max - min);
	        }

	        // Setzt den logischen Slider-Wert (wie beim HTML-Range) und aktualisiert Geometrie
	        function setSliderValue(slider, newValue, options = {}) {
	            const { fromUser = false } = options; // wird später für Events genutzt
	            const { min, max, step } = getSliderRange(slider);
	            let v = typeof newValue === 'number' ? newValue : min;

	            // Clamp auf [min,max]
	            if (v < min) v = min;
	            if (v > max) v = max;

	            // Auf step runden (wenn sinnvoll definiert)
	            if (step > 0 && max > min) {
	                v = min + Math.round((v - min) / step) * step;
	                if (v < min) v = min;
	                if (v > max) v = max;
	            }

		            slider.value = v;
		            // Wenn es unser Hauptslider ist, synchronisieren wir das x-Eingabefeld mit
		            // dem aktuellen Wert (0..1 mit 3 Nachkommastellen).
		            if (slider === slider1 && xValueInput) {
		                xValueInput.value = v.toFixed(3);
		            }

	            // In Normalform [0,1] umrechnen
	            let norm = 0;
	            if (max > min) {
	                norm = (v - min) / (max - min);
	            }
	            norm = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, norm));
		            // "norm" ist die logische Benutzer-Norm (0 = links, 1 = rechts)
		            slider.currentValue = norm;
		
		            // Geometrie arbeitet mit invertierter Norm, damit 0 links und 1 rechts sind
		            const geoNorm = 1 - norm;
		            setThumbPosition(slider, geoNorm);

	            // Später: hier input/change-Events feuern, abhängig von fromUser
	            return v;
	        }

        // === RENDERE SLIDER-ELEMENTE ALS BILDER ===
		    function renderSliderImages(slider) {
		        const font = fontSelect.value;
		        const size = params.size;
		        const length = params.length;
		            const userRotation = params.rotation;
		        const thumbSize = size * 0.9;

		    // Erzeuge normalisierte Bilder - Track bereits gestreckt im Canvas!
		    const trackOutlineImg = createGlyphImage(slider.trackChar, font, size, 'white', true, length);
		    const trackFillImg = createGlyphImage(slider.trackChar, font, size, 'white', false, length);
		    const thumbImg = createGlyphImage(slider.thumbChar, font, thumbSize, 'white', false, 1);

		        // Container-Breite aus dem Layout (wie bei einem echten <input type="range">)
		        const containerRect = slider.container.getBoundingClientRect();
		        let containerWidth = containerRect.width;
		        if (!containerWidth || !isFinite(containerWidth)) {
		            // Fallback: benutze Glyph-Breite oder einen Default
		            containerWidth = trackOutlineImg.width || 600;
		        }

		        // Die sichtbare Slider-Achse soll sich an der Container-Breite orientieren
		        const axisLength = Math.max(10, containerWidth);

		            // Skaliere den Track so, dass seine logische Länge = axisLength ist.
		            // Die Länge der Bahn verläuft IMMER entlang der lokalen Y-Achse der Glyphe,
		            // daher normieren wir konsequent auf die Glyphen-Höhe.
		            let scaleForTrack = 1;
		            const natLength = trackOutlineImg.height || 1;
		            scaleForTrack = axisLength / natLength;

		        // Gleicher Scale für Thumb, damit Proportionen stimmen
		        const trackWidth = trackOutlineImg.width * scaleForTrack;
		        const trackHeight = trackOutlineImg.height * scaleForTrack;
		        const thumbWidth = thumbImg.width * scaleForTrack;
		        const thumbHeight = thumbImg.height * scaleForTrack;

	            slider.trackWidth = trackWidth;
	            slider.trackHeight = trackHeight;
	            slider.thumbWidth = thumbWidth;
	            slider.thumbHeight = thumbHeight;

	            // Container-Höhe = Drag-Bereich: exakt so hoch wie der Thumb
	            // (plus minimale Untergrenze, falls Thumb extrem klein wäre)
	            const dragHeight = Math.max(thumbHeight, 10);
	            slider.container.style.height = dragHeight + 'px';

	            const containerCenterX = containerWidth / 2;
	            const containerCenterY = dragHeight / 2;

	            // Internes Winkelmodell:
	            // - "userRotation" ist der Wert aus dem UI, bei dem 0° eine aufrechte 1 ergibt
	            // - Wir verschieben intern um +90°, damit 0° UI einer vertikalen Achse (oben/unten) entspricht.
	            // - "baseRotation" beschreibt damit die tatsächliche Slider-Achse (in Mathe-Koordinaten):
	            //     0°  = nach rechts, 90° = nach oben, 180° = nach links, 270° = nach unten.
	            // - Diese Achse nutzen wir sowohl zum Drehen der Glyphe als auch für Drag + Debug-Linie.
	            const baseRotation = (userRotation + 90) % 360; // 0° UI => 90° intern (vertikal nach oben)
	            const glyphRotation = baseRotation;

	            // Track-Outline setzen
	            slider.trackOutline.style.backgroundImage = `url(${trackOutlineImg.dataUrl})`;
	            slider.trackOutline.style.width = trackWidth + 'px';
	            slider.trackOutline.style.height = trackHeight + 'px';
	            slider.trackOutline.style.left = containerCenterX + 'px';
	            slider.trackOutline.style.top = containerCenterY + 'px';
	            // Glyphen-Rotation: 0° UI = aufrecht, 90°-Slide dreht nur das Zeichen
	            slider.trackOutline.style.transform = `translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(${glyphRotation - 90}deg)`;

	            // Track-Fill setzen
	            slider.trackFill.style.backgroundImage = `url(${trackFillImg.dataUrl})`;
	            slider.trackFill.style.width = trackWidth + 'px';
	            slider.trackFill.style.height = trackHeight + 'px';
	            slider.trackFill.style.left = containerCenterX + 'px';
	            slider.trackFill.style.top = containerCenterY + 'px';
	            slider.trackFill.style.transform = `translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(${glyphRotation - 90}deg)`;

	            // Thumb setzen
	            slider.thumb.style.backgroundImage = `url(${thumbImg.dataUrl})`;
	            slider.thumb.style.width = thumbWidth + 'px';
	            slider.thumb.style.height = thumbHeight + 'px';

	            // Berechne Slider-Bounds
	            // Slide-Achse: läuft entlang der Glyphen-Achse (baseRotation)
	            const slideRot = baseRotation;
	            const halfRange = axisLength / 2;

	            slider.bounds = {
	                centerX: containerCenterX,
	                centerY: containerCenterY,
	                halfRange,
	                trackLength: axisLength,
	                slideRotation: slideRot
	            };

	            // Thumb initial positionieren – aktuellen Wert im HTML-Sinne auf die Geometrie mappen
	            const range = getSliderRange(slider);
	            const initialValue = (typeof slider.value === 'number')
	                ? slider.value
	                : (range.min + range.max) / 2;
	            setSliderValue(slider, initialValue);

	            return slider.bounds;
	        }

	    // === POSITIONIERE DEN THUMB (value = 0 bis 1) ===
		    function setThumbPosition(slider, value) {
		        if (!slider.bounds) return;
		
			        // Wert begrenzen (Geo-Norm 0..1)
			        value = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, value));
		
			        // Offset vom Zentrum (-halfRange bis +halfRange), "value" ist hier die Geo-Norm
		        const offset = (value - 0.5) * 2 * slider.bounds.halfRange;
		
		        // Slide-Richtung aus bounds
		        const slideRot = slider.bounds.slideRotation;
		        const rotRad = slideRot * Math.PI / 180;
		
		        // Position entlang der rotierten Achse (das ist das ZENTRUM des Thumbs)
		        const thumbCenterX = slider.bounds.centerX + offset * Math.cos(rotRad);
		        const thumbCenterY = slider.bounds.centerY + offset * Math.sin(rotRad);
		
		        // CSS Position - Thumb hat transform: translate(-50%, -50%)
		        // Also ist left/top direkt das Zentrum!
		        slider.thumb.style.left = thumbCenterX + 'px';
		        slider.thumb.style.top = thumbCenterY + 'px';
		
		            // Debug: Thumb-Fadenkreuz positionieren (genau im berechneten Zentrum)
		            const crossSize = parseFloat(slider.thumbCenterCross.style.width) || 24;
		            slider.thumbCenterCross.style.left = (thumbCenterX - crossSize / 2) + 'px';
		            slider.thumbCenterCross.style.top = (thumbCenterY - crossSize / 2) + 'px';
		
		            // Füllung der Track aktualisieren
		            // Vereinfachte Variante: die Füllkante bewegt sich immer ENTLANG der Bahn
		            // und schneidet diese exakt im Thumb-Zentrum – unabhängig vom Winkel.
		            const trackHeight = slider.trackHeight || 0;
		            let clipPathValue = '';
		
		            if (trackHeight > 0) {
		                // value: 0   -> Clip oben   = 0%  (Kante am einen Ende der Bahn)
		                // value: 0.5 -> Clip oben   = 50% (Kante in der Mitte)
		                // value: 1   -> Clip oben   = 100% (Kante am anderen Ende)
		                // Da trackHeight == geometrische Länge der Bahn ist,
		                // liegt die Kante damit immer exakt auf dem Thumb.
		                const clipPercent = value * 100;
		                clipPathValue = `inset(${clipPercent}% 0 0 0)`;
		            }
		
		        if (clipPathValue) {
		            slider.trackFill.style.clipPath = clipPathValue;
		        }
		
		        // Debug: Füll-Ursprung (Übergang) = immer exakt auf dem Thumb (blaues Kreuz)
		        if (slider.fillOriginCross && slider.bounds) {
		            const originSize = crossSize;
		            slider.fillOriginCross.style.width  = originSize + 'px';
		            slider.fillOriginCross.style.height = originSize + 'px';
		            slider.fillOriginCross.style.setProperty(
		                '--line-width',
		                (parseFloat(getComputedStyle(slider.thumbCenterCross)
		                    .getPropertyValue('--line-width')) || 2) + 'px'
		            );
		            slider.fillOriginCross.style.left = (thumbCenterX - originSize / 2) + 'px';
		            slider.fillOriginCross.style.top  = (thumbCenterY - originSize / 2) + 'px';
		        }
		    }

		        // === SCHLANGEN-WERTANZEIGE (0.xxxx mit Wobble) ===
		        // Basis-Längenfunktion: 0..1 → 1..N Zeichen.
		        // N (Anzahl der Schritte/Auflösung) ist einstellbar über params.resolutionSteps.
		        // Die Anzahl der Zeichen selbst wobbel nicht, nur die Y-Position.
		        function getBaseChainLength(norm) {
		            const stepsParam = typeof params.resolutionSteps === 'number' ? params.resolutionSteps : 9;
		            const steps = Math.max(1, Math.round(stepsParam));
		            let raw = Math.round(norm * steps); // 0..steps
		            if (raw < 1) raw = 1;
		            if (raw > steps) raw = steps;
		            return raw;
		        }

		        // Approximierte Schrittweite (Pixel) für ein Zeichen der Schlange (x)
		        let slider1CharStep = null;
		        function getSlider1CharStep() {
		            if (slider1CharStep && slider1CharStep > 0) return slider1CharStep;
		            if (!slider1ValueDisplay) return 12;
		            const probe = document.createElement('span');
		            probe.textContent = 'x';
		            probe.style.visibility = 'hidden';
		            probe.style.position = 'absolute';
		            probe.style.whiteSpace = 'nowrap';
		            slider1ValueDisplay.appendChild(probe);
		            const rect = probe.getBoundingClientRect();
		            slider1CharStep = rect.width || 12;
		            slider1ValueDisplay.removeChild(probe);
		            return slider1CharStep;
		        }
			
		        // Baut die 0.xxxx-Schlange als HTML-Spans, die wie eine 2D-Schlange innerhalb
		        // der Anzeige-Fläche unterwegs ist: Zeichen hängen aneinander, die Textrichtung
		        // kann sich ändern und die Schlange verlässt ihre Ausgangszeile.
		        function updateSlider1Display(time) {
		            if (!slider1ValueDisplay) return;
		            const norm = typeof slider1.currentValue === 'number' ? slider1.currentValue : 0;
				
		            // Arbeitsfläche ist jetzt der gesamte Viewport (die Schlange darf über den ganzen
		            // Screen laufen, unabhängig von der ursprünglichen Container-Höhe)
		            const width = window.innerWidth || slider1ValueDisplay.clientWidth || 800;
		            const height = window.innerHeight || slider1ValueDisplay.clientHeight || 120;
		            const centerX = width / 2;
		            const centerY = height / 2;
		            const step = getSlider1CharStep();
		            const edgeMargin = 16; // etwas Luft zum Rand
		            const leftLimit = edgeMargin;
		            const rightLimit = width - edgeMargin;
		            const topLimit = edgeMargin;
		            const bottomLimit = height - edgeMargin;
				
		            // Exakte Enden: 0 und 1, zentriert in der Mitte der Anzeige
		            if (norm <= 0) {
		                slider1ValueDisplay.innerHTML = `
		                    <div class="slider-value-display-inner">
		                        <span class="anchor" style="left:${centerX}px; top:${centerY}px; transform:translate(-50%, -50%);">0</span>
		                    </div>
		                `;
		                return;
		            }
		            if (norm >= 1) {
		                slider1ValueDisplay.innerHTML = `
		                    <div class="slider-value-display-inner">
		                        <span class="anchor" style="left:${centerX}px; top:${centerY}px; transform:translate(-50%, -50%);">1</span>
		                    </div>
		                `;
		                return;
		            }
				
		            const len = getBaseChainLength(norm);
			
		            // --- Physikalisches Wobble ---
		            // Grundidee:
		            // - Im Stand nahezu keine Eigenbewegung.
		            // - Bewegung des Sliders pumpt Energie in das System.
			
		            // Initialisierung der internen Zustände
		            if (typeof slider1._lastNorm !== 'number') {
		                slider1._lastNorm = norm;
		                slider1._vel = 0;
		                slider1._energy = 0;
		                slider1._phaseJitter = 0;
		            }
			
		            // Geschwindigkeitsänderung seit letztem Frame
		            const vel = norm - slider1._lastNorm;
		            slider1._lastNorm = norm;
			
		            // Instant-Energie aus aktueller Geschwindigkeitsänderung
		            const instantEnergy = Math.min(1, Math.abs(vel) * 400);
			
		            // Energie langsam auf- und abbauen (Dämpfung)
		            const energyDecay = 0.9;
		            slider1._energy = (slider1._energy || 0) * energyDecay + instantEnergy;
		            if (slider1.isDragging) {
		                slider1._energy = Math.min(1, slider1._energy + 0.02);
		            }
		            const energy = slider1._energy;
			
		            // Leichte zufällige Phase, abhängig von der Energie (mehr Chaos bei mehr Input)
		            slider1._phaseJitter = (slider1._phaseJitter || 0) * 0.9
		                + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5 * energy;
			
		            // Amplitude: praktisch 0 bei keiner Energie, kräftig bei viel Energie.
		            // Richtung 1 (norm hoch) verstärkt zusätzlich.
		            const maxAmp = 16; // maximale Amplitude in px
		            const amp = maxAmp * energy * (0.3 + norm * 0.7);
			
		            const baseSpeed = 0.004;
		            const extraSpeed = 0.018 * energy;
		            const speed = baseSpeed + extraSpeed;
		            const t = (typeof time === 'number' ? time : performance.now()) * speed;
			
		            // Zeichenkette: erst der Punkt, dann len-mal 'x'
		            const chars = ['.'];
		            for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) chars.push('x');
			
		            // 2D-Schlangenpfad: wir starten an der 0 in der Mitte und laufen in einem
		            // Winkel los. Der Winkel wird über Zeit und Energie leicht verbogen
		            // und an den Rändern reflektiert (wie ein Lichtstrahl).
		            const positions = [];
		            let angle = 0; // 0rad = nach rechts
		            let x = centerX;
		            let y = centerY;
		            for (let i = 0; i < chars.length; i++) {
		                const idx = i; // 0 = Punkt, 1..len = x-Segmente
		                const ratio = len <= 1 ? 1 : Math.max(0, (idx - 1)) / Math.max(1, len - 1);
		                const bendStrength = 0.4 + 0.8 * energy; // wie stark die Schlange abknicken darf
		                const localNoise = Math.sin(t + idx * 0.5 + slider1._phaseJitter * 2.0);
		                angle += localNoise * bendStrength * 0.3; // kleine Krümmel in den Winkel
				
		                let dx = Math.cos(angle);
		                let dy = Math.sin(angle);
		                let nx = x + dx * step;
		                let ny = y + dy * step;
				
		                // Reflektion an allen vier Rändern der Arbeitsfläche
		                let reflected = false;
		                if (nx < leftLimit || nx > rightLimit) {
		                    dx = -dx;
		                    reflected = true;
		                }
		                if (ny < topLimit || ny > bottomLimit) {
		                    dy = -dy;
		                    reflected = true;
		                }
		                if (reflected) {
		                    nx = x + dx * step;
		                    ny = y + dy * step;
		                    angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
		                }
				
		                positions.push({ x: nx, y: ny, ch: chars[i], angle });
		                x = nx;
		                y = ny;
		            }
			
		            // HTML aufbauen: Anker "0" bleibt im Zentrum, die Kette folgt dem 2D-Pfad und
		            // reagiert zusätzlich auf Maus/Touch (Schlange wird in einem Radius weggedrückt).
		            let chainHtml = '';
		            for (let i = 0; i < positions.length; i++) {
		                const p = positions[i];
		                const isX = p.ch === 'x';
		                let extraWobble = 0;
		                if (isX) {
		                    const segIndex = i - 1;
		                    const ratio = len <= 1 ? 1 : segIndex / Math.max(1, len - 1);
		                    const stiffness = 0.3 + ratio * 0.7;
		                    const phase = segIndex * 0.6 + slider1._phaseJitter * (0.3 + ratio);
		                    extraWobble = Math.sin(t + phase) * amp * stiffness;
		                }

		                // Pointer-Einfluss: in der Nähe von Maus/Touch wird die Schlange leicht weggedrückt.
		                let offsetX = 0;
		                let offsetY = extraWobble;
		                if (snakePointer && snakePointer.active) {
		                    const dxp = p.x - snakePointer.x;
		                    const dyp = p.y - snakePointer.y;
		                    const dist = Math.hypot(dxp, dyp) || 1e-6;
		                    const influenceRadius = Math.min(width, height) * 0.25;
		                    if (dist < influenceRadius) {
		                        const strength = 1 - dist / influenceRadius; // 0..1
		                        const basePush = 40; // in px
		                        const push = basePush * strength * (0.3 + energy * 0.7);
		                        offsetX += (dxp / dist) * push;
		                        offsetY += (dyp / dist) * push;
		                    }
		                }

		                const angleDeg = (p.angle * 180) / Math.PI;
		                chainHtml += `
		                    <span class="seg" style="left:${p.x.toFixed(1)}px; top:${p.y.toFixed(1)}px; transform:translate(-50%, -50%) translate(${offsetX.toFixed(2)}px, ${offsetY.toFixed(2)}px) rotate(${angleDeg.toFixed(1)}deg);">${p.ch}</span>
		                `;
		            }
			
		            const html = `
		                <div class="slider-value-display-inner">
		                    <span class="anchor" style="left:${centerX}px; top:${centerY}px; transform:translate(-50%, -50%);">0</span>
		                    ${chainHtml}
		                </div>
		            `;
			
		            slider1ValueDisplay.innerHTML = html;
		        }

	        function animationLoop(time) {
	            updateSlider1Display(time);
	            requestAnimationFrame(animationLoop);
	        }

        // === STEPPER BUTTONS (wie in shadows.html) ===
		    document.querySelectorAll('.stepper-btn').forEach(btn => {
		        const paramKey = btn.dataset.param;
		        const cfg = PARAMS_CONFIG[paramKey];
		        if (!cfg) return;
		
			        const stepOnce = (isPlus) => {
			            const direction = isPlus ? 1 : -1;
			            const current = typeof params[paramKey] === 'number' ? params[paramKey] : cfg.default;
			            let newVal = current + direction * cfg.step;
		
		            // Rotation Wraparound
		            if (paramKey === 'rotation') {
		                newVal = ((newVal % 360) + 360) % 360;
		            } else {
		                newVal = Math.max(cfg.min, Math.min(cfg.max, newVal));
		            }
		
		            // Rundung
		            const factor = Math.pow(10, cfg.decimals);
		            newVal = Math.round(newVal * factor) / factor;
		
			            params[paramKey] = newVal;
			            const inputEl = document.getElementById(cfg.id);
			            if (inputEl) inputEl.value = newVal;
			            updateStyles();
			            if (paramKey === 'rotation') {
			                updateVerticalToggleUI();
			            }
		        };
		
		        // Einfacher, robuster: ein Klick = ein Schritt. Funktioniert auf Maus & Touch.
		        btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
		            e.preventDefault();
		            const isPlus = btn.classList.contains('plus');
		            stepOnce(isPlus);
		        });
		    });

        // === INPUT FIELDS ===
        document.querySelectorAll('.value-input').forEach(input => {
            const paramKey = input.dataset.param;
            const cfg = PARAMS_CONFIG[paramKey];
            if (!cfg) return;

            input.addEventListener('change', () => {
                let val = parseFloat(input.value.replace(',', '.'));
                if (isNaN(val)) val = cfg.default;

                // Rotation Wraparound
                if (paramKey === 'rotation') {
                    val = ((val % 360) + 360) % 360;
                } else {
                    val = Math.max(cfg.min, Math.min(cfg.max, val));
                }

		                params[paramKey] = val;
		                input.value = val;
		                updateStyles();
		                if (paramKey === 'rotation') {
		                    updateVerticalToggleUI();
		                }
            });
        });

	        // Spezielles Eingabefeld f�fcr x (Slider-Wert 0..1)
	        if (xValueInput) {
	            const startVal = typeof slider1.value === 'number' ? slider1.value : 0.5;
	            xValueInput.value = startVal.toFixed(3);

	            xValueInput.addEventListener('change', () => {
	                let v = parseFloat(xValueInput.value.replace(',', '.'));
	                if (!isFinite(v)) v = slider1.min;
	                if (v < slider1.min) v = slider1.min;
	                if (v > slider1.max) v = slider1.max;
	                setSliderValue(slider1, v, { fromUser: true });
	            });
	        }

        // Font-Select
        fontSelect.addEventListener('change', updateStyles);

        // Track/Thumb Character Inputs
        trackCharInput.addEventListener('input', () => {
            slider1.trackChar = trackCharInput.value || '1';
            updateStyles();
        });

        thumbCharInput.addEventListener('input', () => {
            slider1.thumbChar = thumbCharInput.value || '0';
            updateStyles();
        });

        // === SLIDER THUMB DRAG (einfach mit mousedown/mousemove) ===
		        sliders.forEach(slider => {
		            slider.thumb.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
                slider.isDragging = true;
                slider.dragStartPos = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY };
	                const range = getSliderRange(slider);
	                const currentVal = (typeof slider.value === 'number')
	                    ? slider.value
	                    : (range.min + range.max) / 2;
	                slider.dragStartValue = currentVal; // logischer Wert
	                slider.dragStartNorm = slider.currentValue ?? valueToNormalized(slider, currentVal);
                e.preventDefault();
            });

	            // Touch-Drag auf dem Thumb (Mobil)
	            slider.thumb.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
	                const t = e.touches && e.touches[0];
	                if (!t) return;
	                slider.isDragging = true;
	                slider.dragStartPos = { x: t.clientX, y: t.clientY };
	                const range = getSliderRange(slider);
	                const currentVal = (typeof slider.value === 'number')
	                    ? slider.value
	                    : (range.min + range.max) / 2;
	                slider.dragStartValue = currentVal; // logischer Wert
	                slider.dragStartNorm = slider.currentValue ?? valueToNormalized(slider, currentVal);
	                e.preventDefault();
	            }, { passive: false });

		            // Klick auf die Bahn / den Container: Wert wie beim HTML-Slider setzen
		            // und direkt in einen Drag übergehen
			            slider.container.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
			                // Wenn direkt auf dem Thumb geklickt wurde, übernimmt der Thumb-Handler
			                if (e.target === slider.thumb) return;
			                if (!slider.bounds) return;
			
			                const rect = slider.container.getBoundingClientRect();
			                const px = e.clientX - rect.left;  // Position im Container-Koordinatensystem
			                const py = e.clientY - rect.top;
			
			                // Abstand vom Track-Zentrum
			                const dx = px - slider.bounds.centerX;
			                const dy = py - slider.bounds.centerY;
			
			                // Auf die Slider-Achse (rote Linie) projizieren, egal wie rotiert
			                const rotRad = slider.bounds.slideRotation * Math.PI / 180;
			                const proj = dx * Math.cos(rotRad) + dy * Math.sin(rotRad);
				
			                const halfRange = slider.bounds.halfRange;
			                const fullRange = halfRange * 2;
			                if (fullRange <= 0) return;
				
			                // proj liefert eine Geo-Norm (0..1 entlang der Achse). Für den Benutzer
			                // soll 0 links und 1 rechts sein, daher invertieren wir auf userNorm.
			                let geoNorm = 0.5 + (proj / fullRange); // 0..1 entlang der Bahn
			                geoNorm = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, geoNorm));
			                const userNorm = 1 - geoNorm;
				
			                const newValue = normalizedToValue(slider, userNorm);
			                setSliderValue(slider, newValue, { fromUser: true });
			
			                // Direktes Drag-Verhalten wie beim nativen Slider:
			                // Wir starten jetzt einen Drag an genau dieser Position.
			                slider.isDragging = true;
			                slider.dragStartPos = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY };
			                slider.dragStartValue = newValue;
			                slider.dragStartNorm = slider.currentValue ?? userNorm;
			
			                e.preventDefault();
			            });

		            // Touch auf Bahn/Container: wie Maus-Klick plus anschließender Drag
		            slider.container.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
		                const t = e.touches && e.touches[0];
		                if (!t) return;
		                if (t.target === slider.thumb) return;
		                if (!slider.bounds) return;
		
		                const rect = slider.container.getBoundingClientRect();
		                const px = t.clientX - rect.left;
		                const py = t.clientY - rect.top;
		
		                const dx = px - slider.bounds.centerX;
		                const dy = py - slider.bounds.centerY;
		                const rotRad = slider.bounds.slideRotation * Math.PI / 180;
		                const proj = dx * Math.cos(rotRad) + dy * Math.sin(rotRad);
		                const halfRange = slider.bounds.halfRange;
		                const fullRange = halfRange * 2;
		                if (fullRange <= 0) return;
		
		                let geoNorm = 0.5 + (proj / fullRange);
		                geoNorm = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, geoNorm));
		                const userNorm = 1 - geoNorm;
		                const newValue = normalizedToValue(slider, userNorm);
		                setSliderValue(slider, newValue, { fromUser: true });
		
		                slider.isDragging = true;
		                slider.dragStartPos = { x: t.clientX, y: t.clientY };
		                slider.dragStartValue = newValue;
		                slider.dragStartNorm = slider.currentValue ?? userNorm;
		
		                e.preventDefault();
		            }, { passive: false });
        });

        document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
            sliders.forEach(slider => {
                if (!slider.isDragging || !slider.dragStartPos) return;
                if (!slider.bounds) return;

                const dx = e.clientX - slider.dragStartPos.x;
                const dy = e.clientY - slider.dragStartPos.y;

                const slideRot = slider.bounds.slideRotation;
                const rotRad = slideRot * Math.PI / 180;
	
		                const movement = dx * Math.cos(rotRad) + dy * Math.sin(rotRad);
		                const fullRange = slider.bounds.halfRange * 2;
		                const deltaGeo = fullRange > 0 ? movement / fullRange : 0;
		
		                // dragStartNorm und currentValue speichern die Benutzer-Norm (0 = links, 1 = rechts).
		                // Die Geometrie-Norm l�ufuht umgekehrt, daher �e4ndert sich User-Norm mit -deltaGeo.
		                const startUserNorm = typeof slider.dragStartNorm === 'number'
		                    ? slider.dragStartNorm
		                    : (slider.currentValue ?? 0.5);
		                const newUserNorm = startUserNorm - deltaGeo;
		                const newValue = normalizedToValue(slider, newUserNorm);
		
		                setSliderValue(slider, newValue, { fromUser: true });
            });
        });

	        // Touch-Move: gleiche Logik wie Mouse-Move, nur mit Touch-Koordinaten
	        document.addEventListener('touchmove', (e) => {
	            const t = e.touches && e.touches[0];
	            if (!t) return;
	            sliders.forEach(slider => {
	                if (!slider.isDragging || !slider.dragStartPos) return;
	                if (!slider.bounds) return;
	
	                const dx = t.clientX - slider.dragStartPos.x;
	                const dy = t.clientY - slider.dragStartPos.y;
	                const slideRot = slider.bounds.slideRotation;
	                const rotRad = slideRot * Math.PI / 180;
	                const movement = dx * Math.cos(rotRad) + dy * Math.sin(rotRad);
	                const fullRange = slider.bounds.halfRange * 2;
	                const deltaGeo = fullRange > 0 ? movement / fullRange : 0;
	
	                const startUserNorm = typeof slider.dragStartNorm === 'number'
	                    ? slider.dragStartNorm
	                    : (slider.currentValue ?? 0.5);
	                const newUserNorm = startUserNorm - deltaGeo;
	                const newValue = normalizedToValue(slider, newUserNorm);
	                setSliderValue(slider, newValue, { fromUser: true });
	            });
	            e.preventDefault();
	        }, { passive: false });

        document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
            sliders.forEach(slider => {
                slider.isDragging = false;
                slider.dragStartPos = null;
            });
        });

	        document.addEventListener('touchend', () => {
	            sliders.forEach(slider => {
	                slider.isDragging = false;
	                slider.dragStartPos = null;
	            });
	        });

	        document.addEventListener('touchcancel', () => {
	            sliders.forEach(slider => {
	                slider.isDragging = false;
	                slider.dragStartPos = null;
	            });
	        });

	        // === GLOBALE MAUS-/TOUCH-EINGABE FÜR DIE SCHLANGE ===
	        function updateSnakePointerFromEvent(clientX, clientY, active) {
	            if (!snakePointer) return;
	            snakePointer.active = active;
	            snakePointer.x = clientX;
	            snakePointer.y = clientY;
	            if (active) {
	                // Ein bisschen Energie in die Schlange pumpen, auch wenn der Slider stillsteht
	                slider1._energy = Math.min(1, (slider1._energy || 0) + 0.03);
	            }
	        }

	        // Maus-Ereignisse: bewegen und klicken lassen die Schlange reagieren
	        window.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
	            updateSnakePointerFromEvent(e.clientX, e.clientY, true);
	        });

	        window.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
	            updateSnakePointerFromEvent(e.clientX, e.clientY, true);
	        });

	        window.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
	            if (!snakePointer) return;
	            snakePointer.active = false;
	        });

	        window.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
	            if (!snakePointer) return;
	            snakePointer.active = false;
	        });

	        // Touch-Ereignisse: volle Mobil-Unterstützung
	        window.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
	            const t = e.touches && e.touches[0];
	            if (!t) return;
	            updateSnakePointerFromEvent(t.clientX, t.clientY, true);
	        }, { passive: true });

	        window.addEventListener('touchmove', (e) => {
	            const t = e.touches && e.touches[0];
	            if (!t) return;
	            updateSnakePointerFromEvent(t.clientX, t.clientY, true);
	        }, { passive: true });

	            if (!snakePointer) return;
	            snakePointer.active = false;
	        });

	            if (!snakePointer) return;
	            snakePointer.active = false;
	        });

	        // Start der kontinuierlichen Anzeige-Animation für den Slider-Wert (0.xxxx mit Wobble)

	    const dragHandle = document.querySelector('.settings-header');
	    const settingsBody = document.querySelector('.settings-body');
	    let isPanelDragging = false;
	    let panelDragStart = { x: 0, y: 0 };
	    let panelStartPos = { x: 0, y: 0 };

	    function updateSettingsBodyHeight() {
	        if (!settingsPanel || !settingsBody) return;
	        const rect = settingsPanel.getBoundingClientRect();
	        const headerHeight = (dragHandle && dragHandle.offsetHeight) || 40;
	        const availableHeight = window.innerHeight - rect.top - headerHeight - 8;
	        if (availableHeight > 0) {
	            settingsBody.style.maxHeight = availableHeight + 'px';
	        }

	        settingsPanel.classList.add('dragging');

	        const rect = settingsPanel.getBoundingClientRect();
	        panelDragStart = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY };
	        panelStartPos = { x: rect.left, y: rect.top };

	        // Transform entfernen für absolute Positionierung
	        settingsPanel.style.transform = 'none';
	        settingsPanel.style.left = rect.left + 'px';
	        settingsPanel.style.top = rect.top + 'px';

	        e.preventDefault();
	    });

	        if (!isPanelDragging) return;

	        const dx = e.clientX - panelDragStart.x;
	        const dy = e.clientY - panelDragStart.y;
	        let newLeft = panelStartPos.x + dx;
	        let newTop = panelStartPos.y + dy;

	        // Begrenzen:
	        // - horizontal komplett im Viewport lassen
	        // - vertikal: Panel immer voll im Viewport halten,
	        //   Hhe dynamisch begrenzen und innen scrollen
	        const maxLeft = Math.max(0, window.innerWidth - settingsPanel.offsetWidth);
	        const minLeft = 0;
	        newLeft = Math.max(minLeft, Math.min(maxLeft, newLeft));

	        const minTop = 0; // nicht nach oben raus
	        const headerHeight = (dragHandle && dragHandle.offsetHeight) || 40;
	        const maxTop = Math.max(0, window.innerHeight - headerHeight - 8);
	        newTop = Math.max(minTop, Math.min(maxTop, newTop));

	        // Sichtbare H6he des scrollbaren Inhalts anpassen,
	        // damit der Inhalt scrollbar bleibt, wenn wenig Platz ist
	        const availableHeight = window.innerHeight - newTop - headerHeight - 8;
	        if (settingsBody && availableHeight > 0) {
	            settingsBody.style.maxHeight = availableHeight + 'px';
	        }

	        settingsPanel.style.left = newLeft + 'px';
	        settingsPanel.style.top = newTop + 'px';
	    });

	    // Initial & bei Resize: H�0fhe des scrollbaren Bereichs anpassen
	    updateSettingsBodyHeight();
	    window.addEventListener('resize', updateSettingsBodyHeight);

	    document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
	        if (isPanelDragging) {
	            isPanelDragging = false;
	            settingsPanel.classList.remove('dragging');
	        }
	    });

const canvas = document.getElementById("c");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

// ---------- PLAYFIELD BOUNDS (respektiert Menü) ----------
let bounds = { left: 0, top: 0, right: innerWidth, bottom: innerHeight };

// Bestimme die sichtbare rechte Kante des Spielfelds.
// Wichtig: das Menü kann per CSS transformiert/animiert sein, dann ist offsetWidth
// NICHT gleich der sichtbaren Breite. getBoundingClientRect() ist hier stabiler.
function getRightBoundFromMenu() {
  const menu = document.querySelector('.menu');
  if (!menu) return innerWidth;
  const rect = menu.getBoundingClientRect();
  // Wenn das Menü komplett außerhalb (rechts) ist, soll es keine Bounds wegnehmen.
  if (!rect || rect.width <= 0 || rect.left >= innerWidth) return innerWidth;
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(innerWidth, rect.left));
}

function updateBounds() {
  bounds.left = 0;
  // Oben wirklich bis zum sichtbaren Rand (keine Buttons dort)
  bounds.top = 0;
  // Rechts endet das sichtbare Spielfeld an der linken Kante des Menüs
  bounds.right = getRightBoundFromMenu();
  bounds.bottom = innerHeight;
}

function resize() {
  canvas.width = innerWidth;
  canvas.height = innerHeight;
  updateBounds();
}
addEventListener("resize", resize);

// Menü-Änderungen beobachten
function observeMenu() {
  const menu = document.querySelector('.menu');
  if (!menu) return;
  const observer = new MutationObserver(updateBounds);
  observer.observe(menu, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });
}
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  observeMenu();
  updateBounds();
});
resize();

// ---------- PARAMETERS (live anpassbar) ----------
	let SEGMENTS = 80;           // Centerline-Segmente (unabhängig von Windungen)
	let STIFF = 0.35;            // Längen-Feder (Achse)
	let DAMP = 0.18;
	let GRAVITY = 0.0;
	let BEND = 0.25;             // Biege-"Stab" (glättet Krümmung)
	let DIAMETER = 50;           // Breite des Slinkys
	let WIRE = 3;                // Strangdicke / Pitch in Ruhe
	let TURNS = 18;              // echte Anzahl Ringe (Option A)
	let BOUNCE = 0.4;
	let FRICTION = 0.9;

	// Abgeleitet
	let REST = 3;                // wird aus (TURNS*WIRE)/(SEGMENTS-1) berechnet
	let RADIUS = DIAMETER / 2;
	function updateDerived() {
	  RADIUS = DIAMETER / 2;
	  const L0 = Math.max(1e-6, TURNS * WIRE);
	  REST = L0 / Math.max(1, (SEGMENTS - 1));
	}
	updateDerived();

	// ---------- 3D STATE ----------
	let pts=[], grabbed=null;
	let projCache=[]; // pro Frame: projizierte Screen-Positionen für Picking

	// Kamera (sehr simple Orbit-Kamera)
	const cam = {
	  yaw: 0.8,
	  pitch: 0.25,
	  dist: 900,
	  fov: 700,
	  target: { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 },
	  pos: { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 },
	  right: { x: 1, y: 0, z: 0 },
	  up: { x: 0, y: -1, z: 0 },
	  fwd: { x: 0, y: 0, z: 1 }
	};

	function dot(a,b){return a.x*b.x+a.y*b.y+a.z*b.z}
	function cross(a,b){return {x:a.y*b.z-a.z*b.y, y:a.z*b.x-a.x*b.z, z:a.x*b.y-a.y*b.x}}
	function len(a){return Math.hypot(a.x,a.y,a.z)}
	function norm(a){const l=len(a)||1e-9; return {x:a.x/l,y:a.y/l,z:a.z/l}}
	function sub(a,b){return {x:a.x-b.x,y:a.y-b.y,z:a.z-b.z}}
	function add(a,b){return {x:a.x+b.x,y:a.y+b.y,z:a.z+b.z}}
		function scale(a,s){return {x:a.x*s,y:a.y*s,z:a.z*s}}
	function dist(a,b){return Math.hypot(a.x-b.x,a.y-b.y,a.z-b.z)}
	function clamp(v,lo,hi){return Math.max(lo,Math.min(hi,v))}

	function rotateAroundAxis(v, axis, angle){
	  // Rodrigues
	  const a = norm(axis);
	  const cos = Math.cos(angle), sin = Math.sin(angle);
	  const d = dot(a, v);
	  const c = cross(a, v);
	  return {
	    x: v.x*cos + c.x*sin + a.x*d*(1-cos),
	    y: v.y*cos + c.y*sin + a.y*d*(1-cos),
	    z: v.z*cos + c.z*sin + a.z*d*(1-cos)
	  };
	}

	function updateCamera(){
	  // Welt-"up" für Bildschirm: y nach unten => up ist -y
	  const upWorld = {x:0,y:-1,z:0};
	  const cp=Math.cos(cam.pitch), sp=Math.sin(cam.pitch);
	  const cy=Math.cos(cam.yaw), sy=Math.sin(cam.yaw);
	  // forward vom Kamera-Standpunkt zum Target (normiert)
	  cam.fwd = norm({ x: sy*cp, y: -sp, z: cy*cp });
	  cam.pos = add(cam.target, scale(cam.fwd, -cam.dist));
		  // Rechtssystem: right = fwd × upWorld
		  cam.right = norm(cross(cam.fwd, upWorld));
		  cam.up = norm(cross(cam.right, cam.fwd));
	}

	function worldToScreen(p){
	  const v = sub(p, cam.pos);
	  const x = dot(v, cam.right);
	  const y = dot(v, cam.up);
	  const z = dot(v, cam.fwd);
	  const zz = Math.max(1e-3, z);
	  return {
	    x: canvas.width/2 + (x/zz)*cam.fov,
	    y: canvas.height/2 + (y/zz)*cam.fov,
	    z: z
	  };
	}

	function screenRay(sx, sy){
	  const x = (sx - canvas.width/2) / cam.fov;
	  const y = (sy - canvas.height/2) / cam.fov;
	  // Ray in Kamera-Koords: (x,y,1)
	  let dir = add(add(scale(cam.right, x), scale(cam.up, y)), cam.fwd);
	  dir = norm(dir);
	  return { origin: cam.pos, dir };
	}

	function intersectRayPlane(ray, planePoint, planeNormal){
	  const denom = dot(ray.dir, planeNormal);
	  if (Math.abs(denom) < 1e-6) return planePoint;
	  const t = dot(sub(planePoint, ray.origin), planeNormal) / denom;
	  return add(ray.origin, scale(ray.dir, t));
	}

function initPoints() {
  pts = [];
  // Startposition im sichtbaren Bereich (Mitte des Playfields)
  const centerX = (bounds.left + bounds.right) / 2;
  const startY = bounds.top + 50;
	  updateDerived();
	  cam.target.x = centerX;
	  cam.target.y = startY + 120;
	  cam.target.z = 0;
  for(let i=0;i<SEGMENTS;i++){
    pts.push({
      x: centerX,
	      y: startY + i*REST,
	      z: 0,
	      vx:0,vy:0,vz:0
    });
  }
}
initPoints();

// ---------- INPUT ----------
		let orbiting=false;
		let orbitStart={x:0,y:0};
		let orbitYaw=0, orbitPitch=0;
		const ORBIT_SENS = 0.005;

		function startOrbit(p){
		  orbiting=true;
		  orbitStart=p;
		  orbitYaw=cam.yaw;
		  orbitPitch=cam.pitch;
		}
		function doOrbit(p){
		  const dx=p.x-orbitStart.x;
		  const dy=p.y-orbitStart.y;
		  cam.yaw = orbitYaw + dx*ORBIT_SENS;
		  cam.pitch = clamp(orbitPitch - dy*ORBIT_SENS, -1.25, 1.25);
		}

	function pick(x,y){
	  // pick in Screen-Space (projCache wird in draw() aktualisiert)
	  let best=null, bestD=22;
	  for(let i=0;i<pts.length;i++){
	    const sp = projCache[i];
	    if(!sp) continue;
	    const d = Math.hypot(sp.x-x, sp.y-y);
	    if(d < bestD){ bestD=d; best=pts[i]; }
	  }
	  return best;
	}
function pos(e){return e.touches?
  {x:e.touches[0].clientX,y:e.touches[0].clientY}:
  {x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY}}

		canvas.addEventListener('contextmenu', e => e.preventDefault());

		canvas.onmousedown=e=>{
		  const p = pos(e);
		  // Left-click: point drag if possible, otherwise orbit
		  if(e.button === 0){
		    const hit = pick(p.x, p.y);
		    if(hit){
		      grabbed = hit;
		      orbiting = false;
		    } else {
		      grabbed = null;
		      startOrbit(p);
		    }
		  } else {
		    // Right/middle click -> orbit
		    grabbed = null;
		    startOrbit(p);
		  }
		};
		canvas.onmousemove=e=>{
		  const p = pos(e);
		  if(grabbed){
		    updateCamera();
		    const ray = screenRay(p.x, p.y);
		    const hit = intersectRayPlane(ray, grabbed, cam.fwd);
		    grabbed.x = hit.x; grabbed.y = hit.y; grabbed.z = hit.z;
		    grabbed.vx=grabbed.vy=grabbed.vz=0;
		    return;
		  }
		  if(orbiting) doOrbit(p);
		};
		onmouseup=()=>{ grabbed=null; orbiting=false; };

		canvas.ontouchstart=e=>{
		  e.preventDefault();
		  const p = pos(e);
		  const hit = pick(p.x, p.y);
		  if(hit){
		    grabbed = hit;
		    orbiting = false;
		  } else {
		    grabbed = null;
		    startOrbit(p);
		  }
		};
		canvas.ontouchmove=e=>{
		  e.preventDefault();
		  const p = pos(e);
		  if(grabbed){
		    updateCamera();
		    const ray = screenRay(p.x, p.y);
		    const hit = intersectRayPlane(ray, grabbed, cam.fwd);
		    grabbed.x = hit.x; grabbed.y = hit.y; grabbed.z = hit.z;
		    grabbed.vx=grabbed.vy=grabbed.vz=0;
		    return;
		  }
		  if(orbiting) doOrbit(p);
		};
		ontouchend=()=>{ grabbed=null; orbiting=false; };

		canvas.addEventListener('wheel', (e)=>{
		  e.preventDefault();
		  const k = 1 + e.deltaY*0.001;
		  cam.dist = clamp(cam.dist * k, 120, 1600);
		}, {passive:false});

// ---------- PHYSICS ----------
function step(){
	  pts.forEach(p=>{if(p!==grabbed)p.vy+=GRAVITY});

  // springs
  for(let i=0;i<pts.length-1;i++){
    let a=pts[i], b=pts[i+1];
	    let dx=b.x-a.x, dy=b.y-a.y, dz=b.z-a.z;
	    let d=Math.hypot(dx,dy,dz)||0.001;
	    let nx=dx/d, ny=dy/d, nz=dz/d;
    let f=(d-REST)*STIFF;
	    let dv=(b.vx-a.vx)*nx+(b.vy-a.vy)*ny+(b.vz-a.vz)*nz;
    f+=dv*DAMP;
	    if(a!==grabbed){a.vx+=f*nx;a.vy+=f*ny;a.vz+=f*nz}
	    if(b!==grabbed){b.vx-=f*nx;b.vy-=f*ny;b.vz-=f*nz}
  }

  // bending
  for(let i=1;i<pts.length-1;i++){
    let a=pts[i-1],b=pts[i],c=pts[i+1];
	    let fx=(a.x+c.x-2*b.x)*BEND;
	    let fy=(a.y+c.y-2*b.y)*BEND;
	    let fz=(a.z+c.z-2*b.z)*BEND;
	    if(b!==grabbed){b.vx+=fx;b.vy+=fy;b.vz+=fz}
  }

  // integrate + walls (respektiert bounds/Menü)
	  // NOTE: Beim Rendern wird die Spirale um jeden Punkt um bis zu RADIUS
  // versetzt (Helix-Offset). Damit am Boden/Seiten nicht "abgeschnitten" wird,
  // kollidieren wir mit einem Padding.
	  const pad = RADIUS + 6;

  // Controls-Panel als Hindernis (damit Sprinky nicht darunter "durchläuft")
  let panelRect = null;
  try {
    if (typeof panel !== 'undefined' && panel?.el?.getBoundingClientRect) {
      panelRect = panel.el.getBoundingClientRect();
    }
  } catch (_) {}

  pts.forEach(p=>{
    if(p===grabbed)return;
	    p.x+=p.vx; p.y+=p.vy; p.z+=p.vz;
	    p.vx*=0.999; p.vy*=0.999; p.vz*=0.999;

    // Wände mit dynamischen bounds
    const leftWall = bounds.left + pad;
    const rightWall = bounds.right - pad;
    const topWall = bounds.top + pad;
    const bottomWall = bounds.bottom - pad;

    if(p.x < leftWall) {
      p.x = leftWall;
      p.vx *= -BOUNCE; p.vy *= FRICTION;
    }
    if(p.x > rightWall) {
      p.x = rightWall;
      p.vx *= -BOUNCE; p.vy *= FRICTION;
    }
    if(p.y < topWall) {
      p.y = topWall;
      p.vy *= -BOUNCE; p.vx *= FRICTION;
    }
    if(p.y > bottomWall) {
      p.y = bottomWall;
      p.vy *= -BOUNCE; p.vx *= FRICTION;
    }

    // Kollision mit dem Settings/Controls Panel (AABB, mit Padding)
    if (panelRect) {
      const rL = panelRect.left - pad;
      const rR = panelRect.right + pad;
      const rT = panelRect.top - pad;
      const rB = panelRect.bottom + pad;
      if (p.x > rL && p.x < rR && p.y > rT && p.y < rB) {
        const dL = Math.abs(p.x - rL);
        const dR = Math.abs(rR - p.x);
        const dT = Math.abs(p.y - rT);
        const dB = Math.abs(rB - p.y);
        const m = Math.min(dL, dR, dT, dB);
        if (m === dL) {
          p.x = rL;
          p.vx *= -BOUNCE; p.vy *= FRICTION;
        } else if (m === dR) {
          p.x = rR;
          p.vx *= -BOUNCE; p.vy *= FRICTION;
        } else if (m === dT) {
          p.y = rT;
          p.vy *= -BOUNCE; p.vx *= FRICTION;
        } else {
          p.y = rB;
          p.vy *= -BOUNCE; p.vx *= FRICTION;
        }
      }
    }
  });
}

// ---------- RENDER (performance optimiert - kein shadowBlur!) ----------
	function draw(){
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
	  updateCamera();

  // Zeichne Spirale mit 3D-Effekt + Regenbogenfarben
  ctx.lineCap = 'round';
  ctx.lineJoin = 'round';

	  // arclength (für echte Windungen, Option A)
	  const s = new Array(pts.length);
	  s[0]=0;
	  for(let i=0;i<pts.length-1;i++) s[i+1]=s[i]+dist(pts[i],pts[i+1]);
	  const L = Math.max(1e-6, s[s.length-1]);

	  // Parallel-Transport Frame entlang der Centerline (stabiler als Frenet)
	  let tPrev = norm(sub(pts[1], pts[0]));
	  let base = Math.abs(tPrev.z) < 0.9 ? {x:0,y:0,z:1} : {x:0,y:1,z:0};
	  let nPrev = norm(cross(base, tPrev));
	  if(len(nPrev) < 1e-6) nPrev = {x:1,y:0,z:0};

	  projCache.length = pts.length;
	  for(let i=0;i<pts.length;i++) projCache[i] = worldToScreen(pts[i]);

  for(let i=0;i<pts.length-1;i++){
	    const p=pts[i];
	    const p2=pts[i+1];
	    const tCur = norm(sub(p2, p));

	    // Frame fortschreiben
	    const axis = cross(tPrev, tCur);
	    const axisLen = len(axis);
	    if(axisLen > 1e-6){
	      const ang = Math.atan2(axisLen, clamp(dot(tPrev, tCur), -1, 1));
	      nPrev = rotateAroundAxis(nPrev, axis, ang);
	      // orthonormalisieren
	      const proj = dot(nPrev, tCur);
	      nPrev = norm({x:nPrev.x - tCur.x*proj, y:nPrev.y - tCur.y*proj, z:nPrev.z - tCur.z*proj});
	    }
	    const bPrev = cross(tCur, nPrev);
	    tPrev = tCur;

	    // echte Windungen: θ über Bogenlänge
	    const theta = 2*Math.PI * TURNS * (s[i] / L);
	    const theta2 = 2*Math.PI * TURNS * (s[i+1] / L);
	    const c1 = Math.cos(theta), s1 = Math.sin(theta);
	    const c2 = Math.cos(theta2), s2 = Math.sin(theta2);
	    const off1 = { x:(nPrev.x*c1 + bPrev.x*s1)*RADIUS, y:(nPrev.y*c1 + bPrev.y*s1)*RADIUS, z:(nPrev.z*c1 + bPrev.z*s1)*RADIUS };
	    const off2 = { x:(nPrev.x*c2 + bPrev.x*s2)*RADIUS, y:(nPrev.y*c2 + bPrev.y*s2)*RADIUS, z:(nPrev.z*c2 + bPrev.z*s2)*RADIUS };
	    const depth = s1; // -1..+1 (Front/Back-Effekt)

    // Tiefeneffekt (ohne shadowBlur für Performance)
    let alpha=0.5+depth*0.4;
    let width=2+depth*2.5;

    // Regenbogenfarbe
	    let hue=(i/pts.length)*360;
    ctx.strokeStyle=`hsla(${hue},100%,${55+depth*15}%,${Math.max(0.3,alpha)})`;
    ctx.lineWidth=Math.max(1.5,width);

	    // projiziere Offsets
	    const sp1 = worldToScreen(add(p, off1));
	    const sp2 = worldToScreen(add(p2, off2));
	    ctx.beginPath();
	    ctx.moveTo(sp1.x, sp1.y);
	    ctx.lineTo(sp2.x, sp2.y);
	    ctx.stroke();
  }
}

// ---------- CONTROLS PANEL ----------
const panel = Controls.createPanel({ position: 'center' });

panel
  .addToggle('gravity', {

  <script>
    (function() {
      // Formel als Array von Token (z.B. ['123', '+', '456', '×', '2'])
      let formulaTokens = [];
      let currentInput = '0';
      let shouldResetScreen = false;

      const resultEl = document.getElementById('result');
      const formulaEl = document.getElementById('formula');

      // Echtzeit-Auswertung der Formel
      function evaluateFormula() {
        if (formulaTokens.length === 0) return parseFloat(currentInput) || 0;
        
        // Erstelle ausführbaren Ausdruck
        let expr = formulaTokens.join(' ');
        // Ersetze Unicode-Operatoren durch JavaScript-Operatoren
        expr = expr.replace(/×/g, '*').replace(/÷/g, '/').replace(/−/g, '-');
        // Aktuelle Eingabe anhängen
        expr += ' ' + currentInput;
        
        try {
          // Sicher evaluieren - nur Zahlen und Operatoren erlaubt
          const result = Function('"use strict"; return (' + expr + ')')();
          if (!isFinite(result) || isNaN(result)) return 'Error';
          return result;
        } catch (e) {
          return 'Error';
        }
      }

      function updateDisplay() {
        // Formel anzeigen: alle Tokens + aktuelle Eingabe
        let formulaText = formulaTokens.join(' ');
        if (formulaText) {
          formulaText += ' ' + currentInput;
        } else {
          formulaText = currentInput;
        }
        formulaEl.textContent = formulaText;

        // Echtzeit-Ergebnis anzeigen
        const liveResult = evaluateFormula();
        resultEl.textContent = formatNumber(liveResult);
      }

      function formatNumber(num) {
        if (num === 'Error') return num;
        if (typeof num === 'string') num = parseFloat(num);
        if (isNaN(num)) return 'Error';
        
        // Formatierung für große Zahlen
        if (Math.abs(num) > 999999999999) {
          return num.toExponential(6);
        }
        // Runden um Floating-Point-Probleme zu vermeiden
        return parseFloat(num.toPrecision(12)).toString();
      }

      function clear() {
        currentInput = '0';
        formulaTokens = [];
        shouldResetScreen = false;
        updateDisplay();
      }

      function backspace() {
        if (currentInput.length > 1) {
          currentInput = currentInput.slice(0, -1);
        } else {
          currentInput = '0';
        }
        updateDisplay();
      }

      function appendNumber(num) {
        if (shouldResetScreen) {
          currentInput = num;
          shouldResetScreen = false;
        } else {
          if (currentInput === '0') {
            currentInput = num;
          } else if (currentInput.length < 15) {
            currentInput += num;
          }
        }
        updateDisplay();
      }

      function appendDecimal() {
        if (shouldResetScreen) {
          currentInput = '0.';
          shouldResetScreen = false;
        } else if (!currentInput.includes('.')) {
          currentInput += '.';
        }
        updateDisplay();
      }

      function toggleSign() {
        if (currentInput !== '0') {
          if (currentInput.startsWith('-')) {
            currentInput = currentInput.slice(1);
          } else {
            currentInput = '-' + currentInput;
          }
        }
        updateDisplay();
      }

      function percent() {
        const value = parseFloat(currentInput);
        currentInput = (value / 100).toString();
        updateDisplay();
      }

      function chooseOperator(op) {
        // Aktuelle Eingabe zu Tokens hinzufügen
        formulaTokens.push(currentInput);
        formulaTokens.push(op);
        shouldResetScreen = true;
        updateDisplay();
      }

      function calculate() {
        // Finale Berechnung
        const finalResult = evaluateFormula();
        
        // Zurücksetzen mit dem Ergebnis
        currentInput = finalResult === 'Error' ? 'Error' : finalResult.toString();
        formulaTokens = [];
        shouldResetScreen = true;
        updateDisplay();
      }

      // Event Listeners für Buttons
      document.querySelector('.calc-buttons').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        const btn = e.target.closest('.calc-btn');
        if (!btn) return;

        // Zahlen
        if (btn.hasAttribute('data-number')) {
          appendNumber(btn.textContent);
          return;
        }

        // Operatoren
        if (btn.hasAttribute('data-operator')) {
          chooseOperator(btn.getAttribute('data-operator'));
          return;
        }

        // Aktionen
        const action = btn.getAttribute('data-action');
        switch (action) {
          case 'clear':
            clear();
            break;
          case 'backspace':
            backspace();
            break;
          case 'decimal':
            appendDecimal();
            break;
          case 'sign':
            toggleSign();
            break;
          case 'percent':
            percent();
            break;
          case 'equals':
            calculate();
            break;
        }
      });

      // Tastatur-Unterstützung
      document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
        if (e.key >= '0' && e.key <= '9') {
          appendNumber(e.key);
        } else if (e.key === '.') {
          appendDecimal();
        } else if (e.key === '+' || e.key === '-' || e.key === '*' || e.key === '/') {
          const opMap = { '*': '×', '/': '÷', '-': '−' };
          chooseOperator(opMap[e.key] || e.key);
        } else if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === '=') {
          e.preventDefault();
          calculate();
        } else if (e.key === 'Escape' || e.key === 'c' || e.key === 'C') {
          clear();
        } else if (e.key === 'Backspace') {
          backspace();
        } else if (e.key === '%') {
          percent();
        }
      });
    })();
  </script>

    <script>
        const factorDisplay = document.getElementById('factorDisplay');
        const button = document.getElementById('button');
        const minValueInput = document.getElementById('minValue');
        const maxValueInput = document.getElementById('maxValue');
        const boxWidthInput = document.getElementById('boxWidth');
        const pressTimeInput = document.getElementById('pressTime');
        const releaseTimeInput = document.getElementById('releaseTime');
        const infinitySizeInput = document.getElementById('infinitySize');

        let factor = 1;
        let interval;

        function updateFactorDisplay() {
            const displayValue = factor >= parseFloat(maxValueInput.value) ? '∞' : formatLargeNumber(factor);
            factorDisplay.innerHTML = '<span>' + displayValue + '</span>';
            factorDisplay.style.width = boxWidthInput.value + 'px';
            factorDisplay.style.fontSize = displayValue === '∞' ? infinitySizeInput.value + 'px' : '24px';


            let fontSize = parseFloat(factorDisplay.style.fontSize);
            while (factorDisplay.scrollWidth > factorDisplay.clientWidth) {
                fontSize -= 0.5;
                factorDisplay.style.fontSize = fontSize + 'px';
            }
            if (displayValue === '∞') {
                factorDisplay.querySelector('span').style.transform = `translate(-50%, calc(-50% + 10px))`;
            } else {
                factorDisplay.querySelector('span').style.transform = `translate(-50%, -50%)`;
            }

        }

        function formatLargeNumber(number) {
            const strNumber = BigInt(Math.floor(number)).toString();
            return strNumber;
        }


        function changeFactor() {
            const elapsedTime = Date.now() - startTime;
            const targetTime = increasing ? timeToMaxFactor : timeToMinFactor;
            const progress = elapsedTime / targetTime;

            if (increasing) {
                factor = factorStart * Math.pow(factorEnd / factorStart, progress);
            } else {
                factor = factorStart / Math.pow(factorStart / factorEnd, progress);
            }

            updateFactorDisplay();

            if (progress >= 1) {
                clearInterval(interval);
                factor = increasing ? factorEnd : factorEnd;
                updateFactorDisplay();
            }
        }

        let startTime;
        let increasing = true;
        let factorStart = 1;
        let factorEnd = 1000;
        let timeToMaxFactor = 10 * 1000;
        let timeToMinFactor = 2 * 1000;

        function startIncreasingFactor() {
            increasing = true;
            clearInterval(interval);
            factorStart = factor;
            factorEnd = parseFloat(maxValueInput.value);
            timeToMaxFactor = parseFloat(pressTimeInput.value) * 1000;
            startTime = Date.now();
            interval = setInterval(changeFactor, 100);
        }

        function startDecreasingFactor() {
            increasing = false;
            clearInterval(interval);
            factorStart = factor;
            factorEnd = parseFloat(minValueInput.value);
            timeToMinFactor = parseFloat(releaseTimeInput.value) * 1000;
            startTime = Date.now();
            interval = setInterval(changeFactor, 100);
        }

        button.addEventListener('mousedown', startIncreasingFactor);
        button.addEventListener('mouseup', startDecreasingFactor);
        button.addEventListener('mouseleave', startDecreasingFactor);
        button.addEventListener('touchstart', (event) => {
            event.preventDefault();
            startIncreasingFactor();
        });
        button.addEventListener('touchend', (event) => {
            event.preventDefault();
            startDecreasingFactor();
        });

        function resizeFactorDisplay() {
            boxWidthInput.value = window.innerWidth * 0.9;
            updateFactorDisplay();
        }

        function changeFont() {
            const selectedFont = fontSelect.value;
            factorDisplay.style.fontFamily = selectedFont;
        }


        window.addEventListener('resize', resizeFactorDisplay);
        resizeFactorDisplay();
    </script>

theoremfraktal.md



In 0nefinity gilt vor allem 0 ≡ 1 ≡ ∞
Aber Auch 0 = 1 = ∞
sowie 0 ≠ 1 ≠ ∞
und 0 - 1 - ∞
und 0 + 1 + ∞
Und auch die auch die negierte Version von 0 ≡ 1 ≡ ∞, die es noch nicht als Unicode zeichen gibt, sowie die Version mit vier strichen und die mit unendlich vielen und allen dazwischen. 
(evtl eine potenziell unendliche Version von Unicode entwickeln die fraktal rekursive Strukturen erlaubt?)

und 0 ≥ 1 ≥ ∞
und 0 ≤ 1 ≤ ∞
und 0 < 1 < ∞
und 0 > 1 > ∞
und 0 < 1 > ∞
und 0 > 1 < ∞
und 0 = 1 > ∞
<pre>
      ≡ 
und 0 < 1 = ∞
      ≠ 
</pre>

<pre>
      ± 4       0 
und 0 < 1 = ∞ ≡ ∞ ≠ ∞ ≡ 1 > 0
      π   ≠   
</pre>

Eigentlich was man will. In 0nefinity brauchen Formeln nicht mal ein Ergebnis oder können gleichzeitig auch unendlich viele haben, die man vor allem aber auch auf noch viel vielfältigere Weise kreativ darstellen könnte.

  <script>
    // ============================================
    // ISOCHRONIC TONE GENERATOR
    // ============================================

    class ToneGenerator {
      constructor() {
        this.audioContext = null;
        this.oscillator = null;
        this.gainNode = null;
        this.analyser = null;
        this.isPlaying = false;

        // Parameters
        this.frequency = 440;
        this.pulseRate = 4; // Hz (pulses per second)
        this.masterVolume = 0.3;

        // Pulse state
        this.lastPulseTime = 0;
        this.pulseState = 0; // 0 = off, 1 = on

        // Animation
        this.animationId = null;
      }

      start() {
        if (this.isPlaying) return;

        // Create AudioContext
        this.audioContext = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();

        // Create oscillator (carrier frequency)
        this.oscillator = this.audioContext.createOscillator();
        this.oscillator.type = 'sine'; // Cleanest tone
        this.oscillator.frequency.setValueAtTime(
          Math.max(0.01, this.frequency),
          this.audioContext.currentTime
        );

        // Create gain node for pulse modulation
        this.gainNode = this.audioContext.createGain();
        this.gainNode.gain.setValueAtTime(0, this.audioContext.currentTime);

        // Create analyser for visualization
        this.analyser = this.audioContext.createAnalyser();
        this.analyser.fftSize = 2048;
        this.analyser.smoothingTimeConstant = 0.8;

        // Connect: Oscillator -> Gain -> Analyser -> Destination
        this.oscillator.connect(this.gainNode);
        this.gainNode.connect(this.analyser);
        this.analyser.connect(this.audioContext.destination);

        // Start oscillator
        this.oscillator.start();

        // Initialize pulse
        this.isPlaying = true;
        this.lastPulseTime = this.audioContext.currentTime;
        this.pulseState = 0;

        // Start animation loop
        this.animate();
      }

      stop() {
        if (!this.isPlaying) return;

        this.isPlaying = false;

        if (this.animationId) {
          cancelAnimationFrame(this.animationId);
        }

        if (this.oscillator) {
          this.oscillator.stop();
          this.oscillator.disconnect();
          this.oscillator = null;
        }

        if (this.gainNode) {
          this.gainNode.disconnect();
          this.gainNode = null;
        }

        if (this.analyser) {
          this.analyser.disconnect();
          this.analyser = null;
        }

        if (this.audioContext) {
          this.audioContext.close();
          this.audioContext = null;
        }
      }

      setFrequency(freq) {
        this.frequency = freq;
        if (this.oscillator && this.audioContext) {
          // Smooth frequency change to avoid clicks
          this.oscillator.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(
            Math.max(0.01, freq),
            this.audioContext.currentTime + 0.01
          );
        }
      }

      setPulseRate(rate) {
        this.pulseRate = rate;
      }

      setVolume(vol) {
        this.masterVolume = vol;
      }

      animate() {
        if (!this.isPlaying) return;

        const currentTime = this.audioContext.currentTime;

        // Calculate pulse interval
        const pulseInterval = 1 / this.pulseRate;
        const timeSinceLastPulse = currentTime - this.lastPulseTime;

        // Toggle pulse state
        if (timeSinceLastPulse >= pulseInterval / 2) {
          this.pulseState = 1 - this.pulseState;
          this.lastPulseTime = currentTime;

          // Apply gain with smooth ramping to avoid clicks
          const targetGain = this.pulseState * this.masterVolume;
          const rampTime = Math.min(0.005, pulseInterval / 4); // 5ms or 1/4 pulse

          this.gainNode.gain.cancelScheduledValues(currentTime);
          this.gainNode.gain.setValueAtTime(this.gainNode.gain.value, currentTime);
          this.gainNode.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(targetGain, currentTime + rampTime);
        }

        // Visualize
        this.visualize();

        // Continue animation
        this.animationId = requestAnimationFrame(() => this.animate());
      }

      visualize() {
        const canvas = document.getElementById('visualizer');
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

        if (!this.analyser) return;

        // Set canvas size
        const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
        canvas.width = rect.width;
        canvas.height = rect.height;

        // Get waveform data
        const bufferLength = this.analyser.frequencyBinCount;
        const dataArray = new Uint8Array(bufferLength);
        this.analyser.getByteTimeDomainData(dataArray);

        // Get CSS colors
        const styles = getComputedStyle(document.body);
        const bgColor = styles.getPropertyValue('--bg-color') || '#000';
        const textColor = styles.getPropertyValue('--text-color') || '#fff';

        // Clear canvas
        ctx.fillStyle = bgColor;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

        // Draw waveform
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.strokeStyle = textColor;
        ctx.beginPath();

        const sliceWidth = canvas.width / bufferLength;
        let x = 0;

        for (let i = 0; i < bufferLength; i++) {
          const v = dataArray[i] / 128.0;
          const y = v * canvas.height / 2;

          if (i === 0) {
            ctx.moveTo(x, y);
          } else {
            ctx.lineTo(x, y);
          }

          x += sliceWidth;
        }

        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }

    // ============================================
    // SETUP
    // ============================================

    const generator = new ToneGenerator();

    // Controls Panel (like 10sand.html)
    const panel = Controls.createPanel({ position: 'left' });

    panel.addToggle('playing', {
	      label: 'Ton aktiv',
      value: false,
      onChange: (v) => {
        if (v) {
          generator.start();
        } else {
          generator.stop();
        }
      }
    });

      panel.addSlider('frequency', {
      label: 'Frequenz (Hz)',
      min: 0,
      max: 20000,
      step: 1,
      value: 440,
      decimals: 0,
      onChange: (v) => generator.setFrequency(v)
    });

      panel.addSlider('pulseRate', {
      label: 'Pulse (Hz)',
      min: 0,
      max: 20000,
      step: 1,
      value: 1,
      decimals: 0,
      onChange: (v) => generator.setPulseRate(v)
    });

      panel.addSlider('volume', {
      label: 'Lautstärke',
      min: 0,
      max: 1,
      step: 0.01,
      value: 0.3,
      decimals: 2,
      onChange: (v) => generator.setVolume(v)
    });
  </script>

tools/0necanvas/blocks-dinge.js
/* 0necanvas blocks: Dinge — gitter, kurve, symbol
 *
 * Registers three "ding" block types via OneCanvas.registerBlock.
 * See docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-06-0necanvas-v1-plan.md section 3.
 *
 * Conventions (engine semantics):
 * - World units, origin = canvas center, y down.
 * - Primitive.rot is RADIANS; schema rotation sliders are DEGREES and
 *   converted on emit.
 * - poly.w is a world unit (scales with zoom). The grid deliberately uses
 *   w = 1/view.scale to stay a hairline on screen at any zoom.
 * - Lines are finely tessellated so non-affine forces can BEND them.
 */
(function () {
  'use strict';

  var DEG = Math.PI / 180;
  var LINE_SEGS = 24;      // segments per line across the screen (plan: ~24)
  var MAX_LINES = 140;     // per-direction safety cap when zoomed far out
  var VIEW_PAD = 0.15;     // extend grid beyond the view so warps don't expose ends

  function clamp(v, lo, hi) {
    v = Number(v);
    if (!isFinite(v)) return lo;
    return v < lo ? lo : (v > hi ? hi : v);
  }

  function num(v, fallback) {
    v = Number(v);
    return isFinite(v) ? v : fallback;
  }

  function whiteCol(alpha) {
    return 'rgba(255,255,255,' + clamp(alpha, 0, 1).toFixed(3) + ')';
  }

  // dezentes Selektions-Overlay: gestrichelter Akzent-Kreis + Zentrum-Punkt
  // (Stil wie pfad/verzerren)
  function selCircleOverlay(cx, cy, r, view) {
    var s = Math.max(1e-6, view.scale);
    r = Math.max(Math.abs(r), 18 / s);
    var pts = [];
    for (var i = 0; i <= 64; i++) {
      var a = (i / 64) * Math.PI * 2;
      pts.push(cx + Math.cos(a) * r, cy + Math.sin(a) * r);
    }
    return [
      { k: 'poly', pts: pts, closed: true, w: 1 / s, dash: [6 / s, 6 / s], col: 'rgba(168,184,232,0.5)' },
      { k: 'dot', x: cx, y: cy, r: 3 / s, col: 'rgba(168,184,232,0.8)' }
    ];
  }

  // straight line tessellated into n segments (n+1 points)
  function tessLine(x0, y0, x1, y1, n) {
    var pts = [];
    for (var i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
      var f = i / n;
      pts.push(x0 + (x1 - x0) * f, y0 + (y1 - y0) * f);
    }
    return pts;
  }

  // circle around world origin, n points, meant for closed polys
  function circlePts(r, n) {
    var pts = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      var a = (i / n) * Math.PI * 2;
      pts.push(Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r);
    }
    return pts;
  }

  /* =====================================================================
     gitter — Koordinatengitter (kartesisch / polar)
     ===================================================================== */

  OneCanvas.registerBlock({
    type: 'gitter',
    kind: 'ding',
    label: 'Koordinatengitter',
    icon: '▦', // ▦
    schema: [
      { key: 'density', ctrl: 'slider', label: 'Dichte', min: 2, max: 80, step: 1, value: 20 },
      { key: 'brightness', ctrl: 'slider', label: 'Helligkeit', min: 0, max: 1, step: 0.01, value: 0.25, decimals: 2 },
      { key: 'axes', ctrl: 'toggle', label: 'Achsen zeigen', value: true },
      {
        key: 'mode', ctrl: 'select', label: 'Art',
        options: [
          { value: 'kartesisch', label: 'Kartesisch' },
          { value: 'polar', label: 'Polar' }
        ],
        value: 'kartesisch'
      }
    ],

    // emit depends only on params + view -> engine may layer-cache it
    timeInvariant: true,

    emit: function (block, t, dt, view) {
      var p = block.params;
      var a = clamp(p.brightness, 0, 1);
      if (a <= 0) return [];

      var col = whiteCol(a);
      var axCol = whiteCol(Math.min(1, a * 2.4));
      var hairW = 1 / view.scale; // ~1 CSS px regardless of zoom

      var padX = (view.right - view.left) * VIEW_PAD;
      var padY = (view.bottom - view.top) * VIEW_PAD;
      var left = view.left - padX;
      var right = view.right + padX;
      var top = view.top - padY;
      var bottom = view.bottom + padY;

      // Dichte frei (Betrag: eine Anzahl); 0 = kein Gitter, nur Achsen.
      // Perf schützt NICHT ein Param-Clamp, sondern das View-Budget
      // (MAX_LINES): zu dichte Gitter werden auf ein Vielfaches des
      // Abstands vergröbert statt abgeschnitten.
      var density = Math.abs(num(p.density, 0));
      // world-fixed spacing derived from density (stable while panning)
      var spacing = density > 0 ? 1000 / density : 0;
      var prims = [];
      var i, k, pts;

      if (!(spacing > 0)) {
        // kein Gitter — Achsen unten übernehmen
      } else if (p.mode === 'polar') {
        // radius range of the padded view rect as seen from the origin
        var nearX = clamp(0, left, right);
        var nearY = clamp(0, top, bottom);
        var minR = Math.hypot(nearX, nearY);
        var maxR = 0;
        var cornersX = [left, right];
        var cornersY = [top, bottom];
        for (i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
          for (k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
            maxR = Math.max(maxR, Math.hypot(cornersX[i], cornersY[k]));
          }
        }

        var ringSpacing = spacing;
        var ringCount = (maxR - minR) / ringSpacing;
        if (ringCount > MAX_LINES) ringSpacing *= Math.ceil(ringCount / MAX_LINES);

        var r0 = Math.max(1, Math.floor(minR / ringSpacing));
        var r1 = Math.ceil(maxR / ringSpacing);
        for (k = r0; k <= r1; k++) {
          prims.push({
            k: 'poly', pts: circlePts(k * ringSpacing, 96), closed: true,
            w: hairW, col: col
          });
        }

        // radial rays, count follows density; tessellated so warps bend them
        // (Cap = echtes Perf-Budget: jede Ray ist ein eigener Poly)
        var rays = Math.max(1, Math.min(2 * MAX_LINES, Math.round(density)));
        for (i = 0; i < rays; i++) {
          var ang = (i / rays) * Math.PI * 2;
          var cx = Math.cos(ang), cy = Math.sin(ang);
          prims.push({
            k: 'poly',
            pts: tessLine(cx * minR, cy * minR, cx * maxR, cy * maxR, LINE_SEGS),
