      e.stopPropagation();   // der Seiteneditor soll keine Pfeil-/Zeichentasten aus diesem Feld sehen
      if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); nameEl.blur(); }
      else if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'a') {
        // Die Seite ist selbst ein contenteditable: ein Standard-Alles-Auswaehlen wuerde die ganze Seite greifen.
        e.preventDefault();
        const r = document.createRange();
        r.selectNodeContents(nameEl);
        const sel = getSelection();
        sel.removeAllRanges();
        sel.addRange(r);
      }
      else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        e.preventDefault();
        pending = null;
        say('');
        nameEl.textContent = shown;
        nameEl.blur();
      }
    });
    nameEl.addEventListener('beforeinput', (e) => {
      if (e.inputType === 'insertParagraph' || e.inputType === 'insertLineBreak') e.preventDefault();
    });
    nameEl.addEventListener('paste', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const t = (e.clipboardData || window.clipboardData).getData('text').replace(/[\r\n]+/g, ' ');
      document.execCommand('insertText', false, t);
    });
    nameEl.addEventListener('focus', () => { say(''); if (pending !== null) nameEl.textContent = pending; });
    nameEl.addEventListener('blur', () => {
      const text = nameEl.textContent;
      if (pending === null && text === shown) return paint();
      commit(text);
    });

    paint();
    return {
      el: root,
      setEditing(on) { editing = !!on; paint(); },
      renameTo(stem) { return commit(stem); },
      setFile(file) { cur = split(file); shown = cur.stem; pending = null; say(''); paint(); },
      destroy() { root.remove(); },
    };
  }

  window.OneEditorFilename = { mount };
})();

tools/editor-format.js
// Formatierung im Login-Editor (wie Word): fett, kursiv, unterstrichen, Schriftgroesse, Formatierung entfernen,
// Absatzformat Normal/H1/H2/H3. Ergebnis ist sauberes HTML: strong, em, u, <span style="font-size:1.25em">.
// Das Modul traegt Knoepfe, Tastenkuerzel und die Inline-Befehle; was an die Textstellen des Editors gebunden
// ist (Rueckgaengig, Speichern, Tausch des Absatz-Elements) kommt ueber opts herein.
//
//   const fmt = window.OneEditorFormat.mount({
//     host: () => element|null,        // Textstelle der Auswahl oder Schreibmarke
//     before: (host) => {},            // vor jeder Aenderung (Textstelle vormerken, Rueckgaengig-Schritt oeffnen)
//     after: () => {},                 // nach jeder Aenderung (Autosave anstossen)
//     blockOf: (host) => 'p'|'h1'|..|null,   // null = Element laesst sich nicht umformatieren
//     setBlock: (tag) => boolean,      // 'p'|'h1'|'h2'|'h3'
//     md: () => boolean,               // Markdown-Seite: nur anbieten, was Markdown kann
//     bar: () => element|null,         // Editor-Leiste, unter der die Ablage aufgeht
//     fail: (message) => {},           // sichtbare Fehlermeldung
//   });
//   fmt.parts()   -> { inline: [B, I, U, A-, A+], clear: Knopf, block: [P, H1, H2, H3] } (frische Knoepfe, werden mitgefuehrt)
//   fmt.panel     -> Ablage mit allen Knoepfen; fmt.togglePanel(force); fmt.setEditing(bool)
//   fmt.key(e)    -> Funktion oder null (Strg+B/I/U, Strg+Alt+0-3, Strg+Umschalt+./,)
//   fmt.sync()    -> Knopfzustaende; fmt.tidy(host) -> vom Browser gesetzte b/i in strong/em; fmt.keep(host, fn)
(function () {
  const STEPS = [0.75, 0.875, 1, 1.25, 1.5, 2, 3];
  const NS = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
  const PATHS = {
    bold: 'M7 5h6a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 0 7H7zM7 12h7.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 0 7H7z',
    italic: 'M10 5h7M7 19h7M14 5l-4 14',
    underline: 'M7 4v7a5 5 0 0 0 10 0V4M5 20h14',
    bigger: 'M3 19L8 6l5 13M5 15h6M17 7v6M14 10h6',
    smaller: 'M3 19L8 6l5 13M5 15h6M14 10h6',
    clear: 'M6 5h12M12 5v14M5 19L19 5',
    fmt: 'M3 19L8 6l5 13M5 15h6M15 19l3-7 3 7M16.5 17h3',
  };
  const BLOCKS = [['p', 'P', 'Normal', 0], ['h1', 'H1', 'Überschrift 1', 1], ['h2', 'H2', 'Überschrift 2', 2], ['h3', 'H3', 'Überschrift 3', 3]];
  const KEY = 'oe-fmt';

  function css() {
    if (document.getElementById('oef-style')) return;
    const s = document.createElement('style');
    s.id = 'oef-style';
    s.textContent = `
.oef-panel{position:fixed;z-index:2147483002;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:2px;padding:2px;border-radius:6px;box-sizing:border-box;
  width:max-content;max-width:calc(100vw - 16px);
  border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--text-color,#fff) 30%,transparent);background:var(--bg-color,#000);color:var(--text-color,#fff);
  font:15px/1 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif}
.oef-panel[hidden],body.menu-open .oef-panel{display:none}
.oef-t{font-weight:600!important;font-size:13px!important;letter-spacing:0}
.oef-ic{display:block;width:18px;height:18px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.6;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}`;
    document.head.appendChild(s);
  }

  function svg(kind) {
    const el = document.createElementNS(NS, 'svg');
    el.setAttribute('viewBox', '0 0 24 24');
    el.setAttribute('class', 'oef-ic');
    el.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    el.setAttribute('focusable', 'false');
    const p = document.createElementNS(NS, 'path');
    p.setAttribute('d', PATHS[kind]);
    el.appendChild(p);
    return el;
  }

  // Auswahl als Zeichenabstand in der Textstelle merken und danach wieder setzen: beim Austausch von
  // Elementen verlieren Auswahlbereiche ihre Textknoten.
  function offsetIn(host, node, off) {
    const r = document.createRange();
    r.setStart(host, 0);
    r.setEnd(node, off);
    return r.toString().length;
  }

  function pointAt(host, n) {
    const w = document.createTreeWalker(host, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);
    let t;
    let last = null;
    while ((t = w.nextNode())) {
      last = t;
      if (n <= t.data.length) return [t, n];
      n -= t.data.length;
    }
    return last ? [last, last.data.length] : [host, 0];
  }

  function keep(host, fn) {
    const sel = getSelection();
    const inside = sel.rangeCount && host.contains(sel.anchorNode) && host.contains(sel.focusNode);
    const a = inside ? offsetIn(host, sel.anchorNode, sel.anchorOffset) : 0;
    const f = inside ? offsetIn(host, sel.focusNode, sel.focusOffset) : 0;
    const next = fn() || host;
    if (inside) {
      const [an, ao] = pointAt(next, a);
      const [fn2, fo] = pointAt(next, f);
      sel.setBaseAndExtent(an, ao, fn2, fo);
    }
    return next;
  }

  const sizeSpan = (el) => el && el.nodeType === 1 && el.tagName === 'SPAN' && el.style.length === 1 && /em$/.test(el.style.fontSize);

  // Schriftgroesse einer Stelle relativ zur Textstelle: Produkt der em-Werte der umgebenden Groessen-Spans.
  function effective(node, host) {
    let k = 1;
    for (let el = node && (node.nodeType === 1 ? node : node.parentElement); el && el !== host; el = el.parentElement) {
      if (sizeSpan(el)) k *= parseFloat(el.style.fontSize);
    }
    return k;
  }

  const round = (x) => Math.round(x * 1000) / 1000;
  const stepIndex = (v) => STEPS.findIndex((s) => Math.abs(s - v) < 0.002);

  function mount(opts) {
    css();
    const ctl = [];
    let panel = null;
    let editing = false;
    let open = false;
    try { open = localStorage.getItem(KEY) === '1'; } catch (e) { /* privater Modus: nur fuer diese Sitzung */ }
    // b/i, die schon im Quelltext stehen, bleiben wie sie sind; nur was der Browser neu setzt wird strong/em.
    const known = new WeakMap();

    const md = () => !!(opts.md && opts.md());

    function guard(fn) {
      return () => {
        try { fn(); } catch (e) { opts.fail('Formatierung: ' + e.message); }
        sync();
      };
    }

    function btn(key, label, title, fn, content) {
      const b = document.createElement('button');
      b.type = 'button';
      b.className = 'oe-btn oe-mini';
      b.dataset.oeUi = '';
      b.dataset.fmt = key;
      b.dataset.title = title;
      if (content instanceof Node) b.appendChild(content);
      else { b.textContent = label; b.classList.add('oef-t'); }
      b.setAttribute('aria-label', title);
      b.title = title;
      b.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => e.preventDefault());
      b.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => e.preventDefault());
      b.addEventListener('click', guard(fn));
      ctl.push(b);
      return b;
    }

    function replaceElement(el, name, host) {
      keep(host, () => {
        const n = document.createElement(name);
        for (const a of el.attributes) n.setAttribute(a.name, a.value);
        n.append(...el.childNodes);
        el.replaceWith(n);
        return host;
      });
    }

    function tidy(host) {
      const seen = known.get(host);
      if (!seen) return;
      for (const el of [...host.querySelectorAll('b, i')]) {
        if (!seen.has(el)) replaceElement(el, el.tagName === 'B' ? 'strong' : 'em', host);
      }
    }

    function dropEmpty(host) {
      for (const el of [...host.querySelectorAll('b, i, strong, em, u, span')]) {
        if (el.closest('[data-oe-ui]') || el.firstChild) continue;
        if (!el.attributes.length || sizeSpan(el)) el.remove();
      }
    }

    function current() {
      const host = opts.host();
      if (!host) return null;
      if (!known.has(host)) known.set(host, new Set(host.querySelectorAll('b, i')));
      return host;
    }

    // In Ueberschriften ist alles schon fett: execCommand('bold') wuerde dort ein font-weight-Span setzen.
    // Stattdessen strong setzen bzw. loesen, ohne Span.
    function boldBlock(host) {
      return parseInt(getComputedStyle(host).fontWeight, 10) >= 600;
    }

    function toggleStrong(host) {
      const sel = getSelection();
      if (!sel.rangeCount) throw new Error('keine Auswahl');
      const r = sel.getRangeAt(0);
      if (r.collapsed || !host.contains(r.commonAncestorContainer)) throw new Error('fett nicht ausführbar');
      let el = r.commonAncestorContainer.nodeType === 1 ? r.commonAncestorContainer : r.commonAncestorContainer.parentElement;
      while (el && el !== host && el.tagName !== 'STRONG' && el.tagName !== 'B') el = el.parentElement;
      if (el && el !== host) {
        const kids = [...el.childNodes];
        el.replaceWith(...kids);
        host.normalize();
        return;
      }
      const strong = document.createElement('strong');
      strong.appendChild(r.extractContents());
      r.insertNode(strong);
      sel.removeAllRanges();
      const nr = document.createRange();
      nr.selectNodeContents(strong);
      sel.addRange(nr);
    }

    function run(cmd) {
      const host = current();
      if (!host) return;
      opts.before(host);
      if (cmd === 'bold' && boldBlock(host)) toggleStrong(host);
      else {
        document.execCommand('styleWithCSS', false, false);
        if (!document.execCommand(cmd)) throw new Error(cmd + ' nicht ausführbar');
      }
      tidy(host);
      dropEmpty(host);
      opts.after();
    }

    function clear() {
      const host = current();
      if (!host) return;
      opts.before(host);
      document.execCommand('removeFormat');
      document.execCommand('unlink');
      tidy(host);
      dropEmpty(host);
      opts.after();
    }

    // Groesse: Stufen in em, als <span style="font-size:..em"> um genau die Auswahl. Deckt die Auswahl einen
    // vorhandenen Groessen-Span ganz ab, wird dieser umgestellt; Stufe 1 loest ihn auf.
    function size(dir) {
      if (md()) return;
      const host = current();
      const sel = getSelection();
      if (!host || sel.isCollapsed) return;
      const r = sel.getRangeAt(0);
      const here = effective(r.startContainer, host);
      let i = stepIndex(here);
      if (i < 0) i = STEPS.findIndex((s) => s > here) - (dir > 0 ? 0 : 1);
      else i += dir;
      if (dir > 0 && stepIndex(here) < 0 && i < 0) i = STEPS.length;
      const target = STEPS[i];
      if (target === undefined) return;
      opts.before(host);
      let span = null;
      for (let el = r.commonAncestorContainer.nodeType === 1 ? r.commonAncestorContainer : r.commonAncestorContainer.parentElement;
        el && el !== host; el = el.parentElement) {
        if (sizeSpan(el) && r.toString() === el.textContent) { span = el; break; }
      }
      if (!span) {
        const frag = r.extractContents();
        for (const s of [...frag.querySelectorAll('span')]) if (sizeSpan(s)) s.replaceWith(...s.childNodes);
        span = document.createElement('span');
        span.append(frag);
        r.insertNode(span);
      }
      const rel = round(target / effective(span.parentNode, host));
      if (Math.abs(rel - 1) < 0.002) {
        const first = span.firstChild;
        const last = span.lastChild;
        span.replaceWith(...span.childNodes);
        if (first && last) sel.setBaseAndExtent(first.parentNode, [...first.parentNode.childNodes].indexOf(first),
          last.parentNode, [...last.parentNode.childNodes].indexOf(last) + 1);
      } else {
        span.style.fontSize = rel + 'em';
        const rr = document.createRange();
        rr.selectNodeContents(span);
        sel.removeAllRanges();
        sel.addRange(rr);
      }
      dropEmpty(host);
      opts.after();
    }

    function block(tag) {
      const host = opts.host();
      if (!host) return;
      if (!opts.blockOf(host)) { opts.fail('Dieses Element lässt sich nicht in eine Überschrift oder einen Absatz umformatieren'); return; }
      if (!opts.setBlock(tag)) opts.fail('Absatzformat nicht gesetzt');
    }

    function parts() {
      const inline = [
        btn('bold', '', 'fett (Strg+B)', () => run('bold'), svg('bold')),
        btn('italic', '', 'kursiv (Strg+I)', () => run('italic'), svg('italic')),
        btn('underline', '', 'unterstrichen (Strg+U)', () => run('underline'), svg('underline')),
        btn('smaller', '', 'Schrift kleiner (Strg+Umschalt+,)', () => size(-1), svg('smaller')),
        btn('bigger', '', 'Schrift größer (Strg+Umschalt+.)', () => size(1), svg('bigger')),
      ];
      const clearBtn = btn('clear', '', 'Formatierung entfernen', clear, svg('clear'));
      const blocks = BLOCKS.map(([tag, label, name, n]) => btn(tag, label, name + ' (Strg+Alt+' + n + ')', () => block(tag)));
      return { inline, clear: clearBtn, block: blocks };
    }

    function sync() {
      for (let k = ctl.length - 1; k >= 0; k--) if (!ctl[k].isConnected && !(panel && panel.contains(ctl[k]))) ctl.splice(k, 1);
      const host = opts.host();
      const sel = getSelection();
      const collapsed = !sel.rangeCount || sel.isCollapsed;
      const blk = host ? opts.blockOf(host) : null;
      const onMd = md();
      let sz = 1;
      let anchorEl = null;
      if (host) { sz = effective(sel.anchorNode, host); anchorEl = sel.anchorNode.nodeType === 1 ? sel.anchorNode : sel.anchorNode.parentElement; }
      const within = (sel2) => !!(anchorEl && anchorEl.closest(sel2) && host.contains(anchorEl.closest(sel2)));
      for (const b of ctl) {
        const k = b.dataset.fmt;
        let off = !host || !editing;
        let pressed = false;
        let why = '';
        if (k === 'bold') pressed = !!host && document.queryCommandState('bold');
        else if (k === 'italic') pressed = !!host && document.queryCommandState('italic');
        else if (k === 'underline') { pressed = !!host && within('u'); if (onMd) { off = true; why = 'in Markdown nicht möglich'; } }
        else if (k === 'bigger' || k === 'smaller') {
          if (onMd) { off = true; why = 'in Markdown nicht möglich'; } else if (host && collapsed) { off = true; why = 'erst Text markieren'; } else if (host) {
            if (k === 'bigger' ? sz >= STEPS[STEPS.length - 1] - 0.002 : sz <= STEPS[0] + 0.002) { off = true; why = 'Grenze erreicht'; }
          }
        } else if (BLOCKS.some((x) => x[0] === k)) {
          pressed = !!blk && blk === k;
          if (host && !blk) { off = true; why = 'hier nicht möglich'; }
        }
        b.disabled = off;
        b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(!off && pressed));
        b.title = why ? b.dataset.title + ' – ' + why : b.dataset.title;
      }
    }

    function place() {
      if (!panel || panel.hidden) return;
      const bar = opts.bar && opts.bar();
      const vis = bar && bar.offsetParent !== null;
      const w = panel.offsetWidth;
      const h = panel.offsetHeight;
      if (!vis) { panel.style.top = '60px'; panel.style.left = Math.max(8, innerWidth - w - 8) + 'px'; return; }
      const r = bar.getBoundingClientRect();
      const left = Math.min(Math.max(r.right - w, 8), Math.max(8, innerWidth - w - 8));
      const below = !bar.classList.contains('oe-solo');
      panel.style.left = left + 'px';
      panel.style.top = Math.max(8, below ? r.bottom + 6 : r.top - h - 6) + 'px';
    }

    function buildPanel() {
      panel = document.createElement('div');
      panel.className = 'oef-panel';
      panel.dataset.oeUi = '';
      panel.setAttribute('role', 'toolbar');
      panel.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Formatierung');
      panel.hidden = true;
      const p = parts();
      panel.append(...p.inline, p.clear, ...p.block);
      panel.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => e.stopPropagation());
      document.body.appendChild(panel);
      window.addEventListener('resize', place);
    }

    function togglePanel(force) {
      if (!panel) buildPanel();
      open = typeof force === 'boolean' ? force : !open;
      try { localStorage.setItem(KEY, open ? '1' : '0'); } catch (e) { /* siehe oben */ }
      apply();
    }

    function apply() {
      if (!panel) { if (open && editing) buildPanel(); else return; }
      panel.hidden = !(open && editing);
      place();
      sync();
      for (const f of listeners) f(open && editing);
    }

    const listeners = [];

    function setEditing(on) {
      if (editing === !!on) return;
      editing = !!on;
      apply();
    }

    function key(e) {
      if (!(e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey)) return null;
      if (e.altKey) {
        // Deutsche Tastatur: AltGr meldet Strg+Alt und tippt }, ², ³; nur echte Ziffer-Taste zaehlt.
        if (e.getModifierState && e.getModifierState('AltGraph')) return null;
        const m = /^(?:Digit|Numpad)([0-3])$/.exec(e.code || '');
        return m && e.key === m[1] ? () => block(BLOCKS[+m[1]][0]) : null;
      }
      const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
      if (e.shiftKey && (e.code === 'Period' || e.code === 'Comma')) return guard(() => size(e.code === 'Period' ? 1 : -1));
      if (e.shiftKey) return null;
      if (k === 'b') return guard(() => run('bold'));
      if (k === 'i') return guard(() => run('italic'));
      if (k === 'u') return md() ? () => {} : guard(() => run('underline'));
      return null;
    }

    return {
      parts, key, sync, tidy, keep, togglePanel, setEditing,
      get open() { return open && editing; },
      onPanel(fn) { listeners.push(fn); },
      icon: () => svg('fmt'),
    };
  }

  window.OneEditorFormat = { mount };
})();

tools/editor-marks.js
// Formatierungszeichen (wie Word, Symbol ¶) im Login-Editor: Leerzeichen als ·, Tab als →, Zeilenumbruch als ↵,
// Absatzende als ¶. Rein optisch: die Zeichen liegen in einer eigenen Ebene ausserhalb des bearbeiteten Inhalts
// (pointer-events:none, data-oe-ui) und werden nie in den Text geschrieben, also auch nie gespeichert.
//
//   const marks = window.OneEditorMarks.mount({
//     bar: element,                       // Leiste, in die der Knopf kommt
//     root: () => element,                // Bereich, dessen Text markiert wird (Standard: document.body)
//     btnClass: 'oe-btn oe-mini',
//   });
//   marks.set(true|false); marks.on  // Zustand bleibt in localStorage 'oe-marks'
//   marks.setActive(false)           // Zeichen ausblenden, ohne den gemerkten Zustand zu aendern
(function () {
  const PILCROW = 'M13 4v16M17 4v16M13 4H9.5a4.5 4.5 0 0 0 0 9H13';
  const NS = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
  const KEY = 'oe-marks';
  const BLOCKS = new Set(['P', 'H1', 'H2', 'H3', 'H4', 'H5', 'H6', 'LI', 'DIV', 'BLOCKQUOTE', 'PRE', 'TD', 'TH', 'FIGCAPTION', 'SUMMARY']);
  const MAX_MARKS = 4000;

  function css() {
    if (document.getElementById('oem-style')) return;
    const s = document.createElement('style');
    s.id = 'oem-style';
    s.textContent = `
.oem-layer{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:2147482000;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden}
.oem-layer span{position:absolute;color:var(--text-color,#fff);opacity:.45;font:12px/1 system-ui,sans-serif;
  -webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none;transform:translate(-50%,0)}
.oem-layer span.oem-end{transform:none;opacity:.6}
[data-oe-ui].oem-on{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--text-color,#fff) 18%,transparent)}`;
    document.head.appendChild(s);
  }

  function svg() {
    const el = document.createElementNS(NS, 'svg');
    el.setAttribute('viewBox', '0 0 24 24');
    el.setAttribute('class', 'oe-ic');
    el.setAttribute('fill', 'none');
    el.setAttribute('stroke', 'currentColor');
    el.setAttribute('stroke-width', '1.6');
    el.setAttribute('stroke-linecap', 'round');
    el.setAttribute('stroke-linejoin', 'round');
    el.setAttribute('width', '18');
    el.setAttribute('height', '18');
    const p = document.createElementNS(NS, 'path');
    p.setAttribute('d', PILCROW);
    el.appendChild(p);
    return el;
  }

  function mount(opts) {
    css();
    const getRoot = opts.root || (() => document.body);
    let on = false;
    try { on = localStorage.getItem(KEY) === '1'; } catch (e) { /* privater Modus: Zustand nur fuer diese Sitzung */ }

    const btn = document.createElement('button');
    btn.type = 'button';
    btn.className = opts.btnClass || 'oe-btn oe-mini';
    btn.title = 'Formatierungszeichen ein/aus';
    btn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Formatierungszeichen anzeigen');
    btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
    btn.dataset.oeUi = '';
    btn.appendChild(svg());
    opts.bar.appendChild(btn);

    const layer = document.createElement('div');
    layer.className = 'oem-layer';
    layer.dataset.oeUi = '';
    layer.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    document.body.appendChild(layer);

    let raf = 0;
    let active = true; // false: Bearbeiten aus, Zeichen aus dem Blick; der gemerkte Zustand 'on' bleibt unberuehrt
    function schedule() {
      if (!on || !active || raf) return;
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(() => { raf = 0; draw(); });
    }

    function put(ch, rect, cls, atRight) {
      const sp = document.createElement('span');
      sp.textContent = ch;
      if (cls) sp.className = cls;
      sp.style.left = (atRight ? rect.right + 1 : rect.left + rect.width / 2) + 'px';
      sp.style.top = rect.top + (rect.height - 12) / 2 + 'px';
      return sp;
    }

    function visible(r) {
      return r.bottom >= 0 && r.top <= window.innerHeight && r.right >= 0 && r.left <= window.innerWidth;
    }

    function draw() {
      layer.textContent = '';
      if (!on || !active) return;
      const root = getRoot();
      if (!root) return;
      const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
      let n = 0;
      const range = document.createRange();
      const walker = document.createTreeWalker(root, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT, {
        acceptNode(t) {
          const p = t.parentElement;
          if (!p || p.closest('[data-oe-ui],script,style,noscript,svg')) return NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;
          return NodeFilter.FILTER_ACCEPT;
        },
      });
      const lastText = new Map(); // Block -> letztes sichtbares Textstueck (fuer ¶)
      let t;
      while ((t = walker.nextNode()) && n < MAX_MARKS) {
        const s = t.data;
        if (!s.trim() && !/[ \t]/.test(s)) continue;
        const pre = /^(pre|pre-wrap|pre-line|break-spaces)$/.test(getComputedStyle(t.parentElement).whiteSpace);
        for (let i = 0; i < s.length && n < MAX_MARKS; i++) {
          const c = s[i];
          if (c !== ' ' && c !== ' ' && c !== '\t' && !(pre && c === '\n')) continue;
          range.setStart(t, i);
          range.setEnd(t, i + 1);
          const r = range.getBoundingClientRect();
          if (!visible(r) || (r.width < 1 && c !== '\n')) continue;
          frag.appendChild(put(c === '\t' ? '→' : c === '\n' ? '↵' : '·', r, '', c === '\n'));
          n++;
        }
        const el = t.parentElement.closest('p,h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,li,div,blockquote,pre,td,th,figcaption,summary');
        if (el && BLOCKS.has(el.tagName)) lastText.set(el, t);
      }
      root.querySelectorAll('br').forEach((br) => {
        if (n >= MAX_MARKS || br.closest('[data-oe-ui]')) return;
        const r = br.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (visible(r)) { frag.appendChild(put('↵', r, 'oem-end', true)); n++; }
      });
      lastText.forEach((tn, el) => {
        if (n >= MAX_MARKS) return;
        // nur Bloecke, deren letzter Inhalt dieser Text ist (kein ¶ mitten in verschachtelten Containern)
        const last = el.lastChild;
        if (last !== tn && !(last && last.contains && last.contains(tn))) {
          const walk = document.createTreeWalker(el, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);
          let tl = null, x;
          while ((x = walk.nextNode())) if (x.data.trim()) tl = x;
          if (tl !== tn) return;
        }
        range.selectNodeContents(tn);
        const rects = range.getClientRects();
        const r = rects[rects.length - 1];
        if (r && visible(r)) { frag.appendChild(put('¶', r, 'oem-end', true)); n++; }
      });
      layer.appendChild(frag);
    }

    function set(v) {
      on = !!v;
      btn.classList.toggle('oem-on', on);
      btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(on));
      try { localStorage.setItem(KEY, on ? '1' : '0'); } catch (e) { /* siehe oben */ }
      layer.textContent = '';
      if (on) draw();
    }

    function setActive(v) {
      active = !!v;
      layer.textContent = '';
      if (active && on) draw();
    }

    btn.addEventListener('click', () => set(!on));
    window.addEventListener('scroll', schedule, { passive: true, capture: true });
    window.addEventListener('resize', schedule);
    const mo = new MutationObserver((muts) => {
      if (muts.some((m) => !layer.contains(m.target))) schedule();
    });
    mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true, characterData: true });
    document.addEventListener('input', schedule, true);
    if (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready) document.fonts.ready.then(schedule);
    set(on);

    return { btn, layer, set, setActive, get on() { return on; }, redraw: draw, destroy() { mo.disconnect(); btn.remove(); layer.remove(); } };
  }

  window.OneEditorMarks = { mount };
})();

tools/editor-md.js
/* editor-md.js - Markdown <-> DOM for the login editor (.md pages in the text viewer).
 *
 * The .md viewer (tools/weird-text-viewer.php) renders the file with Parsedown 1.8.0 into
 * <div class="text-viewer-content" data-format="markdown">. This file turns that DOM (also
 * after editing) back into Markdown that Parsedown renders to the same DOM again.
 *
 * Same-origin, no dependencies. API: window._018EditorMd
 *   isMdPage()          true on a rendered .md page
 *   contentRoot()       the content element
 *   serialize(root)     Markdown text (no trailing newline); throws MdSerializeError when
 *                       something cannot be written back safely (fail loud, never guess)
 *   payload(base)       { base, text } for the save request; base = serialize() taken at load
 *
 * The server (editor/md_save.py) merges base -> text into the real file, so unchanged
 * regions keep their original bytes (spacing, comments, list markers). Elements carrying
 * [data-md-ignore] (editor UI) are skipped.
 */
(function (global) {
  'use strict';

  class MdSerializeError extends Error {
    constructor(message, node) {
      super(message);
      this.name = 'MdSerializeError';
      this.node = node || null;
    }
  }

  const INLINE = new Set(['a', 'abbr', 'b', 'bdi', 'bdo', 'br', 'cite', 'code', 'data', 'del', 'dfn', 'em',
    'font', 'i', 'img', 'ins', 'kbd', 'label', 'mark', 'q', 's', 'samp', 'small', 'span', 'strike', 'strong',
    'sub', 'sup', 'time', 'u', 'var', 'wbr']);
  const VOID = new Set(['area', 'base', 'br', 'col', 'embed', 'hr', 'img', 'input', 'link', 'meta', 'source', 'track', 'wbr']);
  const SPECIAL = '\\`*_{}[]()>#+-.!|~';
  const DROP_ATTRS = new Set(['contenteditable', 'spellcheck', 'data-md-ignore']);
  const dropAttr = (n) => DROP_ATTRS.has(n) || n.startsWith('data-018-') || n.startsWith('data-oe');

  const tag = (n) => (n.nodeType === 1 ? n.nodeName.toLowerCase() : '');
  const isIgnored = (n) => n.nodeType === 1 && (n.hasAttribute('data-md-ignore') || n.hasAttribute('data-oe-ui'));
  const isWord = (c) => c !== undefined && c !== '' && /[\p{L}\p{N}_]/u.test(c);
  const attrEsc = (v) => v.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;').replace(/</g, '&lt;');

  function fail(msg, node) {
    throw new MdSerializeError(msg + (node && node.nodeName ? ' (<' + node.nodeName.toLowerCase() + '>)' : ''), node);
  }

  /* ---------------------------------------------------------------- text */

  function escapeText(s, atLineStart, ctx) {
    s = s.replace(/ /g, '&nbsp;');
    let out = '';
    for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
      const c = s[i], prev = s[i - 1], next = s[i + 1];
      if (c === '\\') {
        out += (next === undefined || SPECIAL.includes(next)) ? '\\\\' : '\\';
      } else if (c === '`' || c === '*') {
        out += '\\' + c;
      } else if (c === '_') {
        out += (isWord(prev) && isWord(next)) ? '_' : '\\_';
      } else if (c === '~') {
        out += (next === '~' || prev === '~') ? '\\~' : '~';
      } else if (c === '[') {
        out += (ctx.inLink || /\]\s*[(\[]/.test(s.slice(i))) ? '\\[' : '[';
      } else if (c === ']') {
        out += (ctx.inLink || next === '(' || next === '[') ? '\\]' : ']';
      } else if (c === '<') {
        out += (next !== undefined && /[A-Za-z\/!?]/.test(next)) ? '&lt;' : '<';
      } else if (c === '&') {
        out += /^&#?\w+;/.test(s.slice(i)) ? '&amp;' : '&';
      } else if (c === '|' && ctx.inCell) {
        out += '\\|';
      } else {
        out += c;
      }
    }
    // line-start constructs
    return out.split('\n').map((seg, k) => ((k > 0 || atLineStart) ? escapeLineStart(seg) : seg)).join('\n');
  }

  function escapeLineStart(seg) {
    const m = /^(\s*)([\s\S]*)$/.exec(seg);
    let lead = m[1], rest = m[2];
    if (/^#/.test(rest)) rest = '\\' + rest;
    else if (/^>/.test(rest)) rest = '\\' + rest;
    else if (/^[-+]([ \t]|$)/.test(rest)) rest = '\\' + rest;
    else if (/^-+\s*$/.test(rest) || /^(-\s*){3,}$/.test(rest)) rest = '\\' + rest;
    else if (/^=+\s*$/.test(rest)) rest = '&#61;' + rest.slice(1);
    else if (/^\d+\./.test(rest)) rest = rest.replace(/^(\d+)\./, '$1\\.');
    else if (/^\[[^\]]*\]:/.test(rest)) rest = '\\' + rest;
    return lead + rest;
  }

  /* ---------------------------------------------------------------- inline */

  function openTag(el) {
    let s = '<' + tag(el);
    for (const a of el.attributes) {
      if (dropAttr(a.name)) continue;
      s += ' ' + a.name + (a.value === '' ? '' : '="' + attrEsc(a.value) + '"');
    }
    return s + '>';
  }

  // Raw HTML for a whole element (block passthrough), editor attributes removed.
  function rawHtml(el) {
    const clone = el.cloneNode(true);
    const strip = (e) => {
      for (const n of [...e.children]) {
        if (isIgnored(n)) { n.remove(); continue; }
        strip(n);
      }
      for (const a of [...e.attributes]) if (dropAttr(a.name)) e.removeAttribute(a.name);
    };
    strip(clone);
    let html = clone.outerHTML;
    // the HTML parser drops one newline right after <pre>; put it back when the text needs it
    const t = tag(clone);
    if ((t === 'pre' || t === 'textarea') && clone.textContent.startsWith('\n')) {
      html = html.replace(/^(<[^>]*>)/, '$1\n');
    }
    return html;
  }

  function wrapEmph(inner, mark) {
    const m = /^(\s*)([\s\S]*?)(\s*)$/.exec(inner);
    if (!m[2]) return inner;
    return m[1] + mark + m[2] + mark + m[3];
  }

  function inlineCode(text) {
    if (/\n/.test(text)) text = text.replace(/\n/g, ' ');
    let n = 1;
    const runs = text.match(/`+/g);
    if (runs) n = Math.max(...runs.map((r) => r.length)) + 1;
    const f = '`'.repeat(n);
    const pad = /^`|`$/.test(text) ? ' ' : '';
    return f + pad + text + pad + f;
  }

  function checkUrl(url, node) {
    if (/\s/.test(url)) fail('URL with whitespace cannot be written as Markdown link: ' + url, node);
    let depth = 0;
    for (const ch of url) {
      if (ch === '(') depth++;
      else if (ch === ')' && --depth < 0) break;
    }
    if (depth !== 0) fail('URL with unbalanced parentheses cannot be written as Markdown link: ' + url, node);
  }

  function inlineNodes(nodes, ctx) {
    let out = '';
    const list = [...nodes];
    let afterBr = false;
    for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
      const n = list[i];
      if (isIgnored(n)) continue;
      const wasBr = afterBr;
      afterBr = tag(n) === 'br';
      if (n.nodeType === 3) {
        // Parsedown writes "<br />\n"; that newline belongs to the break
        const v = wasBr ? n.nodeValue.replace(/^\n/, '') : n.nodeValue;
        out += escapeText(v, out === '' || out.endsWith('\n'), ctx);
      } else if (n.nodeType === 8) {
        out += '<!--' + n.nodeValue + '-->';
      } else if (n.nodeType === 1) {
        out += inlineElement(n, ctx);
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  function inlineElement(el, ctx) {
    const t = tag(el);
    const kids = (c) => inlineNodes(el.childNodes, c || ctx);
    switch (t) {
      case 'br': return '  \n';
      case 'strong': case 'b': return wrapEmph(kids(), '**');
      case 'em': case 'i': return wrapEmph(kids(), '*');
      case 'del': case 's': case 'strike': return wrapEmph(kids(), '~~');
      case 'code': return inlineCode(el.textContent);
      case 'img': {
        const src = el.getAttribute('src') || '';
        checkUrl(src, el);
        const alt = escapeText(el.getAttribute('alt') || '', false, { inLink: true });
        const title = el.getAttribute('title');
        return '![' + alt + '](' + src + (title ? ' "' + title.replace(/"/g, '&quot;') + '"' : '') + ')';
      }
      case 'a': {
        const href = el.getAttribute('href');
        if (href === null) return kidsRaw(el, ctx);
        checkUrl(href, el);
        const title = el.getAttribute('title');
        const text = el.textContent;
        if (!title && text === href && /^(https?:\/\/|mailto:|ftp:\/\/)\S+$/i.test(href) && el.children.length === 0) return href;
        const inner = inlineNodes(el.childNodes, { ...ctx, inLink: true });
        return '[' + inner + '](' + href + (title ? ' "' + title.replace(/"/g, '&quot;') + '"' : '') + ')';
      }
      default:
        return kidsRaw(el, ctx);
    }
  }

  // unknown inline element: Parsedown passes the tags through and still parses the content
  function kidsRaw(el, ctx) {
    const t = tag(el);
    if (VOID.has(t)) return openTag(el);
    return openTag(el) + inlineNodes(el.childNodes, ctx) + '</' + t + '>';
  }

  function inlineText(nodes, ctx) {
    return inlineNodes(nodes, ctx || {});
  }

  /* ---------------------------------------------------------------- blocks */

  const isInlineNode = (n) => n.nodeType === 3 || n.nodeType === 8 || (n.nodeType === 1 && INLINE.has(tag(n)));
  const isBlank = (n) => n.nodeType === 3 && !/\S/.test(n.nodeValue.replace(/ /g, 'x'));

  function trimPara(s) {
    return s.replace(/^[ \t\n]+/, '').replace(/\n+$/, '');
  }

  // children of a container -> array of block strings
  function blocks(parent, ctx) {
    const out = [];
    let run = [];
    const flush = () => {
      if (!run.length) return;
      const s = trimPara(inlineText(run, ctx));
      if (s) out.push({ kind: 'p', text: s });
      run = [];
    };
    for (const n of parent.childNodes) {
      if (isIgnored(n)) continue;
      if (isInlineNode(n)) { run.push(n); continue; }
      if (n.nodeType !== 1) continue;
      flush();
      const b = block(n, ctx);
      if (b) out.push(b);
    }
    flush();
    return out;
  }

  function block(el, ctx) {
    const t = tag(el);
    if (/^h[1-6]$/.test(t)) {
      const s = trimPara(inlineText(el.childNodes, ctx)).replace(/\s*\n\s*/g, ' ');
      if (!s) return null;
      return { kind: 'h', text: '#'.repeat(+t[1]) + ' ' + s };
    }
    switch (t) {
      case 'p': {
        const s = trimPara(inlineText(el.childNodes, ctx));
        return s ? { kind: 'p', text: s } : null;
      }
      case 'div': {
        // editor-made line wrappers: attribute-free div with inline content only
        if (el.attributes.length === 0 && [...el.childNodes].every((n) => isIgnored(n) || isInlineNode(n))) {
          const s = trimPara(inlineText(el.childNodes, ctx));
          return s ? { kind: 'p', text: s } : null;
        }
        return { kind: 'raw', text: rawHtml(el) };
      }
      case 'hr': return { kind: 'hr', text: '---' };
      case 'blockquote': {
        const inner = joinBlocks(blocks(el, ctx));
        if (!inner) return null;
        return { kind: 'q', text: inner.split('\n').map((l) => (l ? '> ' + l : '>')).join('\n') };
      }
      case 'pre': {
        const kids = [...el.children].filter((c) => !isIgnored(c));
        if (kids.length === 1 && tag(kids[0]) === 'code' && [...el.childNodes].every((n) => n === kids[0] || isIgnored(n))) {
          const code = kids[0];
          const cm = /(?:^|\s)language-(\S+)/.exec(code.getAttribute('class') || '');
          let text = code.textContent;
          if (text.endsWith('\n')) text = text.slice(0, -1);
          const longest = Math.max(2, ...(text.match(/^[ \t]*`{3,}/gm) || []).map((r) => r.trim().length));
          const fence = '`'.repeat(longest + 1);
          return { kind: 'pre', text: fence + (cm ? cm[1] : '') + '\n' + text + '\n' + fence };
        }
        return { kind: 'raw', text: rawHtml(el) };
      }
      case 'ul': case 'ol': return { kind: 'list', text: list(el, ctx) };
      case 'table': return { kind: 'table', text: table(el, ctx) };
      case 'script': case 'style': return { kind: 'raw', text: rawHtml(el) };
      default:
        if (!el.attributes.length && !el.children.length && !el.textContent.trim()) return null;
        return { kind: 'raw', text: rawHtml(el) };
    }
  }

  function joinBlocks(bs) {
    let out = '';
    bs.forEach((b, i) => { out += (i ? '\n\n' : '') + b.text; });
    return out;
  }

  function list(el, ctx) {
    const ordered = tag(el) === 'ol';
    let n = ordered ? parseInt(el.getAttribute('start') || '1', 10) : 0;
    if (ordered && !(n >= 0)) fail('list start not a number', el);
    const items = [...el.children].filter((c) => !isIgnored(c));
    const loose = items.some((li) => [...li.children].some((c) => tag(c) === 'p'));
    const parts = [];
    for (const li of items) {
      if (tag(li) !== 'li') fail('list child is not <li>', li);
      const marker = ordered ? (n++) + '. ' : '- ';
      const bs = blocks(li, ctx);
      let text = '';
      bs.forEach((b, i) => {
        const sep = i === 0 ? '' : (loose || (b.kind !== 'list' && bs[i - 1].kind !== 'list') ? '\n\n' : '\n');
        text += sep + b.text;
      });
      const pad = ' '.repeat(marker.length);
      const lines = text.split('\n').map((l, k) => (k === 0 ? marker + l : (l ? pad + l : l)));
      parts.push(lines.join('\n'));
    }
    return parts.join(loose ? '\n\n' : '\n');
  }

  function table(el, ctx) {
    const rows = [...el.querySelectorAll('tr')].filter((r) => !isIgnored(r));
    if (!rows.length) fail('empty table', el);
    const cellCtx = { ...ctx, inCell: true };
    const cells = (r) => [...r.children].filter((c) => /^t[hd]$/.test(tag(c)) && !isIgnored(c));
    const head = cells(rows[0]);
    const align = head.map((c) => {
      const m = /text-align:\s*(left|right|center)/.exec(c.getAttribute('style') || '');
      return m ? m[1] : '';
    });
    const fmt = (c) => trimPara(inlineText(c.childNodes, cellCtx)).replace(/\s*\n\s*/g, ' ');
    const line = (cs) => '| ' + cs.map(fmt).join(' | ') + ' |';
    const delim = '| ' + align.map((a) => (a === 'left' ? ':---' : a === 'right' ? '---:' : a === 'center' ? ':---:' : '---')).join(' | ') + ' |';
    const out = [line(head), delim];
    for (const r of rows.slice(1)) {
      const cs = cells(r);
      if (cs.length !== head.length) fail('table row with a different number of cells', r);
      out.push(line(cs));
    }
    return out.join('\n');
  }

  /* ---------------------------------------------------------------- API */

  function contentRoot() {
    return document.querySelector('.text-viewer-content[data-format="markdown"]');
  }

  function isMdPage() {
    return !!contentRoot();
  }

  function serialize(root) {
    root = root || contentRoot();
    if (!root) throw new MdSerializeError('no markdown content on this page');
    // the login editor wraps text runs in <oe-run>; they are not content
    const copy = root.cloneNode(true);
    for (const w of copy.querySelectorAll('oe-run')) w.replaceWith(...w.childNodes);
    copy.normalize();
    return joinBlocks(blocks(copy, {}));
  }

  function payload(base) {
    return { base: base, text: serialize() };
  }

  global._018EditorMd = { isMdPage, contentRoot, serialize, payload, MdSerializeError };
})(typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window : globalThis);

tools/editor-newpage.js
// Plus-Knopf fuer neue Seiten im Login-Editor. Wird von tools/editor.js eingehaengt; ohne mount() passiert nichts.
//
//   const np = window.OneEditorNewPage.mount({
//     bar: element,                            // Leiste, in die der Knopf kommt
//     request: (method, route, body) => ...,   // editor.js: api(); wirft bei Fehler (Error.message wird gezeigt)
//     beforeCreate: async () => true,          // z. B. offene Speicherungen abwarten
//     file: () => 'unbenannt.html',            // aktuelle Datei der Seite (editor.js: source.file)
//     onRenamed: (res) => {},                  // Seite wurde automatisch nach der Ueberschrift benannt: editor.js zieht pagePath nach
//     toast: (text, label, action) => {},      // kurze Meldung mit Rueckgaengig
//     go: (url) => location.assign(url),       // Standard: zur neuen Seite navigieren
//     btnClass: 'oe-btn oe-mini',              // Klassen des Knopfs (Standard wie editor.js)
//   });
//
// Ablauf: Plus klickt, die Seite "unbenannt" wird sofort angelegt und geoeffnet (Bearbeiten an, Platzhalter-
// Ueberschrift "Titel" markiert: tippen ersetzt sie). Kein Namensfeld. Nach dem Speichern der Ueberschrift benennt der
// Server die Datei danach (POST autoname), solange der Name noch der automatische ist. Eine nie beschriebene Seite
// wird beim naechsten Seitenwechsel wieder entfernt (POST discard; der Server prueft, dass sie unveraendert ist) und
// ist ueber Rueckgaengig (Ctrl+Z ohne weitere Schritte, oder die Meldung) sofort weg.
// Merker ueber den Seitenwechsel: sessionStorage "oe-newpage" = {file, from}.
(function () {
  const PLUS = 'M12 5v14M5 12h14';
  const NS = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
  const KEY = 'oe-newpage';
  const PLACEHOLDER = 'Titel';
  const AUTO = /^unbenannt(-\d+)?\.html$/;
  const MSG = {
    name_taken: 'Name ist schon vergeben',
    bad_name: 'Titel nicht erlaubt',
  };
  const flag = () => { try { return JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem(KEY) || 'null'); } catch (e) { return null; } };
  const setFlag = (v) => { try { v ? sessionStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(v)) : sessionStorage.removeItem(KEY); } catch (e) { /* privat */ } };

  function css() {
    if (document.getElementById('oenp-style')) return;
    const s = document.createElement('style');
    s.id = 'oenp-style';
    s.textContent = `
.oe-btn[data-busy]{opacity:.5;pointer-events:none}`;
    document.head.appendChild(s);
  }

  function svg() {
    const el = document.createElementNS(NS, 'svg');
    el.setAttribute('viewBox', '0 0 24 24');
    el.setAttribute('class', 'oe-ic');
    el.setAttribute('fill', 'none');
    el.setAttribute('stroke', 'currentColor');
    el.setAttribute('stroke-width', '1.6');
    el.setAttribute('stroke-linecap', 'round');
    el.setAttribute('stroke-linejoin', 'round');
    el.setAttribute('width', '18');
    el.setAttribute('height', '18');
    const p = document.createElementNS(NS, 'path');
    p.setAttribute('d', PLUS);
    el.appendChild(p);
    return el;
  }

  function mount(opts) {
    css();
    const request = opts.request;
    const go = opts.go || ((url) => location.assign(url));
    const fail = (e) => {
      const m = (e && e.message) || String(e);
      console.error('[editor] ' + m);
      if (opts.toast) opts.toast(MSG[m] || m, '', null, 'error');
    };
    const btn = document.createElement('button');
    btn.type = 'button';
    btn.className = opts.btnClass || 'oe-btn oe-mini';
    btn.title = 'Neue Seite';
    btn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Neue Seite');
    btn.dataset.oeUi = '';
    btn.appendChild(svg());
    opts.bar.appendChild(btn);

    // Der Undo-Verlauf haengt am Pfad; ein frueher gleich benanntes Platzhalter-Blatt darf nicht mitkommen.
    const clearHist = (path) => { try { localStorage.removeItem('oe-hist:' + location.host + path); } catch (e) { /* kein Speicher */ } };
    const pathOf = (file) => '/' + file.replace(/\.html$/, '');

    let busy = false;
    async function create() {
      if (busy) return;
      busy = true;
      btn.dataset.busy = '';
      try {
        if (opts.beforeCreate && (await opts.beforeCreate()) === false) throw new Error('Speichern läuft noch, bitte gleich nochmal');
        const res = await request('POST', 'newpage', {});
        clearHist(pathOf(res.file));
        setFlag({ file: res.file, from: location.pathname + location.search });
        go(res.url, res);
      } catch (e) {
        fail(e);
        busy = false;
        delete btn.dataset.busy;
      }
    }
    btn.addEventListener('click', create);

    const current = () => (opts.file ? opts.file() : '');
    const isNewHere = () => { const f = flag(); return !!f && f.file === current(); };

    // Seitenwechsel: eine zuvor angelegte, nie beschriebene Seite entfernen. Der Server lehnt ab, was beschrieben ist.
    async function sweep() {
      const f = flag();
      if (!f || f.file === current()) return;
      setFlag(null);
      if (!/^unbenannt(-\d+)?\.html$/.test(f.file)) return;
      clearHist(pathOf(f.file));
      try {
        await request('POST', 'discard', { path: pathOf(f.file) });
      } catch (e) { fail(e); }
    }

    const heading = () => document.querySelector('main h1, h1');
    const headingText = () => { const h = heading(); return h ? h.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim() : ''; };
    const pristine = () => headingText() === PLACEHOLDER && !!document.querySelector('main p, p') && document.querySelector('main p, p').textContent.trim() === '…';

    // Nach jedem erfolgreichen Speichern: Datei nach der Ueberschrift benennen (nur automatische Namen).
    let naming = null;
    async function afterSave() {
      if (naming) return naming;
      const t = headingText();
      if (!t || t === PLACEHOLDER) return;
      const f = flag();
      const auto = AUTO.test(current()) || (f && f.file === current());
      if (!auto) return;
      naming = (async () => {
        try {
          const res = await request('POST', 'autoname', { path: location.pathname });
          if (res.renamed) {
            history.replaceState(history.state, '', res.url + location.search + location.hash);
            setFlag({ file: res.file, from: (f && f.from) || '/' });
            if (opts.onRenamed) opts.onRenamed(res);
          }
        } catch (e) {
          fail(e);
        } finally { naming = null; }
      })();
      return naming;
    }

    async function undoCreate() {
      const f = flag();
      if (!f || f.file !== current() || !pristine()) return false;
      setFlag(null);
      clearHist(location.pathname);
      try {
        const res = await request('POST', 'discard', { path: location.pathname });
        if (res.skipped) { setFlag(f); return false; }
      } catch (e) { fail(e); return true; }
      go(f.from || '/');
      return true;
    }

    // Nach dem Oeffnen einer frisch angelegten Seite: Ueberschrift markiert, damit Tippen sie ersetzt.
    function focusHeading(rootEl) {
      const h = heading();
      if (!h) return;
      (rootEl || document.body).focus?.();
      const r = document.createRange();
      r.selectNodeContents(h);
      const sel = getSelection();
      sel.removeAllRanges();
      sel.addRange(r);
    }

    function arrive(rootEl) {
      if (!isNewHere() || !pristine()) return false;
      focusHeading(rootEl);
      if (opts.toast) opts.toast('Neue Seite angelegt', 'Rückgängig', () => { undoCreate(); });
      return true;
    }

    return { btn, create, sweep, afterSave, undoCreate, arrive, isNewHere, destroy() { btn.remove(); } };
  }

  window.OneEditorNewPage = { mount };
})();

tools/editor.js
// Dev-only Editor. Ohne Login: nichts im Menue, der Login liegt nur unter /enternity. Eingeloggt: im Menue nur noch Ausloggen;
// alle Editor-Funktionen sitzen in der Leiste oben links neben dem Menue, nach Zusammengehoerigem gruppiert:
// Verlauf (rueckgaengig, wiederholen, Verlaufsliste) | Text (Formatierung, Steuerzeichen) | Seite (Untermenue:
// neu, umbenennen, loeschen) | mehr (Quelltext, Aenderungen, Kommentare, Analytics) | veroeffentlichen (nur dev) | Stift.
// Auf dem Handy wandern Verlaufsliste, Text und Seite ins mehr-Menue.
// Grundsatz: die Oberflaeche reagiert sofort, alles Laengere laeuft im Hintergrund. Texte sind eingeloggt
// direkt editierbar und gehen ~0,4 s nach dem letzten Tippen auf dev (kein Speichern-Knopf, keine Statusanzeige;
// nur ein Fehler bleibt sichtbar, bis das Speichern wieder klappt). Der Server committet und pusht gebuendelt im
// Hintergrund. Markierter Text bekommt eine kleine Leiste (fett, kursiv, Link, Kommentar, Formatierung weg).
// Kommentare (HTML und JS) erscheinen mit der Sprechblase an ihrem Platz und sind dort direkt schreibbar.
// Alle Knoepfe rendern aus einem Zustand (render()).
// Backend: eigener Editor-Dienst hinter /api/edit/ (nicht in diesem Repo). Fehler stehen sichtbar unter den Symbolen.
// Andere Seiten (timbreitmar.de) binden dieselbe Datei als /api/edit/editor.js ein und stellen sie per
// data-Attribut um: data-mode="direct" (eine Arbeitskopie, Speichern ist sofort live, kein Veroeffentlichen),
// data-me / data-logout (eigener Login des Editor-Dienstes statt /api/auth/*).
// data-mode="draft" (www.0nefinity.love): eingeloggt liefert nginx den Entwurf (main + eigene Aenderungen), Speichern
// geht in den Entwurf, der Veroeffentlichen-Knopf bringt alles Unveroeffentlichte auf main; der Punkt am Knopf
// zeigt es an (GET draft-status). Besucher bekommen weiter main und dieses Skript nie.
(function oneEditor() {
  const tag = document.currentScript;
  const CFG = {
    direct: tag?.dataset.mode === 'direct',
    draft: tag?.dataset.mode === 'draft',
    me: tag?.dataset.me || '/api/auth/me',
    logout: tag?.dataset.logout || '/api/auth/logout',
  };
  if (!CFG.direct && !CFG.draft && !location.hostname.startsWith('dev.')) return;

  const INLINE = new Set(['A', 'B', 'I', 'EM', 'STRONG', 'SPAN', 'BR', 'SUB', 'SUP', 'CODE', 'SMALL',
    'MARK', 'U', 'S', 'ABBR', 'Q', 'KBD', 'WBR']);
  const TEXT_TAGS = new Set(['P', 'H1', 'H2', 'H3', 'H4', 'H5', 'H6', 'LI', 'TD', 'TH', 'DT', 'DD',
    'BLOCKQUOTE', 'FIGCAPTION', 'CAPTION', 'SUMMARY', 'LABEL', 'PRE', 'A', 'SPAN', 'DIV', 'EM', 'STRONG', 'B', 'I']);
  const SKIP = 'script, style, svg, canvas, noscript, template, textarea, input, select, button, #meta-nav, [data-oe-ui], .ctrl-panel';
  const ERRORS = {
    unauthenticated: 'nicht eingeloggt',
    csrf: 'Anfrage abgelehnt',
    text_not_found: 'Stelle im Quelltext nicht gefunden, bitte über quelltext ändern',
    text_ambiguous: 'Text kommt mehrfach vor, bitte über quelltext ändern',
    changed_meanwhile: 'Datei wurde inzwischen geändert, neu laden',
    live_file_dirty: 'Live-Datei hat ungespeicherte Änderungen auf dem Server',
    unsaved_on_dev: 'erst speichern',
    not_tracked: 'Datei ist nicht im Repo',
    not_inline: 'diese Datei nur über quelltext',
    comment_lost: 'im Quelltext steht ein versteckter Kommentar an dieser Stelle, bitte über quelltext ändern',
    mixed_eol: 'Datei mischt Zeilenenden, bitte über quelltext ändern',
    page_not_found: 'keine bearbeitbare Datei zu dieser Adresse',
    name_taken: 'Name ist schon vergeben',
    protected_page: 'diese Seite kann nicht gelöscht oder umbenannt werden',
    page_dirty: 'Seite hat ungespeicherte Änderungen, bitte kurz warten',
    not_deletable: 'diese Datei kann hier nicht gelöscht werden',
    bad_name: 'Name nicht erlaubt',
    protected_page: 'Diese Seite kann nicht umbenannt werden',
    not_supported: 'auf dieser Seite nicht verfügbar',
  };
  const ANALYTICS = 'https://analytics.timbreitmar.de';
  // Ysabeau-Outlines '0' und '1', dieselben wie in der Menue-Lupe (generate-menu.py).

  function icon(kind) {
    if (LINES[kind]) {
      return `<svg class="oe-ic" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="${LINES[kind]}"/></svg>`;
    }
    const vb = '-20 -600 560 640';
    if (kind === 'admin') {
      return `<svg class="oe-icon" viewBox="${vb}" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="${ZERO}"/>` +
        `<path d="${ONE}" transform="translate(155.5 -335) scale(.5)"/></svg>`;
    }
    // 0 und 1 in Originalgroesse wie die Menue-Lupe, also gleiche Strichstaerke; die 1 steht mittig ueber
    // dem Kreis und schneidet sich mit 60 Einheiten Abstand ihre Luecke. viewBox quadratisch um die 0-Mitte.
    const id = 'oe-pwr-' + (++iconSeq);
    const one = `<path d="${ONE}" transform="translate(51 -150)"/>`;
    const box = 'x="-54.5" y="-594" width="629" height="629"';
    return `<svg class="oe-icon oe-pwr" viewBox="-54.5 -594 629 629" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">` +
      `<mask id="${id}" maskUnits="userSpaceOnUse" ${box}><rect ${box} fill="#fff"/>` +
      `<g fill="#000" stroke="#000" stroke-width="120" stroke-linejoin="round">${one}</g></mask>` +
      `<path d="${ZERO}" mask="url(#${id})"/>${one}</svg>`;
  }

  // Waehrend ein Umbenennen laeuft, warten alle anderen Aufrufe und gehen danach mit dem neuen Pfad raus
  // (sonst traf ein Autosave den alten Namen: 404 "keine bearbeitbare Datei").
  let renaming = null;

  async function api(method, route, body) {
    if (route !== 'rename') {
      while (renaming) await renaming;
      if (body && typeof body === 'object' && 'path' in body) body = { ...body, path: pagePath };
    }
    busy++;
    syncPause();
    try {
      return await request(method, route, body);
    } finally {
      busy--;
      if (window.__oneReloadResync) window.__oneReloadResync();
      syncPause();
    }
  }

  async function request(method, route, body) {
    const opts = { method, credentials: 'same-origin', keepalive: route === 'save' || route === 'publish' || route === 'publish-all', headers: { Accept: 'application/json' } };
    if (body) {
      opts.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json';
      opts.headers['X-0ne-Edit'] = '1';
      if (csrf) opts.headers['X-0ne-Csrf'] = csrf;
      opts.body = JSON.stringify(body);
    }
    let res;
    try {
      res = await fetch('/api/edit/' + route, opts);
    } catch (e) {
      throw new Error('Editor-Dienst nicht erreichbar');
    }
    const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
    if (!res.ok) {
      const msg = ERRORS[data.error] || data.error || ('HTTP ' + res.status);
      throw new Error(data.detail ? msg + ' (' + data.detail + ')' : msg);
    }
    return data;
  }

  function q(route) { return route + '?path=' + encodeURIComponent(pagePath); }

  let sayTimer = null;
  // Nur Fehler bleiben stehen; Bestaetigungen verschwinden nach 4 s. Solange das Speichern scheitert, bleibt
  // seine Fehlermeldung oben, bis es wieder klappt.
  function say(text, kind) {
    if (saveFailed && kind !== 'error' && text) return;
    clearTimeout(sayTimer);
    status.textContent = text;
    status.dataset.kind = kind || '';
    if (kind === 'error') console.error('[editor] ' + text);
    else if (text) sayTimer = setTimeout(() => { if (status.textContent === text && !saveFailed) say(''); }, 4000);
  }

  function saveOk() {
    retryN = 0;
    if (saveFailed) { saveFailed = false; say(''); }
  }

  // Fehlschlag: Meldung bleibt, bis es klappt; der Wiederholungsversuch laeuft von selbst (1 s, 2 s, ... 30 s).
  function saveFail(e, again) {
    saveFailed = true;
    if (!leaving) say('nicht gespeichert, erneuter Versuch … (' + e.message + ')', 'error');
    retryN++;
    return setTimeout(again, Math.min(30000, 1000 * 2 ** Math.min(retryN, 5)));
  }

  // Klicks auf Editor-Knoepfe duerfen das Seitenmenue nicht auf- oder zuklappen.
  function keepClicks(el) {
    for (const t of ['click', 'touchend']) el.addEventListener(t, (e) => e.stopPropagation());
  }

  function showToast(text, label, action, ms, kind) {
    hideToast();
    toast = document.createElement('div');
    toast.className = 'oe-toast';
    toast.dataset.oeUi = '';
    toast.dataset.kind = kind || '';
    toast.setAttribute('role', 'status');
    keepClicks(toast);
    toast.append(text);
    if (action) {
      const b = button(label, () => { const fn = action; hideToast(); fn(); });
      b.classList.add('oe-small');
      toast.append(b);
    }
    if (kind === 'error') {
      const x = button('schließen', hideToast);
      x.classList.add('oe-small');
      toast.append(x);
      console.error('[editor] ' + text);
    }
    document.body.appendChild(toast);
    if (ms) toastTimer = setTimeout(hideToast, ms);
  }

  function hideToast() {
    clearTimeout(toastTimer);
    if (toast) toast.remove();
    toast = null;
  }

  function setLive(differs) {
    st.live = !!differs;
    render();
    if (CFG.draft) refreshDraftSoon();
  }

  // Entwurfsmodus: was ist noch nicht auf main? Punkt am Veroeffentlichen-Knopf; ein haengender Abgleich
  // mit main (Konflikt) steht als Fehlermeldung da, nie still.
  let draftTimer = null;

    clearTimeout(draftTimer);
    draftTimer = setTimeout(refreshDraft, 800);

  async function refreshDraft() {
    if (!CFG.draft) return;
    try {
      const d = await request('GET', 'draft-status');
      st.draftCount = d.count || 0;
      st.draftFiles = (d.files || []).map((f) => f.path);
      if (d.conflict && d.conflict !== draftConflictShown) {
        draftConflictShown = d.conflict;
        showToast('Entwurf und veröffentlichte Seite ändern dieselbe Stelle (' + d.conflict + '), Abgleich steht', '', null, 0, 'error');
      } else if (!d.conflict) draftConflictShown = null;
      render();
    } catch (e) { say('Entwurfsstand: ' + e.message, 'error'); }
  }

  // controls.js speichert Voreinstellungen ueber denselben Endpunkt: Quelltext neu holen (neuer sha),
  // damit "veroeffentlichen" erscheint und eine Quelltext-Bearbeitung nicht am alten Stand scheitert.
