        g.mpz_mul_ui(Q, Q, 426880);
        g.mpz_tdiv_q(pi, Q, T);
        freeMpz(Q); freeMpz(T);
        return pi;
    } catch (e) {
        freeMpz(pi);
        throw e;
    } finally {
        freeMpz(c3over24); freeMpz(sqrtC); freeMpz(one); freeMpz(three);
    }
}

// ---------- e (sum 1/k!) ----------

// Terme k in [a, b), a >= 1: Q = prod k, T = Summe-Zaehler (Summe = T / Q)
function bsE(a, b) {
    if (b - a === 1) {
        const Q = newMpz(), T = newMpz();
        g.mpz_set_ui(Q, a);
        g.mpz_set_ui(T, 1);
        return [Q, T];
    }
    const m = Math.floor((a + b) / 2);
    const [Q1, T1] = bsE(a, m);
    const [Q2, T2] = bsE(m, b);
    g.mpz_mul(T1, T1, Q2);
    g.mpz_add(T1, T1, T2);
    g.mpz_mul(Q1, Q1, Q2);
    freeMpz(Q2); freeMpz(T2);
    return [Q1, T1];
}

// kleinstes N mit N! > 10^(n+8)
function termsForE(n) {
    const target = (n + 8) * Math.LN10;
    const lf = (N) => N * Math.log(N) - N + 0.5 * Math.log(2 * Math.PI * N);
    let lo = 1, hi = 2;
    while (lf(hi) < target) { lo = hi; hi *= 2; }
    while (hi - lo > 1) {
        const mid = Math.floor((lo + hi) / 2);
        if (lf(mid) < target) lo = mid; else hi = mid;
    }
    return hi + 1;
}

function calcE(n) {
    const N = termsForE(n);
    assertU32(N);
    const [Q, T] = bsE(1, N + 1);
    const r = newMpz();
    try {
        g.mpz_add(T, T, Q);                  // Q + T  (e = 1 + T/Q = (Q+T)/Q)
        const s = pow10(n);
        g.mpz_mul(T, T, s);
        freeMpz(s);
        g.mpz_tdiv_q(r, T, Q);
        return r;
    } catch (e) {
        freeMpz(r);
        throw e;
    } finally {
        freeMpz(Q); freeMpz(T);
    }
}

// ---------- ln 2 (Machin-artig, acoth) ----------

// acoth(x) = sum_{k>=0} 1/((2k+1) x^(2k+1)); Terme k in [a, b): Q = prod q_k (q_0 = 1, q_k = x^2), B = prod (2k+1), T = S*B*Q
function bsAcoth(x, a, b) {
    if (b - a === 1) {
        const Q = newMpz(), B = newMpz(), T = newMpz();
        g.mpz_set_ui(Q, a === 0 ? 1 : x * x);
        g.mpz_set_ui(B, 2 * a + 1);
        g.mpz_set_ui(T, 1);
        return [Q, B, T];
    }
    const m = Math.floor((a + b) / 2);
    const [Q1, B1, T1] = bsAcoth(x, a, m);
    const [Q2, B2, T2] = bsAcoth(x, m, b);
    const t = newMpz();
    g.mpz_mul(t, B2, Q2);
    g.mpz_mul(T1, T1, t);
    freeMpz(t);
    g.mpz_mul(T2, T2, B1);
    g.mpz_add(T1, T1, T2);
    g.mpz_mul(Q1, Q1, Q2);
    g.mpz_mul(B1, B1, B2);
    freeMpz(Q2); freeMpz(B2); freeMpz(T2);
    return [Q1, B1, T1];
}

function calcLn2(n) {
    const acc = newMpz(), r = newMpz();
    try {
        for (const [coef, x] of LN2_TERMS) {
            const N = Math.ceil((n + 10) / (2 * Math.log10(x))) + 1;
            assertU32(2 * N + 1);
            const [Q, B, T] = bsAcoth(x, 0, N);
            const s = pow10(n); // erst nach bsAcoth: eine ueber die Rekursion gehaltene Potenz hob den Spitzenspeicher auf 14,4 B/Stelle (Test A4)
            g.mpz_mul(T, T, s);
            freeMpz(s);
            g.mpz_mul(Q, Q, B);
            g.mpz_mul_ui(Q, Q, x);
            g.mpz_tdiv_q(r, T, Q);          // floor(10^n * acoth(x))
            freeMpz(Q); freeMpz(B); freeMpz(T);
            if (coef > 0) g.mpz_addmul_ui(acc, r, coef); else g.mpz_submul_ui(acc, r, -coef);
        }
        return acc;
    } catch (e) {
        freeMpz(acc);
        throw e;
    } finally {
        freeMpz(r);
    }
}

// ---------- Wurzeln ----------

function calcSqrt(n, radicand) {
    const r = newMpz(), t = pow10(2 * n);
    try {
        g.mpz_mul_ui(t, t, radicand);
        g.mpz_sqrt(r, t);
        return r;
    } catch (e) {
        freeMpz(r);
        throw e;
    } finally {
        freeMpz(t);
    }
}

function calcPhi(n) {
    const s = calcSqrt(n, 5);
    const one = pow10(n);
    try {
        g.mpz_add(s, s, one);
        g.mpz_tdiv_q_2exp(s, s, 1);
        return s;
    } catch (e) {
        freeMpz(s);
        throw e;
    } finally {
        freeMpz(one);
    }
}

function calcWasm(n) {
    switch (id) {
        case 'pi': return calcPi(n);
        case 'e': return calcE(n);
        case 'ln2': return calcLn2(n);
        case 'sqrt2': return calcSqrt(n, 2);
        case 'phi': return calcPhi(n);
        default: throw new Error('unbekannte Konstante ' + id);
    }
}

// Stufe mit GMP: Ziffern [have, target) als Uint8Array (ASCII); prueft die Stufenkopf-Stellen gegen die erste Stufe.
function stageWasm(target) {
    const n = target + GUARD;
    const r = calcWasm(n);
    let ptr = 0;
    try {
        ptr = g.mpz_get_str(0, 10, r) >>> 0;
        const mem = new Uint8Array(g.mem.buffer);
        const len = n + intLen;
        if (mem[ptr + len] !== 0) throw new Error('unerwartete Ziffernzahl des Ergebnisses (Rechenfehler)');
        checkGuard(mem, ptr + intLen, target);
        checkHead(mem.subarray(ptr + intLen, ptr + intLen + Math.min(HEAD_CHECK, target)));
        const out = new Uint8Array(target - have);
        out.set(mem.subarray(ptr + intLen + have, ptr + intLen + target));
        return out;
    } finally {
        if (ptr) g.free(ptr);
        freeMpz(r);
    }
}

// Schutzstellen duerfen nicht alle 0 oder alle 9 sein (sonst koennte der Rechenfehler die letzten freigegebenen Stellen kippen).
function checkGuard(bytes, off, target) {
    let z = true, nine = true;
    for (let i = 0; i < GUARD; i++) {
        const c = bytes[off + target + i];
        if (c !== 48) z = false;
        if (c !== 57) nine = false;
    }
    if (z || nine) throw new Error('Schutzstellen nicht eindeutig (alle ' + (z ? '0' : '9') + '), Stelle ' + target + ' nicht sicher');
}

function checkHead(h) {
    if (head === null) { head = Uint8Array.from(h); return; }
    const k = Math.min(head.length, h.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        if (head[i] !== h[i]) throw new Error('Kontrollstellen stimmen nicht mit der ersten Stufe ueberein (Stelle ' + (i + 1) + ')');
    }
}

// ---------- BigInt-Rueckfall ----------

function checkBits(v) {
    if (cfg.bigintMaxBits && v > (1n << BigInt(cfg.bigintMaxBits))) throw new RangeError('Maximum BigInt size exceeded (test limit)');
    return v;
}

function bsPiBig(a, b) {
    if (b - a === 1n) {
        let P, Q;
        if (a === 0n) { P = 1n; Q = 1n; } else {
            P = (6n * a - 5n) * (2n * a - 1n) * (6n * a - 1n);
            Q = a * a * a * C3_OVER_24;
        }
        let T = P * (13591409n + 545140134n * a);
        if (a & 1n) T = -T;
        return [P, Q, T];
    }
    const m = (a + b) / 2n;
    const [P1, Q1, T1] = bsPiBig(a, m);
    const [P2, Q2, T2] = bsPiBig(m, b);
    return [checkBits(P1 * P2), checkBits(Q1 * Q2), checkBits(Q2 * T1 + P1 * T2)];
}

function bsEBig(a, b) {
    if (b - a === 1n) return [a, 1n];
    const m = (a + b) / 2n;
    const [Q1, T1] = bsEBig(a, m);
    const [Q2, T2] = bsEBig(m, b);
    return [checkBits(Q1 * Q2), checkBits(T1 * Q2 + T2)];
}

function bsAcothBig(x, a, b) {
    if (b - a === 1n) return [a === 0n ? 1n : x * x, 2n * a + 1n, 1n];
    const m = (a + b) / 2n;
    const [Q1, B1, T1] = bsAcothBig(x, a, m);
    const [Q2, B2, T2] = bsAcothBig(x, m, b);
    return [checkBits(Q1 * Q2), checkBits(B1 * B2), checkBits(T1 * B2 * Q2 + T2 * B1)];
}

function isqrtBig(n) {
    return isqrtBitsBig(n, n.toString(2).length);
}

function isqrtBitsBig(n, bits) {
    if (n < (1n << 52n)) {
        let r = BigInt(Math.floor(Math.sqrt(Number(n))));
        while (r * r > n) r--;
        while ((r + 1n) * (r + 1n) <= n) r++;
        return r;
    }
    const s = bits >> 2;
    const a = isqrtBitsBig(n >> BigInt(2 * s), bits - 2 * s);
    const x = (a + 1n) << BigInt(s);
    let y = (x + n / x) >> 1n;
    let d = n - y * y;
    while (d < 0n) { d += 2n * y - 1n; y--; }
    return y;
}

// floor(wert * 10^n) als BigInt
function calcBig(n) {
    const one = checkBits(10n ** BigInt(n));
    switch (id) {
        case 'pi': {
            const terms = BigInt(Math.floor(n / 14.18) + 2);
            const [, Q, T] = bsPiBig(0n, terms);
            return checkBits(Q * 426880n * isqrtBig(checkBits(10005n * one * one))) / T;
        }
        case 'e': {
            const [Q, T] = bsEBig(1n, BigInt(termsForE(n)) + 1n);
            return checkBits(one * (Q + T)) / Q;
        }
        case 'ln2': {
            let acc = 0n;
            for (const [coef, x] of LN2_TERMS) {
                const N = BigInt(Math.ceil((n + 10) / (2 * Math.log10(x))) + 1);
                const [Q, B, T] = bsAcothBig(BigInt(x), 0n, N);
                acc += BigInt(coef) * (checkBits(one * T) / (Q * B * BigInt(x)));
            }
            return acc;
        }
        case 'sqrt2': return isqrtBig(checkBits(2n * one * one));
        case 'phi': return (one + isqrtBig(checkBits(5n * one * one))) >> 1n;
        default: throw new Error('unbekannte Konstante ' + id);
    }
}

function stageBig(target) {
    const n = target + GUARD;
    const s = calcBig(n).toString();
    if (s.length !== n + intLen) throw new Error('unerwartete Ziffernzahl des Ergebnisses (Rechenfehler)');
    const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(s);
    checkGuard(bytes, intLen, target);
    checkHead(bytes.subarray(intLen, intLen + Math.min(HEAD_CHECK, target)));
    return bytes.slice(intLen + have, intLen + target);
}

// ---------- Hauptschleife ----------

function work() {
    if (busy || failed || limited || !ready) return;
    busy = true;
    let target = 0;
    try {
        if (mode === 'wasm' && cfg.ballastBytes) makeBallast();
        while (have < wanted && !limited) {
            target = Math.max(wanted, have * 2, MIN_STAGE);
            if (mode === 'wasm') {
                const fit = fitDigits();
                if (target > fit) target = fit; // MUT:precheck
                if (target <= have) {
                    limit('engine', 'next stage needs about ' + Math.round(estimateBytes(Math.max(wanted, have + 1)) / 2 ** 20) + ' MiB, module maximum is ' + Math.round(maxBytes() / 2 ** 20) + ' MiB');
                    break;
                }
            } else {
                target = Math.min(target, bigFail - 1);
                if (target <= have) {
                    limit('engine', 'BigInt size limit of this browser engine (no WebAssembly)');
                    break;
                }
            }
            let buf;
            if (mode === 'wasm') {
                if (!reserve(target)) {
                    limit('device', 'memory.grow failed: the device does not provide about ' + fmtBytes(askedBytes) + ' for the next stage (currently ' + fmtBytes(memBytes()) + ')');
                    break;
                }
                buf = stageWasm(target);
            } else {
                try {
                    buf = stageBig(target);
                } catch (e) {
                    if (!(e instanceof RangeError)) throw e;
                    bigFail = have + Math.floor((target - have) / 2) + 1; // Grenze halbieren, bis Zuwachs <= MIN_STAGE
                    if (target - have <= MIN_STAGE) {
                        limit('engine', 'BigInt size limit of this browser engine (no WebAssembly): ' + e.message);
                        break;
                    }
                    continue;
                }
            }
            const from = have;
            have = target;
            postMessage({ type: 'digits', from, buf, total: have, memBytes: memBytes(), maxPtr }, [buf.buffer]);
        }
    } catch (e) {
        fail('irrational-worker: ' + id + ' computation failed: ' + (e && e.message ? e.message : String(e)) + (e && e.stack ? '\n' + e.stack : ''));
    } finally {
        busy = false;
    }
}

// Nur Tests: belegt Speicher in 64-MiB-Bloecken, gibt den letzten wieder frei; die naechsten Allokationen liegen dann ueber 2 GiB.
function makeBallast() {
    const chunk = 64 * 2 ** 20;
    let total = 0, last = 0;
    while (total < cfg.ballastBytes) {
        const p = g.malloc(chunk) >>> 0;
        if (!p) throw new Error('Fatal error in gmp-wasm (ballast malloc failed at ' + total + ' bytes)');
        last = p;
        total += chunk;
    }
    if (last) g.free(last);
    cfg.ballastBytes = 0;
}

function start() {
    const info = (m) => postMessage({ type: 'info', mode: m, maxPages: cfg.maxPages });
    const toBigInt = (why) => {
        mode = 'bigint';
        ready = true;
        const message = why + ': ' + id + ' is computed with BigInt, the number of digits is limited';
        console.warn('[irrational-worker] ' + message);
        postMessage({ type: 'notice', message });
        info('bigint');
        work();
    };
    if (!wasmUsable()) return toBigInt('WebAssembly not available');
    try {
        importScripts(BUNDLE);
        self.gmp.init().then((lib) => {
            g = lib.binding;
            baseBytes = memBytes();
            mode = 'wasm';
            ready = true;
            info('wasm');
            work();
        }).catch((e) => toBigInt('GMP/WASM could not be loaded (' + (e && e.message ? e.message : e) + ')'));
    } catch (e) {
        toBigInt('GMP/WASM could not be loaded (' + (e && e.message ? e.message : e) + ')');
    }
}

onmessage = (ev) => {
    const m = ev.data || {};
    if (m.type === 'test') {
        if (id !== null) return fail('irrational-worker: test message after open');
        for (const k of Object.keys(cfg)) if (k in m) cfg[k] = m[k];
    } else if (m.type === 'open') {
        if (id !== null) return fail('irrational-worker: open called twice');
        if (!BYTES_PER_DIGIT[m.id]) return fail('irrational-worker: unknown constant ' + m.id);
        if (!Number.isInteger(m.intLen) || m.intLen < 0) return fail('irrational-worker: open without valid intLen');
        id = m.id;
        intLen = m.intLen;
        start();
    } else if (m.type === 'want') {
        wanted = Math.max(wanted, Math.floor(m.total) || 0);
        work();
    }
};

tools/workers/normales-mandelbrot-worker.js
"use strict";

// Iterates z <- k z^2 + c from z = 0 for a band of rows and returns gray pixels.
// For k != 0 the set is M / k (z = w / k turns it into w <- w^2 + k c), so the
// cardioid and bulb tests run on k c. The escape test uses a large radius B / |k|
// instead of 2 / |k|, which keeps the distance estimate accurate; it does not
// change which points belong to the set.
const B = 1e3;
const INSIDE = 18;

self.onmessage = (e) => {
  const { id, w, row0, row1, x0, y0, s, k, maxit } = e.data;
  const out = new Uint8ClampedArray(w * (row1 - row0) * 4);
  const R2 = k === 0 ? Infinity : (B / Math.abs(k)) ** 2;
  const logK = Math.log(Math.abs(k));
  let p = 0;
  for (let y = row0; y < row1; y++) {
    const ci = y0 - (y + 0.5) * s;
    for (let x = 0; x < w; x++, p += 4) {
      const cr = x0 + (x + 0.5) * s;
      out[p + 3] = 255;
      if (inMainParts(k * cr, k * ci) || k === 0) {
        out[p] = out[p + 1] = out[p + 2] = INSIDE;
        continue;
      }
      let zr = 0, zi = 0, dr = 0, di = 0, n = 0, r2 = 0;
      for (; n < maxit; n++) {
        // dz/dc <- 2 k z dz/dc + 1, before z moves on
        const ndr = 2 * k * (zr * dr - zi * di) + 1;
        di = 2 * k * (zr * di + zi * dr);
        dr = ndr;
        const nzr = k * (zr * zr - zi * zi) + cr;
        zi = 2 * k * zr * zi + ci;
        zr = nzr;
        r2 = zr * zr + zi * zi;
        if (r2 > R2) break;
      }
      if (n === maxit) {
        out[p] = out[p + 1] = out[p + 2] = INSIDE;
        continue;
      }
      // distance to the set in c units: |z| ln|k z| / |dz/dc|, then in pixels
      const az = Math.sqrt(r2);
      const d = az * (Math.log(az) + logK) / Math.hypot(dr, di);
      const t = Math.max(0, 1 - Math.log2(1 + d / s) / 7);
      const g = 6 + 240 * t * t * t;
      out[p] = out[p + 1] = out[p + 2] = g;
    }
  }
  self.postMessage({ id, row0, row1, out }, [out.buffer]);
};

// main cardioid and period-2 bulb of the classic set, in w-coordinates
function inMainParts(r, i) {
  const x = r - 0.25, q = x * x + i * i;
  if (q * (q + x) <= 0.25 * i * i) return true;
  return (r + 1) * (r + 1) + i * i <= 0.0625;
}

tools/zoom.js
// tools/zoom.js - generischer 2D zoom + pan helper
(function (global) {

  const DEFAULT_CONFIG = {
    mode: 'relative',
    hoverFollowsPointer: false,
    hoverPointerTypes: ['mouse'],
    minScale: 1e-9,
    maxScale: 1e6,
    wheelSpeed: 0.15,
    pinchSensitivity: 1.0,
    wheelThrottleMs: 0,
    wheelDeltaThreshold: 0,
    enableDamping: false,
    dampingFactor: 0.12,
    externalDamping: false,
    initialScale: 1,
    initialOffsetX: 0,
    initialOffsetY: 0,
    shouldIgnoreWheel: null,
    shouldIgnoreDrag: null,
    shouldIgnoreTouchDrag: null,
    panAfterPinch: false,
    getScrollX: null,
    getScrollY: null,
  };

  function clamp(v, min, max) {
    return v < min ? min : v > max ? max : v;
  }

  function createZoom2D(opts) {
    if (!opts || !opts.container) throw new Error('Zoom2D: container required');

    const container = opts.container;
    const content = opts.content || container;
    const cfg = Object.assign({}, DEFAULT_CONFIG, opts);
    const hoverFollowsPointer = cfg.hoverFollowsPointer || cfg.mode === 'absolute';
    const hoverPointerTypes = new Set(cfg.hoverPointerTypes || ['mouse']);

    let scale = clamp(cfg.initialScale, cfg.minScale, cfg.maxScale);
    let offsetX = cfg.initialOffsetX;
    let offsetY = cfg.initialOffsetY;

    let targetScale = scale;
    let targetOffsetX = offsetX;
    let targetOffsetY = offsetY;

    let lastWheelTime = 0;
    let animationFrameId = null;
    let isDragging = false;
    let lastX = 0;
    let lastY = 0;
    let pinch = { active: false, startDist: 0, worldX: 0, worldY: 0 };

    if (content && content.style && !content.style.transformOrigin) {
      content.style.transformOrigin = '0 0';
    }

    function getScrollX() {
      return typeof cfg.getScrollX === 'function' ? cfg.getScrollX() : 0;
    }

    function getScrollY() {
      return typeof cfg.getScrollY === 'function' ? cfg.getScrollY() : 0;
    }

    function applyTransform() {
      if (typeof opts.onTransform === 'function') {
        opts.onTransform({ scale, offsetX, offsetY });
      } else if (content && content.style) {
        content.style.transform = `translate(${offsetX}px, ${offsetY}px) scale(${scale})`;
      }
    }

    function hasMovement() {
      return Math.abs(scale - targetScale) > 0.0001
        || Math.abs(offsetX - targetOffsetX) > 0.01
        || Math.abs(offsetY - targetOffsetY) > 0.01;
    }

    function update() {
      if (!cfg.enableDamping) return false;

      if (hasMovement()) {
        scale += (targetScale - scale) * cfg.dampingFactor;
        offsetX += (targetOffsetX - offsetX) * cfg.dampingFactor;
        offsetY += (targetOffsetY - offsetY) * cfg.dampingFactor;
        applyTransform();
        return true;
      }

      scale = targetScale;
      offsetX = targetOffsetX;
      offsetY = targetOffsetY;
      applyTransform();
      return false;
    }

    function dampingLoop() {
      if (!cfg.enableDamping) return;

      if (update()) {
        animationFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(dampingLoop);
      } else {
        animationFrameId = null;
      }
    }

    function sync() {
      if (!cfg.enableDamping) {
        scale = targetScale;
        offsetX = targetOffsetX;
        offsetY = targetOffsetY;
        applyTransform();
        return;
      }

      if (cfg.externalDamping) return;
      if (!animationFrameId) {
        animationFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(dampingLoop);
      }
    }

    function screenToWorld(x, y) {
      const s = cfg.enableDamping ? targetScale : scale;
      const ox = cfg.enableDamping ? targetOffsetX : offsetX;
      const oy = cfg.enableDamping ? targetOffsetY : offsetY;
      return { x: (x - ox) / s, y: (y - oy) / s };
    }

    function zoomAt(screenX, screenY, factor) {
      const currentScale = cfg.enableDamping ? targetScale : scale;
      const newScale = clamp(currentScale * factor, cfg.minScale, cfg.maxScale);
      if (newScale === currentScale) return;

      const world = screenToWorld(screenX, screenY);
      targetScale = newScale;
      targetOffsetX = screenX - world.x * newScale;
      targetOffsetY = screenY - world.y * newScale;
      sync();
    }

    function setOffsets(nextOffsetX, nextOffsetY) {
      targetOffsetX = nextOffsetX;
      targetOffsetY = nextOffsetY;
      sync();
    }

    function onWheel(e) {
      if (typeof cfg.shouldIgnoreWheel === 'function' && cfg.shouldIgnoreWheel(e)) return;
      e.preventDefault();

      if (cfg.wheelDeltaThreshold > 0 && Math.abs(e.deltaY) < cfg.wheelDeltaThreshold) return;

      const now = performance.now();
      if (cfg.wheelThrottleMs > 0 && now - lastWheelTime < cfg.wheelThrottleMs) return;
      lastWheelTime = now;

      const rect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
      const x = e.clientX - rect.left + getScrollX();
      const y = e.clientY - rect.top + getScrollY();
      const direction = e.deltaY > 0 ? -1 : 1;
      const factor = 1 + direction * cfg.wheelSpeed;
      if (factor <= 0) return;
      zoomAt(x, y, factor);
    }

    function onMouseDown(e) {
      if (e.button !== 0) return;
      if (typeof cfg.shouldIgnoreDrag === 'function' && cfg.shouldIgnoreDrag(e)) return;
      isDragging = true;
      lastX = e.clientX;
      lastY = e.clientY;
    }

    function onMouseMove(e) {
      if (isDragging) {
        const dx = e.clientX - lastX;
        const dy = e.clientY - lastY;
        lastX = e.clientX;
        lastY = e.clientY;
        targetOffsetX += dx;
        targetOffsetY += dy;
        sync();
        return;
      }

      if (!hoverFollowsPointer) return;
      if (!hoverPointerTypes.has('mouse')) return;

      const rect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
      setOffsets(
        e.clientX - rect.left + getScrollX(),
        e.clientY - rect.top + getScrollY()
      );
    }

    function onMouseUp() {
      isDragging = false;
    }

    function onTouchStart(e) {
      if (e.touches.length === 2) {
        e.preventDefault();
        const t0 = e.touches[0];
        const t1 = e.touches[1];
        const rect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
        const cx = (t0.clientX + t1.clientX) / 2 - rect.left + getScrollX();
        const cy = (t0.clientY + t1.clientY) / 2 - rect.top + getScrollY();
        const world = screenToWorld(cx, cy);
        const dx = t0.clientX - t1.clientX;
        const dy = t0.clientY - t1.clientY;

        pinch.active = true;
        pinch.startDist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
        pinch.worldX = world.x;
        pinch.worldY = world.y;
        isDragging = false;
        return;
      }

      if (e.touches.length === 1) {
        if (typeof cfg.shouldIgnoreTouchDrag === 'function' && cfg.shouldIgnoreTouchDrag(e)) {
          isDragging = false;
          return;
        }
        e.preventDefault();
        isDragging = true;
        lastX = e.touches[0].clientX;
        lastY = e.touches[0].clientY;
      }
    }

    function onTouchMove(e) {
      if (pinch.active && e.touches.length === 2) {
        e.preventDefault();
        const t0 = e.touches[0];
        const t1 = e.touches[1];
        const dx = t0.clientX - t1.clientX;
        const dy = t0.clientY - t1.clientY;
        const newDist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
        if (pinch.startDist <= 0) return;

        const rawFactor = newDist / pinch.startDist;
        const factor = 1 + (rawFactor - 1) * cfg.pinchSensitivity;
        const rect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
        const cx = (t0.clientX + t1.clientX) / 2 - rect.left + getScrollX();
        const cy = (t0.clientY + t1.clientY) / 2 - rect.top + getScrollY();
        const currentScale = cfg.enableDamping ? targetScale : scale;
        const newScale = clamp(currentScale * factor, cfg.minScale, cfg.maxScale);
        if (newScale === currentScale) return;

        targetScale = newScale;
        targetOffsetX = cx - pinch.worldX * newScale;
        targetOffsetY = cy - pinch.worldY * newScale;
        pinch.startDist = newDist;
        sync();
        return;
      }

      if (!pinch.active && e.touches.length === 1 && isDragging) {
        e.preventDefault();
        const t = e.touches[0];
        targetOffsetX += t.clientX - lastX;
        targetOffsetY += t.clientY - lastY;
        lastX = t.clientX;
        lastY = t.clientY;
        sync();
      }
    }

    function onTouchEnd(e) {
      if (e.touches.length < 2) {
        // Nach dem Pinch zieht der verbliebene Finger weiter (wie bibelaufdenpunkt.html, touchend)
        if (cfg.panAfterPinch && pinch.active && e.touches.length === 1) {
          isDragging = true;
          lastX = e.touches[0].clientX;
          lastY = e.touches[0].clientY;
        }
        pinch.active = false;
      }
      if (e.touches.length === 0) {
        isDragging = false;
      }
    }

    function getState() {
      return { scale, offsetX, offsetY };
    }

    function setView(newState, animate) {
      if (!newState) return;

      const newScale = typeof newState.scale === 'number'
        ? clamp(newState.scale, cfg.minScale, cfg.maxScale)
        : (cfg.enableDamping ? targetScale : scale);
      const newOffsetX = typeof newState.offsetX === 'number'
        ? newState.offsetX
        : (cfg.enableDamping ? targetOffsetX : offsetX);
      const newOffsetY = typeof newState.offsetY === 'number'
        ? newState.offsetY
        : (cfg.enableDamping ? targetOffsetY : offsetY);

      if (cfg.enableDamping && animate !== false) {
        targetScale = newScale;
        targetOffsetX = newOffsetX;
        targetOffsetY = newOffsetY;
        sync();
        return;
      }

      scale = newScale;
      offsetX = newOffsetX;
      offsetY = newOffsetY;
      targetScale = newScale;
      targetOffsetX = newOffsetX;
      targetOffsetY = newOffsetY;
      applyTransform();
    }

    function zoomBy(factor) {
      const rect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
      zoomAt(rect.width / 2, rect.height / 2, factor);
    }

    function zoomIn() {
      zoomBy(1 + cfg.wheelSpeed * 2);
    }

    function zoomOut() {
      zoomBy(1 - cfg.wheelSpeed * 2);
    }

    function reset() {
      setView({
        scale: cfg.initialScale,
        offsetX: cfg.initialOffsetX,
        offsetY: cfg.initialOffsetY
      });
    }

    function destroy() {
      container.removeEventListener('wheel', onWheel);
      container.removeEventListener('mousedown', onMouseDown);
      window.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
      window.removeEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);
      container.removeEventListener('touchstart', onTouchStart);
      container.removeEventListener('touchmove', onTouchMove);
      container.removeEventListener('touchend', onTouchEnd);
      container.removeEventListener('touchcancel', onTouchEnd);
      if (animationFrameId) cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrameId);
    }

    container.addEventListener('wheel', onWheel, { passive: false });
    container.addEventListener('mousedown', onMouseDown);
    window.addEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
    window.addEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);
    container.addEventListener('touchstart', onTouchStart, { passive: false });
    container.addEventListener('touchmove', onTouchMove, { passive: false });
    container.addEventListener('touchend', onTouchEnd);
    container.addEventListener('touchcancel', onTouchEnd);

    applyTransform();

    return {
      destroy,
      getScale: () => (cfg.enableDamping ? targetScale : scale),
      getState,
      setView,
      zoomIn,
      zoomOut,
      zoomBy,
      reset,
      update,
    };
  }

  global.Zoom2D = { createZoom2D };
})(typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window : this);

  <script>
    const gameContainer = document.getElementById('gameContainer');
    const solutionRing = document.getElementById('solutionRing');
    const hole = document.getElementById('hole');
    const problemCircle = document.getElementById('problemCircle');
    let isDragging = false, offsetX, offsetY;
    function getCenter(elem) {
      const rect = elem.getBoundingClientRect();
      return { x: rect.left + rect.width / 2, y: rect.top + rect.height / 2 };
    }
    function setInitialProblemPosition() {
      const solutionCenter = getCenter(solutionRing);
      const holeRadius = hole.offsetWidth / 2;
      const problemRadius = problemCircle.offsetWidth / 2;
      const minDistance = holeRadius + problemRadius + 2;
      const distance = minDistance + 10;
      const angle = 0;
      const problemCenterX = solutionCenter.x + distance * Math.cos(angle);
      const problemCenterY = solutionCenter.y + distance * Math.sin(angle);
      const containerRect = gameContainer.getBoundingClientRect();
      const problemRect = problemCircle.getBoundingClientRect();
      problemCircle.style.left = (problemCenterX - containerRect.left - problemRect.width / 2) + "px";
      problemCircle.style.top  = (problemCenterY - containerRect.top  - problemRect.height / 2) + "px";
    }
    window.addEventListener('load', setInitialProblemPosition);
    window.addEventListener('resize', setInitialProblemPosition);
    problemCircle.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
      isDragging = true;
      const rect = problemCircle.getBoundingClientRect();
      offsetX = e.clientX - rect.left;
      offsetY = e.clientY - rect.top;
      problemCircle.style.transition = "none";
    });
    document.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
      if (!isDragging) return;
      const containerRect = gameContainer.getBoundingClientRect();
      let newLeft = e.clientX - containerRect.left - offsetX;
      let newTop  = e.clientY - containerRect.top  - offsetY;
      problemCircle.style.left = newLeft + "px";
      problemCircle.style.top  = newTop + "px";
      const solutionCenter = getCenter(solutionRing);
      const problemRect = problemCircle.getBoundingClientRect();
      const problemCenter = { x: problemRect.left + problemRect.width / 2, y: problemRect.top + problemRect.height / 2 };
      const holeRadius = hole.offsetWidth / 2;
      const problemRadius = problemCircle.offsetWidth / 2;
      const minDistance = holeRadius + problemRadius + 2;
      const dx = problemCenter.x - solutionCenter.x;
      const dy = problemCenter.y - solutionCenter.y;
      const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
      if (dist < minDistance) {
        const push = minDistance - dist;
        const pushX = (dx / dist) * push;
        const pushY = (dy / dist) * push;
        newLeft += pushX;
        newTop  += pushY;
        problemCircle.style.left = newLeft + "px";
        problemCircle.style.top  = newTop  + "px";
      }
    });
    document.addEventListener('pointerup', () => {
      if (!isDragging) return;
      isDragging = false;
      const solutionCenter = getCenter(solutionRing);
      const problemRect = problemCircle.getBoundingClientRect();
      const problemCenter = { x: problemRect.left + problemRect.width / 2, y: problemRect.top + problemRect.height / 2 };
      const dx = problemCenter.x - solutionCenter.x;
      const dy = problemCenter.y - solutionCenter.y;
      const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
      const holeRadius = hole.offsetWidth / 2;
      if (dist < holeRadius + 5) {
        const containerRect = gameContainer.getBoundingClientRect();
        const targetX = solutionCenter.x - containerRect.left - problemRect.width / 2;
        const targetY = solutionCenter.y - containerRect.top - problemRect.height / 2;
        problemCircle.style.transition = "left 0.5s, top 0.5s";
        problemCircle.style.left = targetX + "px";
        problemCircle.style.top  = targetY + "px";
        setTimeout(() => { problemCircle.style.transition = ""; }, 600);
      }
    });
  </script>

  <script src="/tools/irrational.js"></script>
  <script src="/tools/pi-file.js"></script>
  <script src="/tools/unfolding-view.js"></script>
  <!--
    Tims Gedanken zu Pi (aus dem Gespräch der früheren Seite piKommaPi, seine Nachrichten, Tippfehler geglättet).
    Der kleine Kreis (o) steht hier für das centrum.

    Das centrum
    Pi wird mit einem kleinen Kreis in der Mitte geschrieben, dem centrum of pi (a little circle).
    Links die 3, rechts (o)1415…

    Am centrum gespiegelt
    Pi am centrum spiegeln: π,π = …951413(o)14159…
    Oder ohne die 3: …5141(o)1415… Perfekt spiegelsymmetrisch. Die 3 geht im Kreis auf.
    3 = 0, 1, ∞, der Anzahl nach.

    Basis 10
    Ein Zahlensystem mit Basis π,π. Dort heißt die Basis selbst 10.

    Malnehmen
    5141(o)1415² = 26431335(o)92302225
    95141(o)14159² = 9051836823(o)0484277281
    Wie genau man malnehmen kann, hängt von der verfügbaren Rechenkapazität ab.
    Aber der Punkt ist, dass es sich definieren lässt.

    Die Pointe
    Die Pointe aller irrationalen Zahlen ist, dass sie im irrationalen Komma gespiegelt, unter irrationaler
    Berücksichtigung aller irrationalen Dezimalstellen eine irrational exakt definierbare irrational unendlich
    große Zahl mit einer irrationalen Anzahl Dezimalstellen ergibt. Empfinde ich als ziemlich rational.
    Sie ist zwar abzählbar unendlich, aber es wäre irrational, dies tatsächlich zu tun.

    Mehr Kommas
    Nicht nur π,π. Auch e,e oder e,π. Unendlich viele irrationale Zahlen ergeben noch mehr unendlich viele
    Kombinationen. Und warum auf ein Komma beschränken? π,π,π. Das tut nur die euklidische Algebra.

    Grundsatz
    Der Mathematik nichts wegnehmen außer ihrer Kleingeistigkeit. Nur hinzufügen.
    Teils interessant, mindblown, absurd, sinnlos, teilweise weise.
  -->
  <script>

    // Die Ansicht (tools/unfolding-view.js) hält die Kette: Ganzzahl (Irrational.constants[].intPart), ".", Nachkommastellen.
    const CONSTS = Irrational.constants;
    const constOf = (id) => CONSTS.find((k) => k.id === id);
    const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
    let cid = params.get('c') || 'pi';
    let requestedTotal = 0;
    let piError = null;
    let piNotice = null;

    const deviceCap = () => (file ? (testCfg().deviceDigits || 100000) + 1 : Infinity);
